  • Du verfolgst Performance-Marketing-Trends aktiv und bringst neue Impulse proaktiv ins Team ein.
  • Du managst deine Projekte proaktiv und selbstständig, findest dich aber auch schnell in Teams ein und schätzt Kollaboration und gute Zusammenarbeit.

jobs.title: UK New Business Director
jobs.description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does an UK- New Business Director do at WPP Production? 
  

The role

The New Business Director plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production, defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities and shaping the strategic direction of our UK growth function.

You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority new business opportunities, designing integrated solutions and clear go-to-market propositions.  You will ensure that every response (whether formal RFP or informal approach) is clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across all UK pitches, setting the standard for how we articulate our value.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in driving integration across Media, Creative and Production, shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions.

Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth — defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally. This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team.

This is a high-impact role with visibility across the whole UK business, suited to someone who thrives in the fast-paced world of new business, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth and business impact at scale.

 

Key areas of responsibility:

  • Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning
  • Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across all pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value
  • Design end-to-end client solutions and commercial models, including operating models, pricing approach and value proposition
  • Lead the development of go-to-market propositions, continuously evolving how WPP Production positions itself in market
  • Work with the Global Chief Growth Officer to define and drive the global growth strategy for WPP Production, identifying priority markets, opportunity types and areas of focus
  • Define and influence where we focus our growth efforts, ensuring time and resource are prioritised on the highest value opportunities
  • Analyse pipeline, performance and market trends to identify where growth is coming from — and where it should come from next
  • Partner with senior leadership to shape growth priorities, targets and investment decisions
  • Drive improved conversion, efficiency and revenue impact across the new business pipeline through stronger strategic positioning and approach
  • Build and scale a repeatable growth engine, embedding frameworks, playbooks, tools and best practice that enable teams globally to win consistently without central dependency
  • Act as a "pitch doctor", stepping into critical opportunities to strengthen narrative, structure and overall response quality
  • Present and represent WPP Production in senior client meetings & pitch meetings
  • Drive cross-WPP integration, ensuring seamless collaboration across Media, Creative and Production
  • Identify and embed new ways of working, improving how we approach, structure and deliver pitches
  • Lead on innovation in growth, including exploring the use of AI and new technologies to enhance team capability and efficiency
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP and key client organisations
  • Develop and scale team capability, through coaching, mentoring and training

 What good looks like:

  • Significant experience in new business, client leadership, growth or strategy roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, with a proven ability to define how complex opportunities are approached and won
  • Outstanding writing and storytelling ability, with experience leading narrative development for high-value, multi-disciplinary pitches
  • Strong commercial acumen, with experience designing and influencing commercial models, pricing strategies and value propositions
  • Able to use and apply AI tools to the new business process
  • Proven experience leading large, complex and high-value pitch processes, often involving multiple stakeholders and disciplines
  • Confident and credible communicator, with experience presenting to senior clients and influencing at leadership level
  • Comfortable operating at pace and under pressure, managing multiple high-stakes opportunities simultaneously
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing ecosystems, including the intersection of media, creative and production
  • Able to influence and align senior stakeholders, often with competing priorities, to a single direction
  • Experience shaping or evolving go-to-market propositions and strategic positioning
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, bringing structure and clarity to complex challenges
  • A proactive and solutions-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Experience developing and mentoring team members, with a focus on building capability and scaling impact
  • Curious and forward-thinking, with an interest in innovation, AI and the future of content and production

#LI-BS2

#LI-Hybrid

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact 
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. Senior Growth Manager

The role 
The Senior Growth Manager plays a central role in driving WPP Production's growth, leading pitch responses, RFP's submissions and client presentations that clearly articulate our value and deliver winning results.

This role blends strategic thinking with strong project leadership. You'll take ownership of multiple opportunities — managing timelines, inputs, and stakeholders to ensure every response is delivered on time and to the highest standard — while also shaping the story that ties it all together.

You'll be responsible for creating a clear red thread and a compelling narrative that connects disparate materials into a cohesive, client-centric story. Working alongside client leads, you'll ensure every submission has a strong overarching narrative — one that is distinct, persuasive, and directly addresses the client's brief and objectives.

You'll help define the strategic approach for each opportunity, ensuring the story, structure, and positioning of every response reflect WPP Production's proposition and competitive advantage. You'll balance creative flair with commercial understanding — able to explain how our operational model works, why it's effective, and what it delivers for clients.

Key activities:  

  • Take ownership of specific new business opportunities, leading the process end-to-end — from strategy to submission.
  • Develop cohesive and compelling narratives that bring together strategy, operations, and creative thinking into a unified client story.
  • Shape and articulate operational models and value propositions clearly — demonstrating how they work, why they matter, and the benefit to the client.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and client leads to ensure each response and presentation has a strong, client-centric narrative.
  • Liaise with WPP agencies and colleagues on multi-agency opportunities.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders in WPP Production, WPP, WPP OpCos, and intermediaries.
  • Support the ongoing development of case studies, marketing collateral, and credentials materials.
  • Ensure the New Business Growth Hub is up to date with high-quality content that adheres to brand guidelines.
  • Monitor and evaluate competitor activity and broader industry trends to keep WPP Production's positioning sharp and differentiated.

Requirements 

  • Advertising experience/Production background is preferable
  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to connect complex ideas into clear, persuasive narratives.
  • Strategic thinker who can distil complexity into clarity and align ideas to client needs and business outcomes.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills and confidence engaging with senior stakeholders across WPP Production, WPP, and client organisations.
  • Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple projects and large volumes of content across stakeholders.

Diversity and Inclusion 

WPP Production is committed to diversity and inclusion, through our ideas, our people, how we behave and conduct ourselves. Creating a truly inclusive culture at all levels of the organisation that encourages different points of view, making WPP Production not only a better company and place to work but an environment where everyone experiences connection, opportunity and a sense of belonging.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Elite Motorsport)
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer (Motorsport)

DO YOU WANT TO WORK FOR THE WORLD LEADER IN ELITE SPORTS PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS?

Catapult is a world leader in sports performance technology, serving over 5000 teams across 40 sports. We improve many of your favorite athletes' performances with our wearable tracking technology, video and data analysis systems, and athlete management products. Our technology offers objective solutions to sport-based challenges and can be found throughout the NFL, NHL, NBA, AFL, NRL, Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga and many more.

In Motorsport, Catapult's SBG race management and team strategy systems are the technology of choice for elite-level organisers and competitors around the world, including in Formula 1, Formula E, IndyCar, NASCAR, WEC/Le Mans and other worldwide endurance racing. Customers include the FIA (in F1, F2, F3, F1 Academy, FE and WEC), nine Formula 1 teams (including the 8-time World Champion Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team), the majority of Formula E teams, the winners of multiple Le Mans 24-hour races over the last 10 years (Audi, Porsche, and Toyota) and teams and organisers in both IndyCar and NASCAR. 

We have major offices in the UK (London and Leeds), USA (Boston) and Australia (Melbourne) as well as multiple smaller offices around the world.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SPORTS AND WANT TO WIN

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Senior Software Engineer (Motorsport) to grow our Motorsport development team as we expand our RaceWatch products into new series and tackle new challenges.

Based in London, you will be a key player in developing new capabilities in RaceWatch, particularly for Endurance racing strategy, but also contributing to the entire RaceWatch suite across different racing series.

We believe that our customers deserve the best platform, and we are on a mission to maximise and enhance their performance through delivering the highest quality experience. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help us drive our products and processes forward, as well as acting as a mentor and providing technical leadership to other team members. You will be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series.
  • Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks.
  • Identify ways to add innovative new features to the software.
  • Lead others to anticipate and meet customer needs.
  • Be one of the technical leaders within the team.
  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
  • Ensure code quality, organization, and best practices throughout the development process.
  • Lead with a growth mindset, encouraging others to share ideas and opinions.
  • Maintain and enhance software reliability.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • A passion for Motorsport.
  • 5+ years working in a fast-paced, technical environment, delivering software to customers.
  • A proven track record of building applications in C/C++.
  • Experience developing products, scaling them, and supporting them throughout the entire lifecycle.
  • An aptitude for working with complex data.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, both internally and when speaking to customers.
  • A willingness to go above and beyond for the customer.
  • Ability to help cover live motorsport events at weekends on a rotational basis with the rest of the team.
  • An ability to multi-task and thrive in a dynamic work environment with changing priorities.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Degree in computer science or other scientific or technical subject.
  • Prior experience working in motorsport is a strong advantage.
  • An understanding of the challenges faced by motorsport officials and teams in managing and participating in events.
  • Experience using Catapult's RaceWatch software.
  • Experience with ticketing and project management platforms, such as JIRA or Monday.
  • Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio.
  • Experience developing applications that process video.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication; to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries so you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures.
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.
  • We care about you. We offer outstanding paid maternity and paternity leave.

Whether you are interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams, organisations and competitors on the planet! While we have access to many exciting opportunities, we also realize that we are here to do a very important job for our customers. As a result, we aim to work with purpose and intention. We look for people that fit into our team culture, those who actively contribute and individuals who are excited about what they do. 

In order to build the future of sports performance, we need the brightest talent. If you think you can contribute to the empowering, enjoyable and exciting Catapult environment, then we invite you to apply.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role:  Senior Integrated Designer - 12 month FTC

Location:  London, United Kingdom  

About the role: 

As Senior Integrated Designer, you'll lead creative thinking and execution across the studio's full channel mix, from initial concept through to final delivery across digital, social, motion, print, and events. You'll bring both ideas and craft to every brief, ensuring work is visually strong, strategically considered, and consistent across touchpoints and markets. 

Operating within a regulated financial services environment, you'll bring discipline to compliance-sensitive materials, set quality benchmarks for the team, embed AI-assisted design workflows, and help build a studio the wider organisation is proud of. 

What you will be doing: 

 Integrated Design & Creative Production 

  • Concept and create on-brand integrated work across the full channel mix, brand campaigns, digital and social content, motion, print, events, marketing collateral, thought leadership, and long-form communications, from brief through to final delivery 
  • Bring integrated thinking to every brief, considering how ideas translate across channels, formats, and markets before execution begins 
  • Produce motion and animation work for digital and social, applying strong storytelling and timing principles alongside visual craft 
  • Adapt integrated design solutions for seven markets and multiple product lines, maintaining visual and conceptual consistency within brand guardrails; prepare all files to correct digital, motion, and print specifications 
  • Manage multiple live projects simultaneously, maintaining brand integrity, quality standards, and deadlines across all output 

 Brand Guardianship & Consistency 

  • Champion consistency of visual identity, tone, and quality across every touchpoint and market, proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen brand expression 
  • Apply compliance requirements, disclaimers, substantiation standards, and sign-off checkpoints, as standard practice, with approvals documented correctly 
  • Contribute to brand guidelines, scalable templates, and asset systems that enable speed and consistency across the studio 

 Team Leadership & Collaboration 

  • Lead, direct, and mentor the design team, providing clear creative briefs, constructive feedback, and development support that raises capability and output quality across the integrated mix 
  • Work closely with the embedded team and client stakeholders to develop integrated creative ideas, translating feedback into clear direction for the team 

 Gen AI & Agentic Thinking 

  • Apply advanced AI tools to enhance integrated creative output and workflows, building effective prompts, critically evaluating results, and maintaining rigorous human oversight of quality and compliance 
  • Design and embed AI-assisted workflows for the team, setting quality benchmarks and guiding responsible AI use across sizing, adaptation, motion, transcreation, and production efficiency 
  • Break down complex, multi-format creative challenges into clear steps, leading the team to the best outcome efficiently and adapting confidently when priorities shift 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating integrated creative thinking and execution across digital, social, motion, print, and campaign formats, with evidence of both conceptual originality and hands-on craft 
  • Advanced proficiency across Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects) and Figma; expert understanding of graphic design, typography, motion, and digital production standards 
  • Proven ability to concept ideas that work across channels, not just adapt static design to new formats 
  • Experience producing motion and animation work for digital and social, with strong storytelling instincts alongside technical execution 
  • Experience producing integrated work for international or multi-market campaigns, adapting design systems across countries and channels within brand guardrails 
  • Deep understanding of brand identity systems, able to apply, protect, and evolve visual standards across a complex, multi-touchpoint portfolio 
  • Familiarity with regulated industries (financial services, insurance, or similar), or demonstrated ability to work within compliance, legal, and governance frameworks 
  • Experience contributing to brand guidelines, scalable templates, and asset systems that enable consistency and speed across a team 
  • Experience leading and mentoring designers, providing clear creative direction, developmental feedback, and coaching that builds integrated craft capability 
  • Confident presenting and defending integrated creative concepts to senior stakeholders, translating feedback into clear direction for the team 
  • Advanced use of AI tools relevant to integrated design, building effective workflows, evaluating outputs critically, and training others in responsible AI use 
  • Agentic mindset: able to lead a team through complex, multi-format creative challenges, adapting confidently when priorities shift and maintaining quality under pressure
  • Formal degrees are welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts. Experience can be gained through work, study, volunteering, or self-directed learning.

Location:  London, United Kingdom  (2-3 days a week from our London offices)

 

About the role: 

We're looking for a Global Head of Analytics to lead one of the most important practices in our business. This is a senior leadership role with genuine scope; you'll own a global team of around 80 people, spanning audience insight, creative performance analytics, social listening and measurement, search marketing and paid social, all embedded within in-house client teams across Europe, APAC, LATAM and North America. 

Reporting to OLIVER's Chief Strategy Officer, you'll sit at the intersection of creativity, technology and data. You'll help OLIVER and our clients understand not just what's performing, but why, and what to do next. You'll spearhead new solutions in driving creative effectiveness, and proving the value of the creative component of our clients' marketing.

    • Ensure the team has the engineering capability to integrate data sources and build automated solutions at scale
    • Champion data and insight as a strategic differentiator — internally at OLIVER and externally with clients

jobs.description:
The Role:

 

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 

The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system. 


What This Role Is Not: 

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title. 


What You Will Work On:
 

Technical Leadership 

  • Define and own the technical roadmap for autonomous constellation operations
  • Set the architectural direction for the data platform, reliability systems, and automation infrastructure
  • Stay hands-on: review code, prototype solutions, and get into the details when it matters
  • Establish engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing, and observability, and hold the team to them
  • Be the person engineers come to when the problem is genuinely hard

Team Building & Culture 

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a team of 6 to 10 world-class reliability and platform engineers
  • Set the pace, tone, and ambition for the team and make being on it feel like a privilege
  • Create an environment where engineers grow fast, own their work, and ship things they are proud of
  • Identify gaps and level up engineers through mentorship and not just management

Operational Transformation 

  • Lead the shift from manual, operator-driven processes to fully automated and self-healing operations
  • Define and drive toward SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets for the constellation
  • Partner with satellite operations and mission teams to translate pain into software solutions

Cross-Functional Influence 

  • Be the technical voice of the team in company-wide conversations about architecture, infrastructure, and platform strategy
  • Influence how Spire thinks about automation, data, and AI/ML across the broader engineering organization

Basic Qualifications: 

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 in a technical leadership or staff-level individual contributor role
  • Demonstrated track record building and shipping reliable production systems at scale. You have owned things that could not go down.
  • Deep technical credibility. Engineers on your teams have respected your judgment and not just your title.
  • Experience with SRE principles, reliability engineering, or large-scale automation. You have reduced toil systematically and not just complained about it.
  • Strong foundation in Python, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience hiring and developing engineers. You know what great looks like and how to find it.
  • The communication and influence skills to drive technical decisions across teams you do not directly control

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience applying AI/ML or advanced analytics to operational or monitoring problems
  • Experience writing performance software in Rust
  • Background in space systems, aerospace, or highly constrained real-time environments
  • Experience building data lakes, telemetry platforms, or observability infrastructure at scale
  • A history of leading teams through technical transformations and not just maintaining the status quo

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office.

jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer - London
jobs.description:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Position

The DevSecOps Engineer is a leadership and individual contributor role responsible for maturing our security posture across all engineering departments. You will lead the design and implementation of automated, platform-based security solutions, enabling teams to build secure software while maintaining velocity. You will partner closely with Core Tech, Product, and Engineering leadership to define our security roadmap and culture.

We’re excited about you because you are a trailblazer who balances high-level strategy with hands-on technical execution. You are comfortable building from near-scratch, thrive on educating others, and possess a "platform" mindset that prioritizes empowering developers over acting as a gatekeeper.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and execute a multi-quarter security roadmap for the entire engineering organization.

  • Develop and maintain platform-level security tools that enable automated, self-service security for feature teams.

  • Partner with Core Tech to integrate security primitives into our standard CI/CD and cloud deployment workflows.

  • Conduct cross-team discovery to assess current security posture and identify high-risk technical debt.

  • Mentor junior and peer engineers, fostering a culture where security is integrated into the "you build it, you run it" philosophy.

  • Stay ahead of evolving threat landscapes, specifically regarding supply chain risks and large-scale AI infrastructure.

  • Own and mature our existing detection, SIEM, and incident-response tooling as part of building out the broader security platform — this role inherits live systems, it isn't a blank canvas.

  • Act as a security collaborator to IT on AI-usage risk (data exposure via connectors/agents, prompt injection) — distinct from, and in addition to, securing the AI systems Hiya builds as a product.

Qualities that will make you successful:

  • Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture (AWS) and modern security best practices.

  • Proven experience designing "self-service" platforms that developers actually want to use.

  • Strong communication skills—the ability to turn complex security concerns into decisions engineers and stakeholders can act on.

  • High proficiency in at least one modern language and familiarity with agent-based/AI-assisted development tools.

  • Pragmatism—knowing when to accept calculated tech debt in favor of high-impact outcomes.

  • A leadership style rooted in empathy, collaborative debate, and commitment to team decisions.

  • Builds systems, documentation, and team capability that outlast you — we're wary of highly productive engineers who leave behind bespoke, unmaintainable tooling that has to be scrapped when they move on.

The person in this role must embody Hiya’s key values of Serving our customers, Doing rather than observing, Improving ourselves and our business, Owning and holding ourselves accountable for success, and Leading by showing up with a point of view, engaging in open discussion, listening respectfully to others opinions and committing to decisions.

The requirements listed in the job descriptions are guidelines. You don’t have to satisfy every requirement or meet every qualification listed. If your skills are transferable we would still love to hear from you.

How We Work

Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems.

We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy. Context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. Once a call is made, we commit and move forward.

You'll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results, while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.

Every team member at Hiya is expected to live our core values:

  • Serve, our customers and partners by holding a high bar for trust and quality

  • Own, share in success and open up to failures

  • Lead, listen, show up with a point of view but commit entirely once a decision has been made

  • Improve, even if it means changing course or contradicting ourselves

  • Do, rather than observe

How We Invest in You

Compensation & Ownership
Equity Compensation: ownership aligned with your impact and the company's growth

We offer an L&D budget to support your growth and real internal mobility so career pathing isn't just a talking point — because we're building this with people who own the outcome.

 

Come Work With Us!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!

Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Service & Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning:

AVL is one of the world’s leading mobility technology companies for development, simulation and testing in the automotive industry, and beyond. The company provides concepts, solutions and methodologies in fields like vehicle development and integration, e-mobility, automated and connected mobility (ADAS/AD), and software for a greener, safer, better world of mobility.

Arbetsbeskrivning:

Vill du arbeta nära den senaste tekniken, lösa komplexa utmaningar och vara den person som kunder litar på när avancerade testsystem ska fungera på topp? Då kan du vara den Service Engineer vi söker.

Hos AVL List Nordiska arbetar vi i framkant inom Instrumentation & Test Systems på den nordiska marknaden. Vi är ett team på 30 personer i Göteborg och Stockholm – och nu behöver vi en Service Engineer till vårt team i Göteborg.

Hos oss får du en roll där du kombinerar teknik, problemlösning och kundkontakt, samtidigt som du får stora möjligheter att utvecklas i en internationell miljö.

Som Service Engineer ansvarar du för att säkerställa att våra kunders emissionsmätsystem och instrument fungerar med högsta möjliga tillförlitlighet och prestanda. Du arbetar nära våra kunder och blir en viktig teknisk partner som bidrar med både service, support och specialistkunskap. Rollen innebär stor variation där du växlar mellan planerade serviceinsatser, felsökning, teknisk rådgivning och utvecklande kunduppdrag.

I det dagliga arbetet utför du service, underhåll, kalibrering och driftsättning av emissionsmätningsinstrument samt säkerställer att utrustningen uppfyller gällande kvalitets- och säkerhetskrav. Du stödjer även kunderna inom mätning och analys av avgasreningssystem och hjälper dem att optimera sina processer och tekniska lösningar. Genom att analysera problem, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och föreslå lösningar bidrar du till att skapa långsiktigt värde för kunden.

Du arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor i teambaserade uppdrag där samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och ett lösningsorienterat arbetssätt är avgörande för framgång. Dokumentation, rapportering och uppföljning är en naturlig del av rollen, liksom ett kontinuerligt arbete med att utveckla och förbättra våra arbetssätt, processer och tjänster.

Tjänsten innebär resor till kunder i Sverige och, i vissa fall, internationellt. Det ger dig möjlighet att arbeta i varierande miljöer, lära känna olika verksamheter och utvecklas inom avancerad mätteknik och ny teknologi.

Profilbeskrivning:

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:


    Minst 2 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom service, underhåll, mätteknik, teknisk support eller liknande område.
    God teknisk förståelse och erfarenhet av felsökning och problemlösning.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med teknisk utrustning, instrument eller mätsystem.
    God datorvana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i olika IT- och affärssystem.
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
    B-körkort.

Meriterande:


    Erfarenhet av installation, driftsättning (commissioning), service och underhåll av mätutrustning, testsystem, precisionsutrustning eller liknande tekniska produkter.
    Erfarenhet av lagkrav, regelverk och certifieringsprocesser kopplade till avgasreningssystem (Exhaust Aftertreatment Systems).
    Erfarenhet av fältservice och arbete i kundnära tekniska miljöer.
    Kunskap om och erfarenhet av emissionsmätningssystem och relaterad utrustning.
    Erfarenhet av arbete inom fordonsindustrin, motorutveckling eller närliggande tekniska områden.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta i internationella projekt eller kundmiljöer.

Som person:

Du är en serviceinriktad och engagerad person som trivs i en roll med stort eget ansvar och många kontaktytor. Du arbetar strukturerat och självständigt, samtidigt som du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar och prioriteringar. Med ett lösningsorienterat och analytiskt förhållningssätt tar du dig an tekniska utmaningar på ett metodiskt sätt och drivs av att hitta effektiva lösningar för både kunder och verksamhet. Samtidigt är du en prestigelös lagspelare som uppskattar samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och att bidra till teamets gemensamma framgång.

Vi erbjuder:

På AVL blir du en del av ett globalt teknikföretag som ligger i framkant av utveckling, simulering och testning inom mobilitetens framtid. Som världens största oberoende aktör inom området, med över 12 000 medarbetare internationellt, driver vi innovation för en grönare, säkrare och bättre värld av mobilitet.

Vårt fokus sträcker sig över hela värdekedjan – från tidiga idé- och konceptfaser till industrialisering och serieproduktion. Vi arbetar med avancerad teknik inom elektrifiering, mjukvara, autonom körning, digitalisering och energieffektiva drivlinor, och hjälper våra kunder att forma framtidens mobilitetslösningar.

Hos oss får du en arbetsplats där du kan växa, påverka och vara med och driva teknikutvecklingen framåt – som gör verklig skillnad för framtidens mobilitet!

Intresserad?

I denna rekryteringsprocess tillämpar vi löpande urval. Det innebär att rekryteringsprocessen kan gå snabbt och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

jobs.title: Global Trade Compliance Lead | Volvo Cars
jobs.description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.

Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves  

The Trade Compliance, Anti-Corruption & Human Rights team is part of Compliance & Ethics within Group Legal and Corporate Affairs. The team defines Volvo Cars’ corporate compliance requirements within key risk areas, including Trade Sanctions and Export Controls, as part of the broader Compliance & Ethics framework.



We operate in a fast-changing regulatory environment and translate complex trade compliance requirements into clear, practical and risk-based guidance for the business.







About the role



This is a global corporate risk lead role within Compliance & Ethics, responsible for defining and maintaining Volvo Cars’ corporate Trade Compliance requirements, with a primary focus on trade sanctions and export controls. The role is based at Volvo Cars headquarters in Gothenburg.



In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert for Trade Compliance. You will set the substantive direction for the risk area, promote consistent application of corporate requirements across regions and functions, and support the business in navigating complex regulatory requirements and important business decisions.



You will play a central role in shaping how Volvo Cars identifies, governs and manages Trade Compliance risks globally, ensuring that regulatory developments, enforcement trends and business priorities are translated into practical requirements, risk-area methodology, guidance, controls, training and management reporting.





     What you'll do  

You will work closely with business and functional stakeholders, regional Compliance & Ethics colleagues and other colleagues working with Trade Compliance globally to drive alignment and ensure that requirements are understood, embedded and applied consistently across regions. The role also requires close coordination with adjacent compliance areas such as anti-corruption, human rights, competition law and broader third-party risk management where risk topics overlap.



Your responsibilities will include:




    Act as the Global Corporate Risk Lead for Trade Compliance and a key Compliance & Ethics contact for trade sanctions and export controls, in close collaboration with other Trade Compliance colleagues globally.
    Define, maintain and continuously improve Volvo Cars’ corporate Trade Compliance framework, requirements, methodology, guidance and tools.
    Monitor regulatory developments, enforcement trends and industry practice, and translate them into practical business requirements and guidance.
    Set risk-area priorities and substantive direction, and provide input to Compliance & Ethics planning, reporting and continuous improvement.
    Provide expert advice and specialist compliance input to business functions and leadership.
    Lead or support risk assessments, controls, mitigation plans, incidents, investigations and complex compliance matters with Trade Compliance expertise.
    Lead coordination and alignment across global Trade Compliance colleagues, regional Compliance & Ethics teams and relevant business functions.
    Provide subject-matter input to authority interactions, industry forums, regulatory consultations and external engagements in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

    



   Profile description: What you'll bring  

Required qualifications




    University degree in Law, Business, International Trade, Engineering, or a related field.
    At least 10 years of relevant experience in trade compliance, export controls and sanctions, preferably in a global corporate, legal, regulatory or advisory environment.
    Strong working knowledge of EU and U.S. export control and sanctions laws and regulations.
    Demonstrated experience handling complex, cross-border trade compliance matters involving multiple jurisdictions.
    Proven ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, business-oriented guidance.
    Experience defining or applying compliance requirements, risk methodology, governance, and controls in a corporate environment.
    Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.



Preferred qualifications




    Experience in a multinational organization with complex products, technologies, supply chains and market-access considerations.
    Experience using digital tools, analytics or AI-enabled solutions to support compliance risk management or process improvement.
    Professional certification, such as Swedish Certified Export Control Manager or equivalent.



Who you are




    You demonstrate strong integrity, independence and sound professional judgment, combined with a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach to compliance.
    You bring an analytical, risk-based mindset and are comfortable navigating complex and evolving regulatory environments.
    You are a strong communicator and trusted partner, able to influence senior stakeholders and build trust across business, regional and functional teams.
    You are comfortable taking ownership, setting direction and managing competing priorities in a global, fast-paced environment.

  



We offer:

Why join us?



This role offers high visibility and the opportunity to shape Volvo Cars´global Trade Compliance agenda, influencing how export controls and trade sanctions are integrated into our products, technologies, supply chains and global operations.



You will join a collaborative, international environment where compliance is seen as an enabler of responsible, sustainable and resilient business.

jobs.description:
Rådgjevar lån og forsikring 

Vi i SpareBank 1 Sogn og Fjordane utviklar oss stadig for å skape den  beste kundeopplevinga. No treng vi deg på laget.  

I avdelinga Direktebank  får du jobbe med kundar frå heile marknadsområdet vårt og bygge brei kompetanse innan lån, forsikring og rådgjeving. Du blir ein del av ein viktig kundekanal i banken og utviklar deg i eit miljø der læring, samarbeid og initiativ blir verdsett. 

I avdelinga jobbar vi aktivt med rådgjeving, sal, kampanjar og kundeutvikling.  

No søker vi tre nye rådgjevarar som vil vere med å påverke korleis vi møter kundane i framtida. To av stillingane har hovudvekt på lån og forsikring, medan den tredje er meir retta mot kundeservice.  

Du vil jobbe på hovudkontoret i Førde, saman med 180 andre tilsette på huset, og ta del i det største samla finansmiljøet mellom Bergen og Ålesund.  

Dette skal du jobbe med 

  • Rådgjeving innan lån, forsikring og andre banktenester 
  • Kartlegging av kundebehov og gode økonomiske løysingar 
  • Kundekontakt på telefon, chat og e-post 
  • Sal, kampanjar og kundeutvikling 
  • Bidra til vidare utvikling av Direktebanken 

Kven ser vi etter? 

Du pratar lett med folk, skapar tillit og oppnår resultat. Du er løysingsorientert og ønsker å utvikle deg innan rådgjeving og sal.  

Har du autorisasjon innan lån og finansiering og/eller skade- og personforsikring er det ein fordel, men ikkje eit krav. Erfaring frå bank, finans, forsikring, kundeservice eller sal er også eit pluss. Det viktigaste er likevel motivasjon og driv.  

Difor skal du søke hos oss 

Vi er eit spennande finanshus med breitt fagmiljø og ein offensiv strategi.  Hos oss ønskjer vi at du skal utvikle deg, og kjem du med gode initiativ er det kort veg til å sette desse i verks.  

Som fast tilsett blir du automatisk medeigar i banken. Du får tildelt eigenkapitalbevis det første året etter oppstart, og vi har eit gunstig spareprogram i EK-bevis. I tillegg får du funksjonærlån med god rente, gode tilsettebetingelsar på sparing og forsikring og tilgang til banken sine hytter og leilegheiter. 

Klar for å bli med på utviklinga av avdelinga Direktebanken? Då håpar vi du søker. 

Renate Skaar Værøy svarer gjerne på spørsmåla dine. 

Vi gjennomfører bakgrunnssjekk av søkjarar for å verifisere opplysningar som kjem fram av CV og tilgjengeleg dokumentasjon. Bakgrunnssjekk blir gjennomført av Semac AS etter at kandidaten er orientert om, og har samtykka til dette.

jobs.title: Senior Health & Safety Engineer
jobs.description:
Zeeco fosters a robust work environment where employees, from engineering teams to support groups, benefit from a strong culture, trained leadership, and opportunities for growth. Zeeco collaborates with the biggest names in the industry, enabling individuals to broaden their skills alongside teams of subject matter experts. 

Zeeco is a global leader in combustion and environmental solutions, renowned for our expertise in designing, engineering, and manufacturing advanced burners, incinerators, and environmental control systems. Serving a wide array of industries such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, and power generation, we deliver innovative technologies that enhance operational efficiency, safety, and environmental compliance.
 
Our Senior Health and Safety Engineer is responsible for overseeing the development, implementation, and management of the Global Field Services (GFS) Health, Safety, Environmental policies and procedures. The role ensures that the organisation complies with legal and regulatory standards while promoting a culture of safety, quality, and environmental responsibility. As our new Health and Safety Engineer for our Construction team you will work closely with the project managers, construction managers and global field services teams to identify risks, ensure compliance, and improve practices related to safety, health, and environmental performance.
 
You will work within the Global Field Services Team based at Zeeco Europe’s European Head Quarters in Stamford the UK. This role requires a flexible and dynamic individual with a passion to deliver complex engineering and construction projects worldwide. Responsible for the development, management and co-ordination of HSE management systems and documentation for the global field service team (GFS) within the EMEA region.
 
Key responsibilities:
  • Develop, implement, and maintain the GFS departments Health and Safety policies and procedures in line with local and international regulations (e.g., OSHA, HSE regulations).
  • Develop and maintain standard documentation packs, templates and process maps for all associated activities related to the GFS team.
  • Conduct risk assessments, safety audits, and inspections to identify potential hazards and mitigate risks.
  • Organize and lead training programs on health and safety practices, compliance training and safe work methods.
  • Track and monitor engineer safety documents and qualifications to ensure validity and verify any qualification gained meets the project and local requirements prior to mobilisation of personnel.
  • Support Zeeco HSE team with registration of freelance engineers and contractors conducting site works. Completing audits as necessary and ensuring all individuals are vetted prior to mobilisation to a work site.
  • Pre-mobilisation vetting and verification of sub-contractor employees to ensure they are competent and qualified for the scope of works and meet client and/or regional requirements.
  • Investigate and report workplace accidents, incidents, and near misses, and ensure the implementation of corrective actions. Working with Zeeco QHSE manager to ensure all reports are logged
  • Implement and track the calibration and certification of critical equipment including but not limited to pressure equipment, personnel monitors, measurement devices, lifting equipment, etc.
  • Organise and deliver HSE training for employees for all GFS groups, fostering a culture of safety, health, and environmental responsibility.
  • Promote awareness programs that educate staff on HSE issues, best practices, and the importance of compliance.
  • Work with Zeeco main QHSE Management to track HSE performance metrics for the GFS groups, including incident reports, audit findings, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Investigate accidents, incidents, and non-conformances, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Skills & Experience required:
  • Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, Occupational Health and Safety, Quality Management, or a related field (preferred).
  • Certifications in HSE (e.g., NEBOSH, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) are highly desirable.
  • Extensive experience in HSE co-ordination/management or a similar role, preferably in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical or Power industry (with Construction bias).
  • Proven track record of managing HSE functions and developing and implementing safety, quality, and environmental programs.
  • Strong knowledge of HSE regulations, standards, and best practices.
  • Experience with HSE audits, risk assessments, and incident investigation.
  • Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Strong IT skills Microsoft, project, teams, excel, etc.
  • Hands-on Health and Safety culture, leading from the front both at construction sites and in the office.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously.
Why join Zeeco?
At Zeeco, we value our employees and are committed to offering a comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being and professional growth, see below some of the great things we offer:
  • BUPA, Medicash, Employee Assistance Program to support your wellbeing.
  • 12% Employer contribution to company pension scheme to help you plan confidently for the future.
  • 27 days holiday (plus bank holidays) so you can recharge and maintain a healthy work–life balance.
  • Life insurance for added peace of mind.
  • Professional growth opportunities, including training, development, and the chance to work alongside world class engineering teams.
  • A supportive, safety driven culture where your expertise is valued and your voice matters.
  • Regular social events to have fun, and enjoy team camaraderie and to promote and protect our culture.
  • Global project exposure, working across Europe and the Middle East with industry leading technology.
The role will be a hybrid role between the office and site-based, with the HSE Engineer spending a split (50/50, site/office) amount of time on construction sites. The position will also require office work for planning and administrative tasks. This role requires hybrid and flexible working to react to business requirements. Including the need to adapt and change plans at short notice, including weekends and evenings on occasion.
Working at Zeeco means being part of a people-centric culture and environment built on mutual respect, personal encouragement, professional integrity, and limitless opportunity. Join Zeeco and embark on a fulfilling journey where innovation, collaboration, and personal and professional growth converge.

  • kunne arbeide godt selvstendig og i team
  • være strukturert
  • ha gode kommunikasjonsevner både skriftlig og muntlig på norsk
  • ser etter løsninger i stedet for problemer og bidrar til utvikling av sektoren

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

 

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr et godt arbeidsmiljø, dyktige medarbeidere og en arbeidsplass der vi ønsker å legge til rette for et faglig utfordrende og kvalitetsmessig godt tilbud til våre ansatte og brukere. Vi forsøker å tilpasse arbeidsoppgavene den enkeltes kompetanse og interessefelt.

Som arbeidssted kan du velge mellom Molde sentrum eller et av våre kontorer i Eidsvåg og Midsund.
Enheten har fleksible løsninger for bruk av hjemmekontor.

Molde kommune er med sine 32000 innbyggere den største kommunen i romsdalsregionen. jobs.title: Vil du jobbe med informasjonssikkerhet i Forsvarsbygg?
jobs.description:
Forsvarsbygg har en sentral rolle i å opprettholde Norges frihet og suverenitet. Vårt oppdrag er å sørge for utvikling og forvaltning av forsvarssektorens eiendom, bygg og anlegg. Slik støtter vi Forsvarets operasjoner og legger til rette for at de kan øve og operere i fred, krise, og krig.

Vi søker nå etter tre nye koordinator innenfor informasjonssikkerhet som skal assistere vår regionale datasikkerhetsleder i utføring av oppgaver. Avdeling sikkerhet har landsdekkende sikkerhetsansvar på tvers av avdelingene i Forsvarsbygg. Sikkerhetsarbeidet retter seg mot et omfattende antall bygg og anlegg, samt ansatte og underleverandører over hele landet. Sikkerhetsarbeidet krever samarbeid med både Forsvaret og andre etater. Stillingen innebærer arbeid med et variert spekter av sikkerhetsmessige utfordringer og etablering og drift av graderte informasjonssystemer gir gode muligheter for faglig utvikling. Vi forventer ikke at du har erfaring med alle oppgavene, da du vil få nødvendig opplæring og støtte underveis.

Arbeidssted kan være Rygge, Sessvollmoen eller Jørstadmoen. Noe reisevirksomhet må regnes med.

Les mer om Forsvarsbygg på www.forsvarsbygg.no


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Assistere regional datasikkerhetsleder i utføring av dennes oppgaver
  • Føre kontroll med eget distrikts datasikkerhet/informasjonssystemsikkerhet, herunder
    • Sørge for at instruksverket for datasikkerhet, både generell del og de systemspesifikke delene, er ajourført og tilfredsstillende til enhver tid.  
    • Følge opp sikkerhetsgodkjenning av regionens informasjonssystemer for gradert informasjon
    • Oppfølging av godkjenning av møterom for høyere gradert tale
  • Gi faglige råd, opplæring og veiledning til personell i tildelt del av regionen, slik at informasjons-
    sikkerheten og den operative bruken av distriktets graderte datasystemer er på et sikkerhetsmessig
    forsvarlig nivå
  • Føre kontroll av medieregister iht. instruks(er) for medieregister – Lavgradert/Høygradert
  • I samråd med foresatt, gi råd og veiledning ved planlegging/prosjektering av graderte
    datainstallasjoner og lokaler
  • Bistå i arbeidet med akkreditering av graderte datainstallasjoner innen sitt arbeidsområde
  • Fremme forslag til endring/oppdatering av eksisterende interne sikkerhetsbestemmelser, instrukser,
    prosedyrer og risikovurderinger
  • Kontrollere alle IKT systemer og påse at kun sikkerhetsmessig godkjente IKT-systemer benyttes for
    graderte data-/informasjonsbehandling
  • Kontakt og koordinering opp imot andre etater og samarbeidspartnere
  • Ved behov bekle lokale sikkerhetsroller
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som jobber strukturert og planmessig, har god gjennomføringsevne og er fagorientert. Du jobber godt både selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre, og kommuniserer tydelig.

Kvalifikasjoner

Du må ha:

  • Relevant utdanning innen informasjonsteknologi, sikkerhetsfag eller annet relevant fagområde. Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Gode kommunikasjonsegenskaper i norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Du må kunne sikkerhetsklareres for nivå STRENGT HEMMELIG og NATO SECRET. Du kan lese mer om sikkerhetsklarering på NSM.no

Det er ønskelig at du har: 

  • Fagbrev innen informasjonsteknologi eller sikkerhetsfag
  • Kurs innenfor forebyggende sikkerhet
Hvorfor jobbe hos oss

I Forsvarsbygg vil du få en spennende og variert arbeidshverdag med et meningsfullt samfunnsoppdrag hvor du vil bidra til å bygge forsvarsevne hver dag. Vi satser på medarbeiderne våre, vi tilbyr kursing, etter- og videreutdanning og har etablert vår egen prosjektlederutdanning. Vi har en familievennlig og fleksibel personalpolitikk med gode arbeidstidsordninger. Du vil også få tilgang til treningsrom og bedriftsidrettslag med varierte aktiviteter. Som ansatt hos oss får du medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse som er en av landets beste pensjonsordninger med mulighet for boliglån og gode forsikringsordninger. Forsvarsbygg ønsker at arbeidsstyrken avspeiler mangfoldet i samfunnet. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, kulturell bakgrunn, hull i CV-en eller funksjonsevne.

Andre opplysninger

  • Stillingen lønnes som førstekonsulent/ seniorkonsulent  (kode 1408/ 1363) fra kr. 600 000,- til kr. 700 000.
  • Vi ber ikke om søknadsbrev. For oss er det mer relevant med en beskrivende CV som viser hva du har av erfaring og kompetanse. Du vil også bli bedt om å svare på et spørsmål i søknadsskjemaet, der du kan utdype relevant erfaring for stillingen.
  • Vi ber om at du laster opp vitnemål og karakterutskrifter i søknaden din.
  • Vi oppfordrer kvinner til å søke.
  • Offentlig søkerliste utarbeides etter søknadsfristens utløp. Dersom du ønsker å reservere deg fra oppføring på offentlig søkerliste må dette begrunnes. Du vil bli varslet om reservasjon ikke tas til følge.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Forsvarsbygg er en etat underlagt Forsvarsdepartementet. Vi bygger, forvalter, drifter og vedlikeholder bygg og anlegg som er avgjørende for Norges sikkerhet. Forsvarsbygg er en beredskapsetat, og vi skal levere på vårt oppdrag for Forsvaret i fred, krise og krig. 

Vi forvalter cirka 13 000 bygg og anlegg, og gjennomfører rundt 700 investeringsprosjekter til enhver tid. Det gjør oss til Norges største offentlige eiendomsaktør. Ansvaret vårt spenner fra historiske festninger åpne for allmennheten til landets mest komplekse og samfunnskritiske forsvarsanlegg.

Hos oss vil du kunne bidra med din kompetanse til å styrke den norske forsvarsevnen, og gjøre oss mer robust, bærekraftig og framtidsrettet.

Vi mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning.

jobs.title: Vil du bruke data til å løse utfordringer for vårt konsern?
jobs.description:
Vi i SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge bygger nå opp vårt analysemiljø på en moderne, skybasert plattform i Snowflake, med verktøy som Python, SQL, Git/GitHub og dbt Cloud. Vi søker en data scientist som ønsker å jobbe med avansert analyse og som brenner for å omsette data til innsikt og forretningsverdi.

Du blir en del av avdelingen Analyse og dataplattform, et fagmiljø på 17 personer som har ansvar for konsernets data- og analyseplattform og analytiske kapabiliteter. Hos oss jobber data scientists, data engineers og andre spesialister tett sammen for å utvikle innsikt, maskinlæringsmodeller og dataprodukter som brukes på tvers av konsernet.

Dette er en rolle for deg som ønsker å gå dypere inn i analyser, modellutvikling og verdiskaping fra data.

Hva du vil jobbe med
Forretningen etterspør stadig ny innsikt og mer presis beslutningsstøtte. For å lykkes trenger vi en data scientist som kan:• Utvikle og vedlikeholde maskinlæringsmodeller og analyser i Python

  • Utvikle og vedlikeholde maskinlæringsmodeller og analyser i Python
  • Utvikle datamodeller i dbt/SQL for å understøtte analyser
  • Samarbeide tett med både forretning og dataplattform 
  • Bidra til at maskinlæring og avansert analyse tas i bruk på nye områder og gir målbar forretningsverdiForstå forretningsutfordringer og omforme dem til analytiske problemstillinger 
  • Presentere funn og anbefalinger til beslutningstakere, samt fungere som bindeledd mellom forretning og tekniske miljøer 
  • Bidra til at forretningen lykkes med selvbetjente BI-løsninger

Hvem vi ser etter 

Du trenger ikke kunne alt, men du må være nysgjerrig, analytisk og motivert for å lære. 

Vi ser gjerne at du har flere av følgende: 

  • Høyere utdanning innen statistikk, data science, matematikk, økonomi, informatikk eller tilsvarende 
  • Erfaring med analysearbeid, modellutvikling og maskinlæring 
  • Kompetanse på SQL og Python eller lignende programmeringsspråk
  • Forståelse for MLOps og versjonskontroll
  • Kjennskap til finans eller bank
  • Kunnskap om GDPR og personvern

Personlige egenskaper 

  • Du er nysgjerrig og liker å forstå hvordan ting henger sammen 
  • Du jobber strukturert og metodisk 
  • Du trives med både selvstendig arbeid og samarbeid i tverrfaglige team 
  • Du kommuniserer komplekse analyser på en enkel og forståelig måte 
  • Du deler kunnskap og bidrar til et godt fagmiljø 
  • Du liker å holde deg oppdatert på nye metoder og teknologi innen data science og KI

Hvorfor velge oss 

I Analyse og dataplattform får du: 

  • Et sterkt fagmiljø innen data, analyse og maskinlæring 
  • Spennende problemstillinger med stor betydning for konsernet 
  • Mulighet til å jobbe med moderne analyse- og datateknologi

Vi ønsker at du legger ved vitnemål sammen med søknaden. Kandidater som har fullført høyere utdannelse i løpet av de siste tre årene må legge ved karakterutskrift.

jobs.title: Vil du jobbe der hele verden går forbi?
jobs.description:
Vil du jobbe der hele verden går forbi?

Vi søker ekstrahjelper til vår suvenirbutikk på Bergen Lufthavn og ser etter deg som liker mennesker, høyt tempo og en arbeidsdag hvor ingen dager er helt like.

Hos oss møter du kunder fra hele verden. Noen skal kjøpe med seg et lite minne fra Norge, noen trenger en gave i siste liten, og noen trenger bare hjelp til å finne akkurat den elgen de ikke visste at de måtte ha.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss hvis du:

  • er blid, utadvendt og glad i mennesker

  • liker å selge og yte skikkelig god kundeservice

  • tar initiativ og ser hva som må gjøres

  • trives med høyt tempo og mange kunder

  • er pålitelig og kommer på jobb når du skal

  • kan jobbe både selvstendig og sammen med andre

  • snakker godt norsk/skandinavisk og engelsk

Du må kunne jobbe i tidsrommet 05.00--22.00, og arbeidstid vil variere mellom tidlige morgener, dag, kveld og helg.

Det er en stor fordel om du har bil da enkelte vakter starter så tidlig at kollektivtransport kan være utfordrende.

Hva går jobben ut på?

Først og fremst: kunder og salg.

  • hjelpe og veilede kunder fra hele verden

  • selge norske gaver og suvenirer

  • betjene kasse og håndtere Tax Free Refund

  • fylle på varer og sørge for at butikken alltid ser bra ut

  • holde orden i butikk og på lager

  • bidra der det trengs gjennom dagen

Vi tilbyr

  • En annerledes arbeidsplass i den internasjonale terminalen på Bergen Lufthavn

  • Kontakt med mennesker fra hele verden

  • Variert jobb med salg, service og mange ulike produkter

  • Hyggelig arbeidsmiljø med kollegaer som hjelper hverandre

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Dette er en ekstrahjelpstilling, så vi ser spesielt etter deg som er fleksibel og har mulighet til å stille opp når det trengs. Det er en fordel om du også kan jobbe mer i ferier og travle perioder.

For å jobbe på Avinors Lufthavner kreves det plettfri vandel og bakgrunnssjekk fra Luftfartstilsynet.

Høres dette ut som deg?

Send oss en kort søknad og CV . Fortell gjerne litt om hvem du er, hvorfor du har lyst til å jobbe hos oss -- og når du vanligvis har mulighet til å jobbe.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Om North

North er en del av Ting AS og er et suvenirkonsept med fokus på gaver, suvenirer og minner fra Norge.

I butikkene våre ønsker vi å gi både norske og internasjonale reisende muligheten til å ta med seg et lite stykke Norge videre på reisen. Sortimentet består av alt fra klassiske norske suvenirer til gaver og produkter med norsk design og tilhørighet. North finner du på Oslo Lufthavn Gardermoen og Bergen Lufthavn Flesland. Hos North handler det ikke bare om hva kunden tar med seg hjem, men og om å gi dem et hyggelig siste møte med Norge.

jobs.title: På utkikk etter en deltidsjobb i helger? Kvinne i 60-årene søker BPA!
jobs.description:

Jeg ser etter deg som har god rolleforståelse, er profesjonell, trygg i deg selv og tar initiativ når det trengs. Fredag 16-21, lørdag 9-16, søndag 16-21.

Totalt 17 timer helg, tilsvarende fast stilling 8,5 timer per uke
