jobs.title: Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

Who you are

We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.

Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.

What you’ll do

  • Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

  • Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.

  • Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.

  • Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.

  • Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.

  • Shape pricing and commercial decisions: Translate underlying payment economics into recommendations for customer pricing, product design, new market launches and commercial strategy, ensuring growth is supported by sustainable unit economics.

  • Build scalable infrastructure and automation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to strengthen cost engines, fee allocation logic, dashboards and automated controls. Apply AI and advanced analytics to accelerate rule interpretation, detect anomalies and surface optimization opportunities.

  • Own complex scheme economics issues: Serve as the escalation point for scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions, working directly with Visa, Mastercard and other payment partners where required.

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or related roles, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

  • Deep knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules.

  • Strong ability to operationalize complex payment rules, translating fee schedules and network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.

  • Experience with payment cost systems and controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modeling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to connect detailed payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimization.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale.

  • Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Bli min nye BPA-assistent på Søndre Nordstrand – humor og hjertevarme verdsettes
jobs.description:

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - CIMAR
jobs.description:
Company Overview  

CIMAR UK Ltd, now a part of DeepHealth, is a leading provider in the SaaS (Software-as-a-Service) healthcare sector, specialising in advanced cloud-based image management solutions. Our technology empowers healthcare organisations to optimise image management processes, enhance patient care, and streamline workflows through seamless integration and actionable data insights.

Job Summary 

The DevOps Engineer is a hands-on engineering role within the Platform Engineering team, responsible for supporting and evolving DeepHealth's AWS-based infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD tooling, and operational processes. Working closely with the Senior Platform Engineer, this role focuses on infrastructure automation, cloud operations, platform reliability, and continuous improvement. The DevOps Engineer plays an important part in helping development teams deliver software efficiently while ensuring that DeepHealth's infrastructure remains secure, scalable, and resilient.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

·       Design, build, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tooling (Terraform or equivalent), ensuring consistency, repeatability, and version control.

·       Manage and improve Kubernetes platforms (EKS or similar), including cluster configuration, scaling, upgrades, and reliability.

·       Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to support fast, reliable software delivery across development teams.

·       Monitor platform health and performance, respond to incidents, and drive root cause analysis and resolution to maintain high availability.

·       Automate operational processes and repetitive tasks to reduce toil and improve team efficiency.

·       Implement and maintain cloud security best practices including IAM policies, network security, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.

·       Support development teams with platform tooling, onboarding to infrastructure services, and resolving environment-level issues.

·       Manage container image pipelines and registry, including security scanning and lifecycle management.

·       Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation of infrastructure, processes, runbooks, and architectural decisions.

·       Contribute to cost monitoring and optimisation across cloud services, identifying inefficiencies and recommending improvements.

 

 

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above.  Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience: 

·       Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required).

·       5+ years of experience in a DevOps, platform engineering, or cloud infrastructure role (required).

·       Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, and related) (required).

·       Experience managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments (required).

·       Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or equivalent (required).

·       Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform (required).

·       Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar for automation (required).

·       Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, load balancing, firewalls, and VPNs (required).

·       Security-conscious approach to infrastructure design and operations (required).

·       Preferred: Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar).

·       Preferred: Familiarity with GitOps practices and tooling (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux).

·       Preferred: AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect).

·       Preferred: Experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare or finance.

 

Quality Standards  

• Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

• Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

• Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

• Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

• Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

• Practices universal safety precautions.

• Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

• Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

• Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

• Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Physical Demands 

This position often requires sitting, standing, walking, bending, twisting, reaching with hands and arms, using hands and fingers, handling, or feeling, speaking, listening, and high-level cognitive thinking. Also, must be able to lift up to 10 pounds occasionally.

Travel 

This position may require occasional travel.

Working Environment 

Remote

£60,000 - £70,000 per year

jobs.title: Socialsekreterare ekonomiskt bistånd och socialpsykiatri
jobs.description:
Är du intresserad av en tjänst som socialsekreterare i en verksamhet med flera ansvarsområden? Vi  rekryterar nu en ny medarbetare. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Tjänsten är placerad i verksamheten Arbete och Etablering Myndighet inom Individ- och familjeomsorgen i Vellinge kommun. I verksamheten finns boendekoordinator samt socialsekreterare som handlägger försörjningsstöd, socialpsykiatriinsatser, budget-och skuldrådgivning, bostadsinsatser, familjerätt, våld i nära relation samt skadligt bruk och beroende med totalt 11 medarbetare. Våra medarbetare har en hög expertis inom respektive område och arbetsgruppen arbetar gemensamt, tar hjälp av varandra och täcker upp för varandra vid behov. Arbetsgruppen arbetsleds av en närvarande enhetschef.

Vi arbetar med individens rätt till självständighet och självförsörjning och med en god service med regelbundna klientmöten. Det kräver god kunskap om våra olika områden, ett gott bemötande mot våra medborgare och en förmåga att kunna handlägga på ett rättssäkert sätt. Vi förväntar oss att du arbetar med hög grad av självständighet och har en god samarbetsförmåga.

Hos oss erbjuds du ett varierande arbete i en utvecklingsinriktad organisation med ambitiösa och engagerade kollegor. Vi lägger tid och resurser på att kompetensutvecklas utifrån de behov som finns och gruppen erbjuds extern handledning kontinuerligt. Utifrån tjänstens utformning har du själv möjlighet att vara med och forma din tjänst efter intresse, engagemang och verksamhetens behov.

Vi använder verksamhetssystemet Life Care.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Tjänsten innebär ett kombinerat uppdrag där du arbetar med Mottagningssarbete genom att bedöma rätten till ekonomiskt bistånd avseende nyansökningar, samt genom att handlägga ansökningar enligt Socialtjänstlagen (SoL) för personer med socialpsykiatriska behov.

Ekonomiskt bistånd

I din roll som socialsekreterare inom ekonomiskt bistånd kommer du huvudsakligen att arbeta med arbetsuppgifter kopplade till vårt Mottag, vilket innebär att du tar emot nyansökningar och utreder grundläggande förutsättningar till ekonomiskt bistånd. Du ger även råd, stöd och vägledning till kommunens medborgare utifrån boende, socialpsykiatri, skadligt bruk och beroende och våld i nära relationer.  I rollen ingår återkommande kontakter med både enskilda individer och interna och externa samverkansaktörer.

I rollen ingår även att erbjuda enklare budget- och skuldrådgivning. Då Vellinge kommun eftersträvar att bli en mer förebyggande, lättillgänglig, jämställd och kunskapsbaserad socialtjänst kan rollen innebära arbete utanför kontorsmiljö i en högre grad än traditionell myndighetsutövning.



Socialpsykiatri

I rollen som socialsekreterare inom socialpsykiatri arbetar du i första hand med att handlägga ansökningar om insatser enligt Socialtjänstlagen (SoL) utifrån socialpsykiatriska behov. Arbetet innebär att du utreder, bedömer, fattar beslut och följer upp insatser. Inom socialpsykiatrin är insatserna boendestöd, vård- och omsorgsboende samt  kontaktperson. I detta arbete kommer du att ha löpande uppföljning med utförare på boendestöd kring pågående insatser.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har socionomexamen. Du ska ha minst 1 års erfarenhet av socialt arbete med inriktning ekonomiskt bistånd. Det är även önskvärt om du har erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom socialpsykiatri, men det är inget krav.



Det är meriterande om du har:

Aktuell erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom socialtjänstens övriga ansvarsområden

Erfarenhet av arbete i Lifecare

Utbildning i MI

Erfarenhet av Case Management eller liknande arbetsmodeller

Arbetet kräver att du har goda datorkunskaper, en välutvecklad administrativ förmåga samt att du kan uttrycka dig väl i både tal och skrift på svenska.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2026-11-01  Tillträde omgående eller enligt överenskommelse.

Vi vill att det ska kännas bra både att bo och jobba i Vellinge kommun. För oss är mod, trovärdighet, glädje och omtanke viktigt för att trivas på arbetet och i vardagen. Vi har stort fokus på god service och gott bemötande såväl internt som externt. jobs.title: Ernæringskokk
jobs.description:
Solberglia kjøkken søker dyktig, faglært og engasjert kokk.

Er du en positiv person med godt humør? Ser du muligheter der andre ser utfordringer, liker høyt tempo og forstår viktigheten av riktig og god kvalitet og ernæring. Vi er en av 5 kjøkken i Ernæring og kjøkkendrift i Drammen kommune og vårt kjøkken ligger på Solberglia sykehjem.

Vi produserer frokost, lunsj, middag og kveldsmåltid til beboerne ved Solberglia, samt lunsj og middag til Bråta helse og aktivitetssenter og bofellesskap.

På vårt kjøkken er vi et godt og kunnskapsrikt team hvor samarbeid er en stor del av jobben. Vi er tålmodige og hjelpsomme. Hver dag jobber vi sammen for å lage god og ernæringsrik mat til Drammen kommunes institusjoner og innbyggere.



Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Produksjon av varm og kald mat til institusjoner, bofelleskap inkludert både normalkost og dietter/spesialkost
  • Bestilling av varer ved behov
  • Pakking av mat
  • IK mat, HACCP og HMS
  • Bidra med kompetanse på kurs i virksomheten
  • Bidra til reduksjon av matsvinn
  • Fokus på økonomisk bærekraft
  • Oppvask og renhold
  • Arbeid i kalde rom
  • Varemottak, rydding av lager, kjøl og frys
  • Daglig bruk av kostholdsprogrammet Matilda
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagbrev i kokk/ernæringsfaget
  • Inneha digitale ferdigheter
  • Kjennskap til relevant lov og avtaleverk
  • Grunnleggende kjennskap til produksjons - og næringsmiddelhygiene, samt IK mat, HACCP og HMS
  • Erfaring fra kok/server og kok/kjøl produksjon
  • Erfaring fra institusjon/storkjøkken
  • Kjennskap til kostholdsprogrammet Matilda
  • For søkere med annen utdanning enn norsk, kreves dokumenterte språkkunnskaper skriftlig og muntlig på nivå B2. Dette gjelder ikke skandinaviske søkere. Dokumentasjon vedlegges søknaden. 
Personlige egenskaper
  • Evne til å jobbe systematisk og strukturert både på egen hånd og i team
  • Liker høyt tempo og mange arbeidsoppgaver
  • Trygg på egne ferdigheter og deler kompetanse
  • Bidrar til at arbeidsdagen blir god for alle
  • Kreativ, liker å gjøre det lille ekstra og bidra til at kjøkkenet utvikler seg
  • Gode samarbeids og kommunikasjonsevner
  • Evne til å takle høyt arbeidstempo, uforutsigbarhet og god på å omstille seg
  • Profesjonell og liker ta imot tilbakemeldinger for å forbedre både seg selv og kjøkkenet
  • God humør, god helse og god personlig hygiene
  • Utviklingsorientert og ser viktigheten av kjøkkenets rolle i helse og velferdsektoren
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt
Vi tilbyr
  • Arbeid på dagtid mellom 0730 - 1500 mandag til fredag + hver 6 søndag
  • Et godt å inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • Forsikring og pensjonsavtaler
  • Lønn etter tariff
  • En godt organisert virksomhet som har fokus på kvalitet og innovasjon
  • Utviklingsmuligheter

 

Vedlagt søknaden legges relevante vitnemål og attester. Vitnemålsportalen skal benyttes for vitnemål som er registrert i denne portalen. Har du utdanning fra utlandet legger du ved godkjenning fra direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse eller NOKUT.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
jobs.description:

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

Senior Marketing Specialist (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Context of the Role

To strengthen our Marketing Team, we are looking for a Senior Marketing Specialist to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, implementing and continuously improving integrated B2B marketing activities that strengthen our market presence, generate qualified leads and support our international business growth. You will develop relevant content and campaigns across digital and offline channels, coordinate marketing initiatives with internal and external stakeholders and ensure consistent communication of our products, services and value proposition.
You will work closely with Product Mangaement, Sales, and futher other internal teams to develop our marketing programs and campaigns, addressing the needs of potential new customers and partners, based on our Product Portfolio as well as Go-To-Market Strategy. You will be instrumental for the further development of our marketing measures, performance measurement and communication standards.
For this position, residency in Germany as well as very good German and English skills, both written and spoken, are required. Occasional travel to trade fairs, conferences, customer events and internal meetings will be also relevant for your success.


Key Tasks

  • Owning our marketing demand generation programs: Planning, implementation, and measuring of integrated B2B marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels
  • Development of ABM-driven campaigns and activities that strengthen brand awareness, generate qualified leads by substantially supporting the achievement our revenue goals
  • Independent management of marketing campaigns and projects, including target groups, timelines, approvals, implementation and follow-up
  • Close cooperation with the Marketing Specialist for communication in the creation and coordination of website content, articles, newsletters, case studies, presentations, campaign materials and sales enablement content
  • Translation of complex software products and technical topics into clear and compelling marketing messages
  • Implementation of targeted marketing activities for specific industries, customer segments, products and business priorities
  • Close collaboration with Sales and Business Development on lead generation, target account activities and customer acquisition
  • Coordination with Product Management and our service teams regarding product developments, customer use cases and market requirements
  • Planning and coordination of trade fairs, conferences, webinars, customer events and related communication activities
  • Coordination of external agencies and service providers, including briefing, quality assurance and timeline management
  • Monitoring of marketing performance and preparation of KPI-based reports and improvement recommendations
  • Leading the lead management, lead nurturing and marketing automation processes
  • Market, competitor and target group research, as well as continuous improvement of marketing processes, tools and reporting structures


Required Skills

  • Several years of professional experience in B2B marketing, digital marketing, content marketing, campaign management or product marketing
  • Proven experience in independently planning, implementing and evaluating integrated marketing campaigns
  • Understanding of the structure and the approach on realizing Accout-Based-Marketing Programs
  • Experience in marketing activities that support lead generation, customer acquisition and business growth
  • Strong content development and copywriting skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly
  • Experience in marketing software products, IT solutions or consulting services, ideally in an international B2B environment
  • Industry experience in Energy, Chemicals, logistics or industrial software is an advantage
  • Strong understanding of websites, email marketing, social media, online campaigns and marketing automation
  • Experience in developing customer-focused content, campaign materials and sales enablement materials
  • Experience collaborating with Sales and Business Development on lead generation and growth initiatives
  • Ability to translate business priorities, market requirements and customer needs into effective marketing activities
  • Experience in marketing analytics, campaign performance measurement and KPI-based reporting
  • Confidence in working with CRM, content management, email marketing and analytics systems
  • Strong project management, organisational and stakeholder management skills
  • A structured, reliable and results-oriented approach, with high ownership and attention to detail
  • Very good German and English skills, willingness to travel occasionally and a relevant degree or comparable qualification
 
Note:
This is not an entry-level position. We therefore particularly welcome applications from candidates with at least five years of relevant professional experience in B2B marketing, digital marketing, content marketing, campaign management, product marketing or a comparable role. We also explicitly encourage people aged 50+ to apply!


Why us?

We offer a modern working environment where initiative, professional development and teamwork are highly valued:

  • Hybrid working and the option to work remotely, including temporary mobile working from abroad
  • Working time account to support a healthy work-life balance
  • 30 days of annual leave
  • An integrated career and development system with transparent perspectives
  • Professional development and continuous learning are important to us and are actively supported
  • JobRad: configure your JobRad, or even more than one
  • Team and company events that strengthen our open and collaborative culture
  • An international working environment with colleagues, customers and partners worldwide
  • A Works Council that provides advice and support
  • A growing global team and an innovative product environment
  • The opportunity to actively shape our market presence, marketing activities and future growth
The salary range for this position is 70.000 € to 90.000 € gross per year on a full-time basis. The specific classification within the salary range is based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, particularly relevant professional experience, qualifications and competencies.
In addition to the base salary, the position may include a variable compensation component based on clearly defined and measurable individual and company-related objectives. The specific compensation model will be communicated transparently during the recruitment process.
Does this sound like your next challenge? We look forward to getting to know you!
If you would like to use your marketing experience to strengthen our market presence, develop effective B2B campaigns and contribute directly to our international growth, you have come to the right place.

About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective, changing how autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. This gives our operators a decisive edge in highly contested environments. As threats rise, STARK is strengthening the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe.

Du wirst Teil unseres Teams an der Schnittstelle zwischen internationalem Handel, Exportkontrolle und dem operativen Tagesgeschäft bei STARK. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus verschiedenen Bereichen wie Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik zusammen. Von Anfang an arbeitest du an realen Fällen und sammelst praktische Erfahrung in einem schnelllebigen internationalen Umfeld.


Your mission

Als Werkstudent im Bereich Exportkontrolle unterstützt du uns dabei, nationale und internationale Exportkontrollvorgaben zuverlässig in unsere täglichen Geschäftsprozesse zu integrieren.

Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachabteilungen wie Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik zusammen und unterstützt bei konkreten Fragestellungen rund um Exportgenehmigungen, Sanktionen, Güterklassifizierungen und länderbezogene Restriktionen.

Dabei erhältst du direkten Einblick in reale Fälle des internationalen Handels- und Exportkontrollrechts und kannst dein theoretisches Wissen unmittelbar in der Praxis anwenden.


Responsibilities

  • Du beantwortest tägliche Fragen aus Fachabteilungen, zum Beispiel Vertrieb, Einkauf und Logistik, zu exportkontrollrelevanten Abläufen und Prüfschritten.

  • Vor geplanten Exporten führst du Recherchen zu Exportgenehmigungen, Sanktionen, Güterklassifizierungen und länderbezogenen Restriktionen durch.
  • Du analysierst und dokumentierst vergangene Ausfuhr- und Zolldaten zur Risikoanalyse und zur Vorbereitung interner und externer Audits.

Qualifications

  • Du bist immatrikulierter Student (all genders) im Bereich Wirtschaftsrecht, Rechtswissenschaften, BWL, Logistik, International Business oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes Verständnis oder starkes Interesse am deutschen und europäischen Exportkontrollrecht, insbesondere AWG/AWV und der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung.
  • Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Regelungen verständlich zu vermitteln und deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen lösungsorientiert zu unterstützen.
  • Du arbeitest sehr sorgfältig, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich.
  • Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Exportkontrolle, Zoll, Compliance oder Außenwirtschaft, zum Beispiel durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten

jobs.title: Working Student – Hardware Engineering (UAS Propulsion & Power) (all genders)
jobs.description:
About Us

STARK is a European defence technology company building the next generation of unmanned systems. We
design, develop and manufacture software-defined, mass-scalable and cost-effective platforms that give
NATO operators a decisive edge in highly contested environments. We are focused on delivering
deployable, high-performance capability — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, our work
strengthens the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners.


Your mission

Your mission is to work hands-on with the parts of the aircraft that turn stored energy into flight: the
motors, the batteries, and the propulsion and power components that decide how far, how fast, and how
long our platforms fly. You support the hardware team from bench characterisation through data analysis
in MATLAB and Python.

You aren't just swapping components on a bench; you are helping generate the measured evidence that
decides what actually flies — and learning how unmanned hardware is designed, tested, and pushed to its
limits.


Responsibilities

● Support characterisation and bench testing of motors, propellers, batteries, and power
components for our UAS platforms.
● Help set up test rigs and instrumentation, and capture clean, repeatable measurement data.
● Assist with component selection and trade-offs by turning test data into clear comparisons.
● Reduce and analyse test data in MATLAB and Python — efficiency, thrust, endurance, thermal and
discharge behaviour.
● Visualise results so the engineering team can make decisions from them quickly.
● Keep test setups, measurements, and findings documented and traceable.


Qualifications

● Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, or a comparable
engineering field.
● Working knowledge of MATLAB and Python for data analysis.
● Interest in and some exposure to UAS, electric propulsion (motors / ESCs), or battery / power
systems.
● Must be a citizen of a NATO member state (due to export control and security regulations).
● Practical, hands-on mindset — comfortable at the bench and with a multimeter as much as in a
script.
● Good written and verbal communication skills in English; German is a plus
● Hands-on: You like building, measuring, and finding out what really happens.
● Rigorous: You trust clean measurements over assumptions.
● Curious: You want to understand why a component behaves the way it does.


Nice to have

● Experience with test benches, DAQ, or measurement instrumentation.
● Familiarity with battery testing, thermal behaviour, or motor/propeller characterisation.
● Personal projects with drones, RC aircraft, batteries, or robotics

jobs.title: Tactical Data Link Expert (all genders)
jobs.description:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.
We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems—not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe—today.


About the team

Minerva is STARK's command and control software — the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Minerva team is a small, senior software group based in Berlin and Munich, working directly with our systems and hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities deployed in active operational environments.
We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter — low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field.


Your mission

Support the development, integration, testing, and operational use of tactical data link capabilities for STARK’s unmanned systems, Ground Control Stations, and wider command-and-control environments. You will help ensure that our systems can communicate reliably and securely with military networks, command posts, allied platforms, and mission systems. A key part of the role is to evaluate, understand, and integrate tactical communication standards and technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military data link solutions. You will translate operational communication requirements into practical integration concepts, test setups, and deployable system configurations.


Responsibilities

Tactical Data Link Integration: Support the integration of tactical data link capabilities such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military communication systems into STARK platforms and Ground Control Station environments.

Interoperability Concepts: Define and support communication concepts that enable reliable data exchange between unmanned systems, GCS setups, command centers, allied platforms, and external mission systems.

Requirements Translation: Translate operational and military communication requirements into technical integration requirements, interface definitions, test needs, and subsystem-level implementation concepts.

System Interface Support: Work with engineering, software, network, RF, modem, antenna, and GCS teams to align interfaces, protocols, data flows, configuration requirements, and integration constraints.

SATCOM & Beyond-Line-of-Sight Support: Support concepts and integration activities for SATCOM, long-range communication paths, and other beyond-line-of-sight connectivity options.

Testing & Validation: Plan and support lab tests, field tests, interoperability checks, and validation activities for tactical data link and communication setups.

Security & Reliability: Contribute to secure, robust, and mission-ready communication architectures, considering availability, latency, data integrity, authentication, and operational constraints.

Supplier & Partner Coordination: Work with external suppliers, partners, military stakeholders, and internal teams to assess data link options, integration dependencies, and technical feasibility.

Documentation: Document data link concepts, interface assumptions, configuration settings, integration dependencies, test results, and recommended operational setups in a clear and maintainable way.


Qualifications

Experience: Around 5 years of professional experience in tactical communications, military data links, SATCOM, RF systems, communication engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical field.

Tactical Data Link Knowledge: Practical understanding of military data link technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, or comparable tactical communication systems.

Systems Understanding: Ability to understand complex communication architectures involving platforms, radios, antennas, modems, networks, command systems, software interfaces, and operational workflows.

Interoperability Mindset: Strong understanding of how different systems exchange data, how interfaces are defined, and how interoperability is tested and validated.

Technical Communication: Ability to translate between operational users, engineering teams, software developers, RF specialists, suppliers, and program stakeholders.

Testing & Documentation: Experience supporting technical tests, integration trials, validation activities, or operational demonstrations, including structured documentation of results and findings.

Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify communication issues, integration gaps, configuration problems, and practical solutions.

Communication: Solid English skills are required. German skills for technical communication, stakeholder alignment, and documentation are a plus.

Team Fit: Ability to work collaboratively in a small, cross-functional team and communicate clearly and reliably in fast-moving engineering environments.

Clearance: Ability to obtain appropriate security clearance required for the position.


Nice to have

 Experience in defence, military communications, command-and-control systems, aerospace, naval systems, UAVs, or other mission-critical operational environments.

· Prior exposure to NATO communication standards, tactical networks, joint fires, air defence, command posts, or battlefield management systems.

· Experience with SATCOM terminals, tactical radios, MANET, IP-based tactical networks, or professional communication equipment.

· Experience integrating unmanned systems into wider military communication architectures.

· Understanding of network security, encryption concepts, authentication, routing, IP networking, and secure data exchange.

We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments.

We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today.


About the team

Our team leads the independent validation and verification of complex software systems, bridging the gap between rigorous architectural requirements and deployed capabilities. We operate at the critical intersection of software development and system safety, ensuring every release meets the highest performance and reliability standards. You will work closely with cross-functional partners in sofware & hardware, and flight operations to maintain technical integrity in a fast-paced environment.


Your mission

As the Software IVV Lead, you will act as the independent software testing and verification authority, ensuring that the standards defined by our architecture are measurably adhered to, rigorously tested, and successfully audited. You will own the strategy, infrastructure, and execution of software validation and verification, serving as the ultimate quality gatekeeper for our software release candidates before they reach hardware integration and testing in the field.


Responsibilities

  • Define the Test Strategy: Establish and enforce the overarching software testing frameworks and QA processes (based on ISTQB) across all software capability teams.

  • Manage Test Infrastructure & Tooling: Oversee the setup and maintenance of software test environments and test data, ensure the qualification of testing tools, and lead the generation of audit-proof, revision-safe test evidence.

  • Oversee V&V Execution: Supervise the validation and verification phases of the V-Model, ensuring rigorous unit, integration, and sub-system-level testing are completed before handing over to the Hardware integration and Flight Testing teams.

  • Ensure Requirements Traceability: Deliver transparency in bidirectional traceability between Software Requirements, architectural design, implementation, and testing. Define and monitor the traceability processes in close collaboration with Software Configuration Management (SCM), ensuring operational compliance.

  • Govern Defect & Deviation Management: Establish and oversee the interfaces and processes for defect, deviation, and problem management, ensuring all findings from testing are systematically tracked, evaluated, and resolved.

  • Enforce Code Quality: Drive the adoption of strict coding standards (like MISRA for C++) using automated static analysis and code coverage metrics.

  • Interface with Configuration Management: Verify compliance with defined SCM processes, auditing baselines, versions, reproducible builds, Software Configuration Indexes, and Release Packages to ensure they meet quality standards.

  • Act as the Quality Gatekeeper: Provide independent quality gate approvals and formal release recommendations for software release candidates via the Engineering Change Request (ECR) process, while recognizing that the ultimate release decision resides with Product/Program Management.

  • Manage Audits: Lead the preparation, execution, and follow-up for all internal software QA assessments and external regulatory audits.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Position description

 
At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Machine Learning Scientist to join our Data & AI team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis engine. You will be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) techniques to the complex domain of source code. Your work will directly shape our products, pushing the boundaries of static analysis to help millions of developers write better, more secure code. If you are driven to solve real-world problems by turning state-of-the-art research into practical, high-impact solutions, this is the role for you.
 

What you will do
  • Spearhead Research & Innovation: Stay on the cutting edge of ML, Deep Learning, and LLMs, specifically their application to the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), and identify novel opportunities to enhance our products.
  • Develop Advanced AI Models: Design, prototype, and validate novel ML models that identify and resolve complex bugs, vulnerabilities, and code smells, going beyond the capabilities of traditional static analysis.
  • Build LLM-Powered Features: Develop and implement advanced LLM-based solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for contextual code analysis, fine-tuning models on proprietary codebases, and exploring agentic systems for automated code remediation.
  • Engineer Data Pipelines: Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale.
  • Translate Prototypes to Products: Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful ML prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base.
  • Communicate and Evangelize: Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Experience and qualifications
  • An advanced academic background (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong industry experience in machine learning, with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices and tools.
  • Solid programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with core ML/DL frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face). Familiarity with Java is a plus.
  • Proven experience in applied Machine Learning, with a strong focus on Natural Language Processing (NLP) or, ideally, Programming Language Processing (PLP).
  • Hands-on experience with modern LLM architectures and techniques, such as Fine-tuning strategies (e.g., LoRA, QLoRA), advanced prompt engineering, building and optimizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and working with vector databases and semantic search
  • Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks and cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS).
  • Experience of driving research projects from initial ideation to a demonstrable prototype with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and a talent for explaining complex scientific topics clearly and concisely.

    •  

    Salary range

    Additional comments

    This role is based in Bochum. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Bochum, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

À propos de nous

E-finances est un éditeur de logiciels B2B spécialisé dans les solutions de gestion financière et de trésorerie. Nos solutions permettent aux entreprises d'optimiser la gestion de leurs flux financiers, d'améliorer leur visibilité sur leur trésorerie et de renforcer leur performance financière.

Nous sommes en pleine phase de modernisation : refonte technique de nos produits historiques, lancement de nouvelles fonctionnalités, montée en puissance de nos stacks. C'est le bon moment pour rejoindre l'aventure et laisser une vraie empreinte sur ce que nous construisons.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Un vrai rôle de bâtisseur. Vous n'arrivez pas sur un projet figé : vous participez activement à la refonte de nos applications et à la définition de la manière dont elles doivent évoluer. Vos idées et votre esprit d'initiative sont attendus, pas seulement votre code.
  • De l'autonomie et de la confiance. Vous travaillez en petite équipe soudée (un Lead Tech, trois développeurs, un Product Owner), avec la liberté d'organiser votre travail et de proposer vos propres solutions techniques.
  • Des perspectives d'évolution concrètes. En rejoignant une équipe en croissance sur un produit stratégique, vous avez l'opportunité de faire grandir vos responsabilités techniques (architecture, mentorat, choix technologiques) au fil du temps.
  • De la flexibilité. Organisation de travail flexible et équilibre vie pro / vie perso respecté, dans un environnement où l'on juge sur les résultats plutôt que sur la présence.
  • Des sujets qui comptent. Modernisation d'un legacy réel (.NET Framework 3.5/4.8 vers .NET 8), dette technique à réduire, nouveaux features à concevoir de zéro : de quoi élargir votre expertise technique en continu.
  • Un process rapide et direct. un premier échange avec notre Lead Tech (en visio), puis une case study en présentiel avec la Directrice d'E-finances.

Vos missions

  • Développer :  concevoir, développer, tester et maintenir des applications en C#.
  • Moderniser :  participer activement à la refonte technique de nos solutions et à la migration vers les technologies récentes.
  • Réduire la dette technique :  contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre codebase et proposer des solutions.
  • Collaborer en agilité :  participer aux rituels agiles (sprints, daily stand-ups, weekly meetings) au sein d'une équipe où la communication est directe et fluide.
  • Garantir la qualité :  assurer la qualité du code via des tests unitaires et les bonnes pratiques de développement.

Compétences principales requises

  • C# :  minimum 4 ans d'expérience.
  • .NET Framework 3.5 / 4.8 à .NET 8 :  maîtrise de ces technologies.
  • ASP.NET (Razor et jQuery) ou React :  expertise dans l'une de ces stacks.
  • SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle :  maîtrise de SQL et expérience avec au moins l'un des trois SGBD.
  • Git :  gestion des versions avec Git, Pull Requests et Code Review.
  • Tests unitaires :  expérience avec les TU pour garantir la qualité du code.
  • Agilité :  connaissance des pratiques agiles et des méthodologies associées.
  • CI/CD.

Profil recherché

  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en développement.
  • Basé(e) à moins d'une heure de Nantes.
  • Français et anglais courants.
  • Esprit d'initiative et mentalité « doer » :  à l'aise pour proposer, tester et itérer plutôt qu'attendre des consignes.
  • Adaptabilité :  capacité à monter rapidement en compétence sur de nouvelles technologies et à comprendre les enjeux métier.
  • Autonomie et goût du collectif :  capable de travailler aussi bien seul qu'en équipe.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en résolution de problèmes.

 

Vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases ? Postulez quand même, nous discutons volontiers de votre profil.

jobs.title: Verzorgende IG met hart voor de zorg!
jobs.description:
Bij Medicalhunt zoeken wij een Verzorgende IG'er die op zoek is naar een veelzijdige, afwisselende baan in de ouderenzorg.

Werkervaring in de functie is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Wel is het belangrijk dat je beschikt over een zorgdiploma van minimaal helpende niveau.

Ben jij een Verzorgende IG die houdt van afwisseling, nieuwe uitdagingen en vrijheid in je werk? Dan hebben wij de baan voor jou!


Als Verzorgende IG via detachering spring jij in bij verschillende zorginstellingen: van verpleeghuizen en thuiszorg tot revalidatiecentra. Geen dag is hetzelfde! Je ondersteunt cliënten met hun dagelijkse zorg, voert verpleegtechnische handelingen uit en zorgt voor een warme en veilige omgeving.

Het is natuurlijk belangrijk om een vertrouwd gezicht te zijn voor de bewoners. Daarom duurt een detachering minimaal 2 tot 3 maanden, maar het kan ook een half jaar of zelfs een jaar zijn. In die tijd draai je volledig mee in het team. Na deze periode ga je door naar een nieuwe, uitdagende opdracht. Je kan kiezen voor afwisseling tussen verschillende doelgroepen, hebt de mogelijkheid om een opdracht te verlengen wanneer deze goed bevalt of je kiest voor een doelgroep die jou het meeste aanspreekt.


Bij Medicalhunt sta je er niet alleen voor: je krijgt een vaste contactpersoon en we bieden je persoonlijke begeleiding en ondersteuning, zodat jij je kunt focussen op wat je het beste doet: zorgen voor anderen!


Wat maakt detacheren nou zo leuk?

Afwisseling: Jij bepaalt waar en wanneer je werkt. Dit geeft je vrijheid in je werk, maar zorgt er ook voor dat je een goede werk-privé balans kan behouden;

Zekerheid: Een arbeidscontract bij ons voor een x aantal uren in de week, mét de flexibiliteit van detachering;

Ontwikkeling: Wij investeren in jouw groei met trainingen en opleidingen;

Teamspirit: Ook al werk je op verschillende locaties, je maak echt deel uit van team Medicalhunt. We staan altijd voor je klaar en zetten jouw werkgeluk op nummer 1!

jobs.title: Experienced Junior Graphic Designer - Scale-up company
jobs.description:

A standard graphic design background is insufficient. The candidate must possess proven experience with pre-press production processes, including vectorizing artwork, Pantone (PMS) color matching, print separations for embroidery and Screen Printing/DTG, and mapping 2D artwork onto complex 3D product surfaces. Furthermore, the candidate must have experience executing designs within strict corporate B2B brand guidelines and working directly with technical specifications from global manufacturers.

About Monday Merch
Monday Merch is a fast-growing B2B merch platform based in Rotterdam. We design, produce, and deliver high-quality, sustainable custom merchandise and corporate gifts for leading global brands and scale-ups.

The Role: Graphic & Visual Designer
We are looking for a talented Graphic & Visual Designer to join our creative team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between creative visual design and physical product execution. You will be responsible for creating compelling visual assets, developing brand identities, and translating complex design concepts into production-ready physical merchandise.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop full visual identity packages, brand guidelines, and high-impact design assets.
Create production-ready vector files and technical specs (tech packs, CMYK/Pantone prepress) for apparel, accessories, and custom packaging.
Lead design projects from initial concept and artwork creation through final supplier handoff.
Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

What We Offer:
A dynamic, international work environment in Rotterdam.
Full-time position (40h/week) with market-competitive remuneration.
Catered team lunches, travel reimbursement, and high-end merch benefits.

Vaste werktijden, tijd voor iedere deelnemer en ruimte voor verdieping geven je werk als onderzoeksarts een helder ritme binnen klinisch medicijnonderzoek. Jouw nieuwe baan
Jouw aandacht gaat uit naar deelnemers aan klinisch medicijnonderzoek. Daarbij informeer je hen als onderzoeksarts helder over deelname, voer je gesprekken en doe je lichamelijk en neurologisch onderzoek.

Er is aandacht voor de inhoud van het onderzoek én voor jouw ontwikkeling. Zo leer je nieuwe onderzoeksvaardigheden en krijg je ruimte om medische handelingen verder te oefenen.

Jij bepaalt hoe onze klant door de shop beweegt. De agents voeren het uit.
Bij Ploonk verkopen we in vijf landen via meerdere webshops. Onze shop maken we vandaag nog grotendeels met de hand: mensen richten pagina's in, zetten filters, koppelen bundels. A Control Systems Engineer is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and support of industrial control and automation systems for large‑scale capital projects. jobs.title: Tips for Candidates
jobs.description:
This document has been put together to help you prepare for your arrival in the Netherlands. You are
going to work in the Netherlands, and so below are some tips to help you prepare as well as possible.
We advise you to ask your future employer as many questions as possible to ensure you are well
prepared when you start work.
Description of the agricultural sector
• Much of the work is done outside, in all kinds of weather (rain and hot sunshine). Ask your
employer for any photos and/or films of the work you will be doing. Tip: search Google and
YouTube for videos / photos of the work involved.
• Work in the agricultural sector is seasonal and depends on the weather. Favourable weather
conditions can boost production within a short space of time. This will result in a lot of work
and you may be able to work more (extra) hours. It's just as likely that, due to the weather,
production levels do not rise as quickly as expected, and that you consequently work fewer
hours than usual. In that case, your employer may give you other work to do.
• Agricultural businesses are often located in remote areas, some distance from the nearest
large town. Facilities and amenities such as a supermarket or train station will often not be
close by.
• Accomodation varies from business to business and will often be located close to the
field/building you are working in. The agricultural businesses provide accommodation for their
workers, and this could be on a campsite, a container home, shed, caravan, house, etc.

jobs.title: Osastonlääkäri Diagnostiikkakeskus Radiologia
jobs.description:
Tervetuloa osastonlääkäriksi HUS Diagnostiikkakeskukseen!

HUS Diagnostiikkakeskus on Suomen johtava kliinisten laboratorio- ja kuvantamispalvelujen tuottaja. Pääasiallinen toiminta-alueemme on HUS-yhtymän erikoissairaanhoito ja HUSiin kuuluvien hyvinvointialueiden perusterveydenhuolto. Vastaamme myös Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialueen ja Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialueen laboratorio- ja kuvantamistoiminnasta.

Toimimme kahdeksalla lääketieteen erikoisalalla. Vastaamme valtakunnallisesti useista erityisosaamista vaativista tutkimuksista sekä yliopistolliselle sairaalalle kuuluvasta tutkimuksesta ja opetuksesta. Diagnostiset tutkimukset ovat keskeisessä roolissa sairauksien varmistamisessa, poissulkemisessa, osana hoitoa sekä hoidon seurannassa ja seulonnassa. HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksessa työskentelee noin 3300 laboratorio- ja kuvantamisalan asiantuntijaa yli 150 toimipisteessä.

Haemme nyt osastonlääkäriä Diagnostiikkakeskukseen, Siltasairaalan päivystysröntgeniin sekä Etelä-Karjalan röntgeniin

Vähintään puolet erikoislääkärin tehtävästä sijoittuu Meilahden Siltasairaalan päivystysröntgeniin, sisältäen radiologin kliinistä työtä yliopistosairaalan yhteispäivystyksen alueella. Tehtävään kuuluu myös Etelä-Karjalan röntgenin päivystyskuvantamisen kehittämiseen osallistuminen ja osa kliinisestä työajasta kohdentuu Etelä-Karjalan keskussairaalan röntgeniin, Lappeenrantaan.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä ammatissasi nykyaikaisen teknologian parissa ja mukavassa työyhteisössä. Yksiköissämme teemme monipuolisesti päivystysradiologisia tutkimuksia ja toimenpiteitä. Etelä-Karjalan keskussairaalassa työnkuvaan kuuluu myös monipuolista yleisradiologista kuvantamista. Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää radiologian erikoislääkärin pätevyyttä ja hakijalla tulee olla ajantasainen ja monipuolinen osaaminen eri modaliteeteista. Virkaan valittavalla tulee olla suoritettuna päivystys- ja traumaradiologian lisäkoulutus.

Työhön liittyy lääketieteen opiskelijoiden sekä erikoistuvien lääkärien koulutusvelvollisuus.

Radiologialla on päivystysvelvollisuus. Erikseen sovittaessa osittainen etätyöskentely on mahdollista.

Osastonlääkärin tehtäväkohtainen palkka maksetaan lääkärisopimuksen (LS) ja HUS uraporrasjärjestelmän mukaan, tällä hetkellä palkka on alkaen 6443,01 €/kk (uraportaalla 2A) ja mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät. Radiologialla on myös käytössä suoritepalkkiojärjestelmä.

Työn aloitus on 1.11.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Haethan tehtävää mahdollisimman pian, viimeistään 28.9.2026. Hakijoita voidaan kutsua haastateltavaksi jo hakuaikana.

Tervetuloa työkaveriksemme Diagnostiikkakeskukseen!

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Erikoislääkärin pätevyys soveltuvalla erikoisalalla ja lisäksi laillistettu lääkäri tai lupa toimia lääkärin tehtävissä. Suoritettu lisäkoulutusohjelma päivystys- ja traumakuvantamisesta.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on suomen kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja ruotsin kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito taikka ruotsin kielen hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ja suomen kielen tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

jobs.title: Erikoislääkäri urologia
jobs.description:
Haemme HUS Vatsakeskukseen Urologian linjalle erikoislääkäriä!

HUS Urologian yksiköt toimivat Meilahden, Peijaksen, Hyvinkää, Lohjan ja Porvoon sairaaloissa. HUS Urologialla hoidamme miesten ja naisten munuaisten ja virtsateiden sekä miesten sukuelinten sairauksia HUS alueella ja keskitettyjen hoitojen osalta erityisvastuualueeltamme sekä tiettyjen potilasryhmien osalta myös valtakunnallisesti. Teemme urologisten potilaiden diagnostiikkaa ja hoidamme potilaitamme leikkauksilla ja lääkkeellisesti. Teemme aktiivisesti tutkimusta ja kehitämme diagnostiikkaa ja eri hoitomuotoja.

Meillä on yli 70 000 polikliinistä potilaskontaktia vuosittain ja suoritamme noin 5200 leikkausta. Toimintaamme ohjaavat potilaslähtöisyys, yhdenvertaisuus sekä tutkimukseen pohjaava näyttö hoitojen valinnassa. Käytössämme on nykyaikainen huipputeknologia ja kehitämme hoitoprosessejamme jatkuvasti potilaidemme eduksi.

Työntekijöillemme tarjoamme mahdollisuudet tehdä vaikuttavaa työtä asiantuntijana, hyvät kehittymismahdollisuudet sekä osaavan ja mukavan työporukan. Olemme EBU:n (European Board of Urology) sertifioima urologian koulutuskeskus.

Haemme HUS Urologialle yhtä (1) erikoislääkäriä. Virkaan edellytetään hyvää kliinistä kokemusta ja perehtyneisyyttä urologiaan sekä kokemusta lääketieteellisestä tutkimuksesta. Eduksi katsotaan perehtyneisyys urologisten syöpätautien diagnostiikkaan ja hoitoon. Valittavan erikoislääkärin edellytetään osallistuvan penissyövän hoidon kehittämiseen. Kirurgian osaaminen tasolla, joka mahdollistaa myös penissyöpäleikkauksien tekniikan opettamisen katsotaan hakijalle hyödyksi. Valmius mini-invasiivisten hoitomuotojen kehittämiseen penissyövän hoidossa kuuluu valittavan erikoislääkärin työnkuvaan. Valittava erikoislääkäri toimii moniammatillisessa uro-onkologisessa työryhmässä vastaten osaltaan penissyövän hoidosta. Aktiivinen osallistuminen Urologian linjan tutkimushankkeisiin ja potilaiden hoitoprosessien kehittämiseen sekä hyvät yhteistyö- ja työyhteisötaidot ovat hakijalle eduksi. Hakijan tulee olla kiinnostunut kehittämään urologisen poliklinikan toimintaa moniammatillisessa ympäristössä. Kokemus opetustyöstä katsotaan hakijalle eduksi.

Virkaan valittava tulee toimimaan perehtyneisyytensä mukaisessa hoitotiimissä Meilahden ja Peijaksen sairaaloissa, mutta mahdollisten palveluverkkomuutosten vuoksi pääasiallinen toimipiste voi olla jatkossa muukin HUS sairaala tai toimipiste.
