jobs.title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & RECRUITMENT MANAGER
jobs.description:
TALENT&PARTNER

Vi rekryterar Executives, Digital & Sales Specialists & Engineers. Med över 20 års erfarenhet och 1 100 utförda rekryteringar. Med bas i Stockholm rekryterar vi över hela Sverige, Norden, UK och Europa. Våra kunder – från små, nystartade företag till globala koncerner.cVi headhuntar högt presterande talanger och matchar dem med världens mest attraktiva arbetsplatser. Digitala rekryteringar ligger i hjärtat av vårt bolag och utgör fortsatt vårt dominerande fokus. Vi arbetar uteslutande med högt presterande individer. Det är det som gör oss till en av Sveriges marknadsledande rekryteringsbyråer.

Är du riktigt bra på att sälja, skapa förtroende och få kunder att vilja stanna kvar?

Då kan vi lära dig rekrytering.

Talent&Partner söker en affärsdriven relationsbyggare som vill kombinera försäljning och affärsutveckling med rekrytering och headhunting. Det här är inte i första hand en traditionell rekryterarroll. Vi söker framför allt dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av B2B försäljning och som vet hur man öppnar dörrar, skapar affärer, bygger förtroende hos beslutsfattare och utvecklar kunder över tid. Du kan komma från exempelvis tech, SaaS, media, konsultbranschen, professional services eller någon annan B2B verksamhet där försäljning bygger på relationer och förtroende.

Har du arbetat med rekrytering tidigare är det förstås ett plus. Men det är inget krav.

Försäljning är svårare att lära ut. Rekrytering, search och headhunting kan vi lära dig.

OM ROLLEN

Hos oss får du arbeta med hela affären. Från att identifiera en potentiell kund och skapa den första kontakten till att förstå rekryteringsbehovet, vinna uppdraget, hitta rätt kandidat och utveckla kunden till en långsiktig relation. Du kommer att ha direktkontakt med VD:ar, grundare, försäljningschefer, marknadschefer och andra seniora beslutsfattare. Din uppgift är inte bara att sälja en rekrytering. Din uppgift är att bygga kunder som vill arbeta med oss igen.

DU KOMMER BLAND ANNAT ATT

Skapa nya kundrelationer och bygga din egen kundportfölj

Bearbeta nya, tidigare och befintliga kunder

Identifiera rekryteringsbehov och nya affärsmöjligheter

Boka och genomföra kundmöten

Presentera Talent&Partner och vårt arbetssätt

Ta fram offerter och avtal och stänga nya rekryteringsuppdrag

Utveckla befintliga kunder och skapa återkommande affärer

Ansvara för relationen från första kontakt till genomförd rekrytering och uppföljning

Parallellt lär du dig att självständigt driva professionella rekryteringsprocesser från kravprofil till signerad kandidat.

FRÅN SALES TILL SEARCH

Att hitta en riktigt bra kund och att hitta en riktigt bra kandidat har mer gemensamt än man kanske tror. Båda kräver nyfikenhet, uthållighet, affärsmässighet, fingertoppskänsla och förmågan att skapa intresse hos någon som kanske inte ens letade efter det du erbjuder när du först tog kontakt.

Hos oss lär du dig att:

Förstå kundens verksamhet, utmaningar och rekryteringsbehov

Kartlägga marknader och identifiera relevanta kandidater

Searcha och headhunta personer som inte aktivt söker nytt jobb

Genomföra intervjuer och bedöma kompetens, erfarenhet, motivation och matchning

Presentera de bästa kandidaterna för kunden

Driva kund och kandidatdialogen genom hela processen

Hantera intervjuer, uppföljning, erbjudande och förhandling

Följa processen hela vägen till signering

På sikt kan du alltså äga hela kedjan från första säljsamtalet till att kunden välkomnar sin nya kollega.

VEM ÄR DU?

Din exakta branschbakgrund är mindre viktig än din kommersiella erfarenhet.

Vi tror däremot att du har flera års erfarenhet av B2B försäljning och kan visa att du själv har skapat affärer.

Du är bekväm med att kontakta nya kunder och prata med seniora beslutsfattare. Du kan lyfta telefonen, öppna en relation, förstå ett behov och faktiskt be om affären.

Samtidigt förstår du att en signerad affär bara är början.

Den riktigt bra affären är kunden som kommer tillbaka. Igen. Och igen.

Vi tror att du:

Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av B2B försäljning

Är van vid nykundsbearbetning och att själv skapa affärsmöjligheter

Tycker lika mycket om att utveckla befintliga kunder som att vinna nya

Är affärsmässig och naturligt relationsskapande

Har lätt för att skapa förtroende hos seniora beslutsfattare

Är nyfiken på människor, företag och olika branscher

Tar stort eget ansvar och ser till att saker faktiskt blir gjorda

Trivs med högt tempo och många parallella kontaktytor

Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska

DU BEHÖVER INTE VARA REKRYTERARE

Har du erfarenhet av rekrytering eller executive search är det förstås meriterande.

Men för rätt säljare är det inte ett krav.

Vi kan lära dig searchmetodik, headhunting, intervjuteknik, kandidatbedömning, rekryteringsprocesser och våra verktyg och system.

Det vi däremot vill att du tar med dig från dag ett är din kommersiella erfarenhet, ditt driv och din förmåga att skapa och utveckla kundrelationer.

FRIHET UNDER ANSVAR

Rollen är på heltid och innebär stor frihet och stort eget ansvar.

Det finns möjlighet att arbeta 100 procent remote och du har stor frihet att planera din egen arbetsdag, så länge kunder, kandidater, deadlines och åtaganden hanteras med den kvalitet och det tempo vi förväntar oss.

Vi bryr oss om resultat, relationer och kvalitet.

Vi bryr oss betydligt mindre om var du är eller hur du ser ut när du levererar dem (mysbyxor till kavajen).

DIN UTVECKLING HOS OSS

Vi tror inte på att människor ska stå still i en roll.

Du börjar med det du redan är riktigt bra på och bygger sedan vidare därifrån.

För en stark säljare innebär det att du successivt lär dig hela rekryterings och headhuntingaffären och blir allt mer självgående i att både vinna och leverera uppdrag.

Med resultat kommer också större ansvar och större möjligheter.

Det kan innebära större och mer strategiska kunder, seniorare rekryteringsuppdrag, executive search, ett bredare affärsansvar och en allt mer central kommersiell roll i Talent&Partners fortsatta utveckling. Hur långt rollen utvecklas beror mycket på dig, dina ambitioner och vad du vill bygga tillsammans med oss.

ANSÖKAN

Skicka din ansökan idag via sabine.andersdotter@talentpartner.se. Den får gärna innehålla en motivering till varför just du passar i rollen samt din cv förstås. Se mer om oss på vår site www.talentpartner.se

jobs.title: Researcher in Solar Physics
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Researcher position at the Rosseland Centre for Solar Physics (RoCS) at the Institute of Theoretical Astrophysics (ITA).

The position is for a period of 2 years.

Starting date is flexible between 1st of January 2027 and 1st of October 2027.

Place of work is Rosseland Centre for Solar Physics, Institute of Theoretical Astrophysics at Blindern, Oslo.


Project description

The position is funded by the Research Council of Norway through the Researcher Project for Early Career Scientists (FRIPRO) “MultiSCORE: Multi-scale structure of the coronal environment” and led by Petra Kohutova. The MultiSCORE project focuses on the formation of large- and small-scale structure in the solar corona and combines high-resolution solar observations with numerical modelling. The successful candidate will contribute to the observational aspect of the project using multi-vantage-point observations of the solar corona from Solar Orbiter and the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO). The candidate will work on the analysis of fine-scale structure in the corona using Solar Orbiter/EUI imaging and SPICE spectroscopic data, and on reconstruction of three-dimensional structure of active regions by combining multi-vantage-point Solar Orbiter and SDO/AIA observations with constraints from magnetic field extrapolations. Observational results will be compared with synthetic observables from numerical models. The candidate will be expected to participate in the dissemination of the research results through journal publications and conference presentations in Solar Physics and Astrophysics as well as through outreach activities.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe's leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Solar Physics, Astrophysics, or a closely related field. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and completed defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 
  • Experience with Solar Orbiter data analysis
  • Programming skills in Python/IDL/Julia

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience with scaling and intermittency analysis techniques applied to solar or space plasma observations and/or simulations is an advantage
  • Experience with coronal magnetic field extrapolation methods is an advantage
     

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 595 000 - 690 000 depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

We especially encourage women to apply.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • A short (1-2 page) research statement describing how the applicant’s expertise fits the project objectives and what additional ideas or research directions they could bring to the project
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of educational certificates and academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

Please see Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

The Rosseland Centre for Solar Physics is situated at the Institute of Theoretical Astrophysics, the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral fellow in Structural studies of mitochondrial DNA replication
jobs.description:
This postdoctoral position is part of a research project funded by a Wallenberg Scholar grant. The postdoctoral researcher will work in an interdisciplinary team with expertise in molecular biology, biochemistry and structural biology. The project aims to understand the molecular mechanisms that govern mitochondrial DNA replication and gene expression, and how defects in these processes contribute to human disease.



Subject area

Structural studies of mitochondrial DNA replication



Subject area description

Mitochondrial DNA replication is essential for maintaining mtDNA integrity and stability and thereby for normal mitochondrial function and cellular energy production. Defects in the replication process can lead to mtDNA depletion or deletions and cause mitochondrial disease.

Our research aims to understand the molecular mechanisms that govern replication of human mtDNA. We combine structural biology, in vitro biochemistry and cell biology to investigate how the mitochondrial DNA replication machinery is organized and regulated. A particular focus is on structural and functional studies of the protein complexes involved in mtDNA replication and on understanding how disease-associated mutations affect these processes.



Job assignments

In this project, In this project, the postdoctoral researcher will carry out structural and functional studies of protein and protein-DNA complexes involved in mitochondrial DNA replication. A central aim will be to determine structures of replication complexes using single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) and use these structures to understand how the proteins interact and regulate mtDNA replication at the molecular level.

The work will include preparation and biochemical characterization of protein complexes, cryo-EM sample preparation and grid optimization, as well as processing and structural analysis of cryo-EM data. Structural findings will be combined with in vitro biochemical analyses to test mechanistic models and investigate how disease-associated mutations affect the function of the replication machinery.

The postdoctoral researcher is expected to drive the project independently while working closely with other members of the research group and our collaborators.



Eligibility

The eligibility criteria for employing teaching staff are set out in Chapter 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance and in the Appointment Procedure for Teaching Posts at the University of Gothenburg.

To be eligible for appointment as a postdoc, the applicant is required to have a doctoral degree, a doctoral degree in art or a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree. This eligibility requirement must be met before the employment decision is made.

In the first instance, those who have completed their degree no more than three years prior to the end of the application period shall be considered. Those who have completed their degree more than three years prior to the end of the application period may also be considered in the first instance if special grounds exist. Special grounds relate to leave of absence due to illness, parental leave, commissions of trust within union organisations, service within the defence services or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or service/assignment relevant to the subject area.



Assessment criteria

We are seeking a highly motivated researcher with a doctoral degree in structural biology, biochemistry, molecular biology or a related field.

Documented experience in structural studies of proteins or macromolecular complexes using cryo-electron microscopy is required. Experience in protein purification and protein biochemistry is also required.

Experience in single-particle cryo-EM, including sample preparation, grid optimization, data processing and structural analysis, is particularly meritorious. Experience in structural studies of protein-DNA complexes is a strong advantage. Knowledge of mitochondrial systems and experience in cloning, mutagenesis, protein expression, cell culture and in vitro biochemical analyses are considered merits.

Great emphasis will be placed on scientific skills and the ability to independently plan, carry out and analyse research. The work involves close collaboration both within and outside the research group, making good teamwork and communication skills important. The candidate is expected to have strong scientific curiosity and the ability to work both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team.

Excellent spoken and written English is required, as the research group operates in an international environment.



Regulations for the evaluation of qualifications for academic positions are given in Chapter 4, Section 3 - 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance.



Employment

The employment is full time and temporary, two years with the possibility of one year's extension, with placement at the Institute of Biomedicine. First day of employment as agreed.



Contact information

Please contact: Maria Falkenberg, Professor, e-mail: maria.falkenberg@medkem.gu.se.



Unions

Union representatives at the University of Gothenburg can be found here: https://www.gu.se/en/work-at-the-university-of-gothenburg/how-to-apply-for-a-position#collective-agreement-and-union-representatives





Application

Submit your application via the University of Gothenburg’s recruitment portal by clicking the “Apply” button. It is your responsibility to ensure that the application is complete as per the vacancy notice, and that the University receives it by the final application deadline.  

The application should contain:



- A cover letter giving a brief description of previous research experience, and a motivation to why you are applying



- A CV including a list of publications



- Contact details of two references



- Proof of completed PhD



Applications must be received by: 2026-10-02.



Information for International Applicants

Choosing a career in a foreign country is a big step. Thus, to give you a general idea of what we and Gothenburg have to offer in terms of benefits and life in general for you and your family/spouse/partner please visit:

https://www.gu.se/en/about-the-university/welcome-services

jobs.title: Säljare Västerås
jobs.description:
Riddermark Bil är Sveriges största och snabbast växande marknadsplats för begagnade bilar. Idag består bolaget av ca 600 medarbetare i Sverige. Här är gemenskap, en familjär atmosfär och möjligheten till personlig utveckling viktiga delar trots bolagets storlek. Nu utökar vi vårt säljteam ytterligare och söker därför drivna lagspelare till vår butik i Västerås.

Om dig
Vi söker personer med specifika attityder och egenskaper, samt med en tidigare framgångsrik bakgrund inom försäljning. Gillar du förändring och triggas av utmaningar? Är du ständigt nyfiken och beredd att göra det lilla extra? Älskar du kundkontakt och brinner för den magi som uppstår vid en god försäljning? Då kan du vara rätt medarbetare för oss – och vi arbetsplatsen för dig. Vi gillar mångfald och ser gärna att fler tjejer söker våra tjänster.

Att sälja hos oss
Är enkelt. Har du ett högt engagemang, lyhördhet, ett starkt intresse och mod? Bilförsäljning hos oss är modernt och kundfokuserat och affärerna görs lika enkelt och snabbt som noggrant och personligt. I rollen som bilförsäljare på Riddermark Bil arbetar du med bilaffärens alla steg, från första kundkontakt och provkörning till leverans och eftervård. Riddermark Bil har Sveriges största utbud av begagnade bilar. Därför blir förmågan att kunna göra en relevant behovsanalys och snabbt skapa en relation med kunden avgörande. Som säljare hos oss jobbar du i team om 5–8 personer med en gruppchef som har till uppgift att leda gruppen mot tydliga gemensamma mål.


Urval sker löpande och vi behöver din ansökan så snart som möjligt.





Vi är idag ca 600 anställda fördelade på 14 butiker, ett logistikcenter och ett huvudkontor. Trots vår storlek beskrivs vi ofta som ett mindre familjebolag, här får du vara med och påverka och hjälpa till att hela tiden driva vår tillväxt i rätt riktning med fler och nöjdare kunder. Riddermark bil är ett utav Sveriges mest expansiva företag, den självklara marknadsplatsen för begagnade bilar. Stolt leder vi utvecklingen inom försäljning och avyttring av begagnade bilar genom lagarbete, nytänkande och lyhördhet. Med flera stora anläggningar i Sverige hjälper vi privatpersoner och företag med sina bilaffärer. Vi bygger och utvecklar egna IT-system om vi helt enkelt anser att det saknas tillräckligt bra sådana, och varje dag strävar vi efter att göra allting lite bättre. Våra medarbetare rekryteras främst för sina värderingar.

jobs.description:
WeStaff Sweden söker nu en noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten produktionsmedarbetare till en högteknologisk industriverksamhet i norra Stockholm.

Företaget är en internationell aktör inom avancerad teknisk utrustning med kunder över hela världen. Här arbetar du i en modern och tekniskt avancerad produktionsmiljö där precision, kvalitet och noggrannhet står i fokus.

Till gruppen inom företagets optikverksamhet söker vi nu en ny kollega. Du behöver inte ha tidigare erfarenhet av optik: du får upplärning på plats och lär dig arbetssätt, produkter och kvalitetskrav från grunden.

Om rollen

I rollen arbetar du med optiska komponenter i ett av produktionens slutsteg. En stor del av arbetet består av avsyning och kvalitetskontroll av linser och andra detaljer.

Du arbetar bland annat med mikroskop för att noggrant kontrollera komponenterna och identifiera eventuella repor, partiklar, skador eller andra avvikelser. Arbetet kräver koncentration och ett gott öga för detaljer.

Det förekommer även praktiska moment och viss fysisk hantering, exempelvis arbete med större linser eller moment i anslutning till maskiner. Du kommer bland annat att:

    

Arbeta med avsyning och kvalitetskontroll av linser och andra optiska komponenter

    

Använda mikroskop för att granska detaljer och identifiera eventuella avvikelser

    

Kontrollera komponenter utifrån tydliga kvalitetskrav och instruktioner

    

Hantera och sortera detaljer genom olika produktionsmoment

    

Dokumentera och rapportera avvikelser

    

Utföra enklare praktiska moment i samband med maskinarbete

    

Hantera både mindre och större komponenter

    

Säkerställa att arbetet utförs enligt gällande rutiner och kvalitetskrav

Rollen passar dig som tycker om noggrant och praktiskt arbete och som trivs med att arbeta koncentrerat med detaljer.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är noggrann, ansvarstagande och har lätt för att följa instruktioner. Du behöver inte ha en specifik utbildning eller tidigare erfarenhet av optik: det viktigaste är att du har rätt inställning och vill lära dig. Vi ser gärna att du har:

    

Erfarenhet från produktion, industri, montering, lager, verkstad eller liknande

    

Vana av att arbeta praktiskt och noggrant

    

God koncentrationsförmåga och ett öga för detaljer

    

God finmotorik

    

Förmåga att arbeta metodiskt och följa instruktioner

    

Intresse för teknik och praktiskt arbete

    

Grundläggande datavana

    

God svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Erfarenhet av avsyning, kvalitetskontroll, renrumsmiljö, mikroskoparbete, finmekanik eller optik är meriterande men inget krav.

Som person

Du är noggrann, tålmodig och kvalitetsmedveten. Du har lätt för att fokusera på detaljer och förstår vikten av att upptäcka även små avvikelser.

Du är en person som gärna arbetar strukturerat och metodiskt och som inte har något emot att arbetet ibland är repetitivt. Samtidigt uppskattar du praktiska moment och variation under arbetsdagen.

Det är viktigt att du är prestigelös, hjälpsam och trivs med att samarbeta. Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och bidrar gärna till en positiv arbetsmiljö.

Framför allt söker vi dig som är nyfiken och vill lära dig något nytt. Du behöver inte kunna optik idag: rätt inställning och noggrannhet kommer långt.

Övrigt

    

Start: Omgående enligt överenskommelse

    

Omfattning: Heltid, långsiktigt uppdrag

    

Arbetstid: Dagtid

    

Placering: Norra Stockholm

Vi erbjuder dig

Som anställd hos oss på WeStaff Sweden AB erbjuder vi en trygg anställning med kollektivavtal och ett närvarande engagemang.

Du får möjlighet att komma in i en högteknologisk och internationell verksamhet där du får lära dig mer om optik, finmekanik och avancerad produktion.

Din nya arbetsgivare

WeStaff Sweden AB är ett växande konsult- och rekryteringsföretag inom Produktion & Tillverkning. Våra värderingar bygger på personlig relation, trygghet och långsiktighet.

Vi är ett kunskapsdrivet team med över 30 års samlad erfarenhet från branschen. Vårt arbete kännetecknas av kvalitet, nytänkande och ett personligt engagemang. Läs mer om oss på www.westaff.se

Vill du bli en del av oss? Ansök redan idag och bli vår nästa medarbetare!

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer to Sergel Group
jobs.description:
Sergel Group is one of the leading providers of credit management services in the Nordic region. We offer services within credit scoring, debt collection, debt purchasing, as well as messaging and payment solutions. Sergel is part of Marginalen Group and has just over 150 employees across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.

About the role

Sergel is on an exciting journey to strengthen its inhouse capabilities, bringing more competence and ownership closer to the business. This means several ongoing development areas and new projects where data plays a central role, and the people who work with it are central to Sergel's ability to compete and grow across the Nordic market.

In this role you will drive the development of scalable, efficient and compliant data solutions, with a strong focus on operational excellence and exploring new opportunities for innovation. You will have significant autonomy and a broad mandate to influence technical direction, make key decisions and ensure they are executed with real impact. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a natural drive to take ownership and move things forward. Over time, you are motivated by the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and a more leading position within the area.

Your responsibilities will include:

    

Defining and enforcing data modeling standards, best practices and governance policies.

    

Designing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and optimizing ETL processes.

    

Building and maintaining applications and integrations for data ingestion, transformation and delivery.

    

Driving the shift from external-dependent delivery toward strong in-house capability.

    

Setting the technical direction and owning key architectural decisions.

    

Ensuring that BI is an integral part of the data platform, enabling trusted reporting, analytics and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Qualifications and experience

You are someone who combines deep technical expertise with a natural drive to take ownership. You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders and thrive in environments where you can shape and improve things rather than just maintain them.

You enjoy working closely with others, sharing knowledge and helping the team grow through collaboration, curiosity and mutual respect. You are humble enough to listen and confident enough to challenge when needed.

You also bring:

    

Solid experience as a data engineer and experience with designing, modeling and implementing data-intensive systems.

    

Strong proficiency in SQL and C# .NET/Python.

    

Experience with ETL tools, data pipeline frameworks and orchestration tools.

    

Understanding of CI/CD principles.

    

Knowledge of data governance, GDPR compliance and security best practices.

    

The ability to drive technical decisions and set standards.

    

Fluency in English.

    

Valid work permit.

You don't need to be senior in every area listed above, if you bring strong fundamentals and the right mindset, there is room to develop and grow into the full scope of the role.

Meriting experience:

    

Experience from financial services, credit or similar data-intensive industries.

    

Knowledge in one of the nordic languages.

    

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.

About the company

In Sergel we care about the people we meet. We are a company with a culture based on trust and learning, where we work towards strengthening individuals through competence, compassion and a high level of engagement. Together we work with clear ownership and shared responsibility towards our stakeholders, which creates long-term and loyal business relations. We always try to find new ways of working and challenging the market. We want our employees to develop with the company and have fun with their colleagues on the way.

Additional information

    

Start: By agreement

    

Location: Central Stockholm

    

Extent: Full-time

    

Salary: By agreement

We apply ongoing selection in this recruitment process, which means the position may be filled before the final application date. We therefore recommend submitting your application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions regarding Asta Agency’s recruitment process, please do not hesitate to contact us at alice@astaagency.se.

About Asta Agency

Asta Agency is a recruitment and staffing company helping businesses across Sweden find the right professionals, with a primary focus on Stockholm, Gothenburg, and Malmö.

We recruit and provide consultants within sales, marketing, HR, customer service, finance, administration, IT, and tech – both specialists and generalists. With a strong focus on quality, long-term partnerships, and smart solutions, we support both companies and candidates in taking the next step.

Learn more about how we work with recruitment, staffing, and temp-to-perm solutions at astaagency.se.

jobs.title: Lead Risk Model Specialist
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will take a key role in strengthening transaction monitoring models within a large Nordic banking environment. The focus is on financial crime prevention, where robust model development, validation, and governance are critical to how suspicious activity is identified and managed.

In this role, you combine analytical depth with practical judgment. You will help set the direction for model design, validation, and governance within the Transaction Monitoring Unit, while working closely with analytics specialists and stakeholders across the organisation. The role suits you if you enjoy turning complex quantitative work into clear, well-documented, and well-governed models that stand up to scrutiny.

It is an exciting opportunity to influence how model governance evolves in an important AML context with both strategic and hands-on impact.

Job Description

    You will own the development and validation of transaction monitoring models, with a strong focus on model documentation, review, and governance.
    You will drive governance activities within the Transaction Monitoring Unit, including validation assessments and implementation of second line feedback.
    You will set and execute the direction for model development and experimental design, balancing analytical rigor with practical constraints.
    You will document model design and outcomes, and work closely with the analytics team to ensure assumptions, limitations, and weaknesses are clearly analysed and described.
    You will provide hands-on support in prototyping tests and analytical methodologies.
    You will mentor and collaborate with the analytics team to design, test, and implement model SOPs, including data lineage and governance, tuning and calibration, and monitoring of model operations and outcomes.
    You will represent the organisation professionally in collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.

Requirements

    Extensive experience in model risk management, model governance, and validation.
    Strong background in data science, statistics, and quantitative methods.
    Experience in academic or technical writing, particularly related to model documentation.
    Advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or equivalent.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
    You work in a structured and professional way, take initiative, and are comfortable working proactively under your own direction.
    You communicate clearly and confidently, and can set direction and create results in a dynamic environment.

Nice to have

    Experience in Financial Crime or AML, for example transaction monitoring or work with technology suppliers in the area.
    Experience with transaction monitoring platforms such as Quantexa.
    Experience as a model validator or quantitative risk analyst.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Intertalents Consulting AB is looking for a Software Engineer Consultant to work on assignment with one of our clients. You will be employed by Intertalents Consulting AB and work closely with the client’s development, product, and business teams.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer Consultant, you will develop, test, and maintain software applications and services based on the client’s technical and business requirements.

You will contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and developing technical solutions to testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. The specific assignment and technical environment may change depending on the client’s needs, but your role will remain focused on software and systems development.

Your Key Responsibilities

    Develop, test, and maintain software applications and services
    Build backend systems, APIs, integrations, and data-driven solutions
    Translate business and product requirements into technical solutions
    Troubleshoot technical issues and improve existing systems
    Participate in code reviews, automated testing, and deployment processes
    Collaborate with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders
    Deliver software solutions according to agreed requirements and timelines

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer with an analytical and solution-oriented mindset. You are comfortable working independently, taking responsibility for your assignments, and collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a consulting environment.

We Believe You Have

    A university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
    10 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, and systems development
    Experience with modern programming languages and AI tools for backend or full-stack development, APIs, and databases
    Experience with cloud platforms, automated testing, and CI/CD is considered a strong merit
    Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

Application Process

We are conducting an ongoing recruitment process, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Please note that interviews and selection will take place on a rolling basis.

What We Offer

You will receive full-time employment with Intertalents Consulting AB and the opportunity to work on an engaging assignment with one of our clients. We provide ongoing support throughout your employment and assignment, including work permit and relocation assistance when required.

Diversity & Inclusion

We encourage all applicants, regardless of gender, age, nationality, ethnicity, or background, to apply. Diversity and inclusion are important to us, and we believe that different perspectives strengthen both teams and technical solutions.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer, PV&T
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for two Lead Engineers, Pressure Vessels and Tanks, for our office in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Valmet in Gothenburg delivers evaporation plant solutions to the pulp and paper industry and provides services for recovery boilers as well as environmentally friendly power and heating boilers designed for technically demanding fuels.

As a Lead Engineer, Pressure Vessels and Tanks, you will primarily work with customer delivery projects. You will take a leading role within the mechanical discipline, working closely with other disciplines such as piping, structural engineering, and process design engineering within the project team.

Area of responsibility and tasks:

    Lead and coordinate the discipline team in delivery projects.
    Keep track and be responsible for the discipline budget.
    Preparing technical documentation for the procurement and manufacturing of equipment by our suppliers, project schedules, specifications, and drawings for pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and storage tanks.
    Follow up on the manufacturing process through drawing reviews and daily communication with suppliers.
    Support installation work at the customer’s or workshop site, both remotely and on site when needed.
    Support pre‑projects and sales work when needed.
    Contribute to the development of work processes and continuous improvements.
    Occasionally travel to suppliers or customer sites during project execution.

The scope of the projects varies, which means that the size of your discipline team will also vary. Therefore, we place equal importance on your ability to collaborate and lead, as well as your capability to perform engineering and design work independently. Working in global teams is part of our delivery projects execution setup.

We operate within a global multi technology organization. Daily work involves contact with colleagues and partners in many parts of the world and also with other technologies. The role therefore includes some planned short-term business travel.

Who you are

To be successful in this role, you should hold a Masters or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or possess an equivalent qualification.

You are accustomed to taking initiative and enjoy working collaboratively in a global environment. Furthermore, you have extensive experience (more than 10 years) in a similar industry, involving engineering design, drafting, and supplier interactions.

You have the below skills and knowledge:

    AutoCAD 2D
    Microsoft Office applications
    Solid works (desirable)
    E3D (desirable)
    Knowledge in norms and standards such as EN, ASME and GB
    Working in global project teams
    Expericence from Evaparation plants or other pulp and paper process areas
    Site experience from Pulp & Paper industry (desirable)

Excellent English language skills, both written and spoken, are required.

We offer

We offer a collaborative and dynamic work environment with meaningful projects that support industrial efficiency. The global presence fosters cultural exchange, professional growth, and a shared commitment to excellence. You will also benefit from competitive compensation, bonus plan, health insurance, flexible work arrangements, continuous learning opportunities and many other wellness and leisure benefits.

Want to know more?

Please submit your application through the link provided no later than September 24, 2026. We review applications continuously.

For additional information, please contact Kristoffer Mohlin, Manager Pv&T at kristoffer.mohlin@valmet.com or Marcus Lindén, Team Leader Pv&T at marcus.linden@valmet.com. Please note that we will not accept applications via e-mail.

We perform background checks and alcohol and drug testing for all employees, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.

We look forward to hearing from you!

When everything works together

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.

Join the team and lead the way with us!

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!

Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:

    We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
    We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
    We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities

We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.

The role

As a Product Owner, your role sits at the intersection of product and clients: you run advertiser onboarding end-to-end, own the delivery and optimization roadmap for the Perform product, and are the person who knows exactly where every campaign, integration, and attribution flow stands. The demand side of this product sits in India - you will work daily with advertisers, agencies and the India commercial team while building with the engineering team in Stockholm.

What you'll do

    Own advertiser onboarding end-to-end - integration requirements, event and attribution setup, campaign configuration, launch readiness and the first weeks of live delivery.
    Run the delivery and optimization roadmap for the Perform stack: campaign delivery intelligence, conversion optimization, pacing and pricing.
    Be the product counterpart for enterprise advertisers and agencies - requirements, timelines, escalations and performance reviews.
    Own attribution and measurement quality - the integrity of the numbers advertisers see is the product.
    Work daily with engineering and data science in Stockholm to turn client needs into shippable, reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off fixes.
    Track and report the commercial funnel: pipeline status, live campaign performance, and revenue against targets.

What you bring in

    Hands-on experience with the adVantage Perform stack or an equivalent performance advertising product - campaign delivery, conversion optimization, and attribution.
    Deep familiarity with the India advertising market - advertisers, agencies, measurement conventions and commercial dynamics.
    Strong execution instincts: you keep many threads moving at once, close loops, and communicate status without being asked.
    Comfort with data - you can query, chart, and sanity-check campaign performance yourself.
    Clear written communication with both technical teams and client stakeholders.
    Willingness to work across Stockholm and India time zones with regular client-facing hours.

Great to have

    Experience inside an ad network, DSP or retail-media platform.
    Exposure to real-time ML systems - bandits, ranking or conversion models - and what it takes to run them for paying customers.
    Experience growing into product ownership from an engineering, data, or analyst background.

What we offer:

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:                                                                                                                                                        

    A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
    Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
    A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
    Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.

Come as you are:

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.

Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code:  https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/

Sounds like a great opportunity?

We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.

We only accept applications in English.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Support Engineer to EYKON, Denmark or Mälardalen, Sweden
jobs.description:
EYKON operates as an independent utility infrastructure technology company built on more than 130 years of utility expertise. Headquartered in Switzerland, with a network of expert local teams, the company serves customers in more than 75 markets and supports over 100 million connected endpoints across the region.

Combining proven metering technology, deep utility expertise and real-world operational insight from one of the largest installed bases in EMEA, EYKON connects what utilities measure with how they operate. This helps customers gain greater visibility, make better decisions, maintain greater control and unlock more value from the infrastructure they already operate.

Do you want to play a key role in the green energy transition while working in the intersection of technology, customer support and commercial development?

EYKON is looking for a Technical Sales Support Engineer to support customers and sales activities across Scandinavia. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating stakeholders and solving a wide variety of customer and business challenges in an international environment.

In this role, you will become a central part of the Scandinavian organisation. Acting as the link between customers, sales teams, product management and technical specialists, you will help ensure that customers receive the right support while contributing to the continued growth of the business across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

The Role

As Technical Sales Support Engineer, you will support Scandinavian customers and the Nordic Sales organisation across EYKON's portfolio of hardware, software and service solutions. The role combines customer support, pre-sales, order management and stakeholder coordination in a truly international environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Supporting customers across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
    Coordinating customer-related activities and acting as the customer's internal ambassador.
    Working in close cooperations with order management team
     Following up on logistics, deliveries and customer commitments.
    Providing technical and commercial support to the sales organisation
    Supporting tenders, RFQs and commercial projects.
    Participating in pre-sales initiatives and customer-facing activities.
    Conducting customer, market and competitor analysis.
    Coordinating activities between customers and internal specialists.
    Supporting customer training, product documentation and knowledge transfer together with Training team och Product Management.

This is a highly collaborative role where your ability to build relationships and navigate different stakeholder groups will be just as important as your technical understanding. You will work closely with experienced specialists while gradually developing extensive knowledge of EYKON's products, solutions and customers.

The preferred location is Sorø, Denmark, but strong candidates located in Sweden, particularly in the Örebro/Mälardalen region, will also be considered. Travel within Scandinavia is included in the role.

Is this you?

To be successful in this role, you have experience from a customer-facing B2B environment involving technical sales, customer support, sales support, application support, pre-sales or similar technical-commercial responsibilities. You are comfortable working with technical products, systems or solutions and enjoy building strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders. Experience coordinating activities across multiple functions and stakeholders is important, as is the ability to support quotations, tenders and customer-related projects. You understand how hardware, software and services interact within a broader solution environment and are able to translate technical topics into practical customer value. Professional proficiency in English together with Swedish and/or Danish language skills is required in the role, as the position involves daily collaboration with colleagues and customers across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

Experience from the energy sector, utilities, smart metering, infrastructure, automation or related technical industries is considered an advantage, but we welcome candidates from a broad range of technical and technical-commercial environments. The most important factor is your ability to learn, build relationships and create value for customers.

In this recruitment, your personal qualities will be of great importance. We are looking for a proactive, structured and customer-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and driving activities forward. You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable operating in the intersection between commercial and technical discussions. As a person, you enjoy creating structure, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring that things get done. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by building relationships, solving problems and supporting both customers and colleagues.

jobs.title: Site Integrated Planning Sr Specialist
jobs.description:
Join us to deliver a smoke- free future as Site Integrated Planning Sr Specialist!  

At Swedish Match we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and have been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.  

In the Nordic region, we are 1,600 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway working in various functions and teams and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics.

In this role you will be responsible for executing and maintaining integrated production scheduling across all manufacturing processes, from primary to secondary, ensuring the delivery of the Best Executional Production Plan. Your work will balance cash, cost, and service targets while navigating constraints like capacity, material availability, and operational realities.  

Main responsibilities:  

    Prepare rolling, integrated, and synchronized production schedules aligned with planning cycles and volume forecasts.

Who you are:

    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including functions, pivot tables, and data analysis tools.  

    Demonstrated proficiency in supply chain / production planning (site integrated planning).  

    Experience in structured way of working, ideally with defined planning process cycle.  

    Track record as team player connecting well with peers and other key stakeholders outside of team.  

    Proficiency in in written & spoken English. Swedish is meritorious.  

    Working knowledge of Supply Chain Planning Solutions and Forecasting Solutions (E2OPEN suite is a strong plus).

• Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Developer
jobs.description:
At Manta Marine Technologies, we are committed to advancing greener shipping through intelligent technologies — supporting operational efficiency, reduced carbon emissions and fuel consumption as well as simplifying emissions reporting. We provide a wide range of innovative and intelligent maritime technologies, including Vessel Optimisation solutions, Marine Electrification systems and comprehensive Lifecycle Services for all our products. Manta Marine is headquartered in Oslo, Norway, with offices in Sweden, Poland, and China.

Do you want to help us to promote a healthy planet for future generations? We are currently seeking a Senior Embedded Developer to enhance our Vessel Optimization team.

Main responsibilities

As part of Manta Marine Technologies Vessel Optimization business line, you’ll work with FuelOpt, our onboard fuel optimisation system installed on more than 500 vessels worldwide. FuelOpt helps ship owners improve operational performance, reduce fuel consumption, and lower emissions through real-time propulsion optimisation.

As a Senior Embedded Developer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining embedded applications running on our proprietary hardware platform. You will work closely with other developers, application engineers, and adjacent product teams to deliver reliable and high-quality solutions for vessel operating worldwide.

The role combines software development, troubleshooting, product improvement, and technical collaboration across the organization.



Key responsibilities

    Develop and maintain embedded software in C running on real-time embedded kernel, on in-house hardware
    Contribute to the ongoing development and improvement of our proprietary hardware platform
    Diagnose and resolve issues across hardware, operating system, and application layers
    Participate in concept development and implementation of new product features
    Develop and maintain internal tools that support system configuration and deployment
    Integrate software with operator-facing HMI solutions
    Review, test, and improve code quality and development practices
    Collaborate with adjacent engineering teams on shared solutions
    Provide technical support and expertise to internal stakeholders and customer-facing teams when needed



Background and skills

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Developer with at least six years of professional experience in embedded software development. You hold a BSc or MSc in Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent. You have strong programming skills in C and experience working in complex embedded environments.

Furthermore, you have:

    Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS) or real-time embedded kernels
    Experience developing software on custom or non-standard hardware platforms
    Strong debugging skills across hardware and software boundaries (e.g., JTAG)
    Experience with industrial and embedded communication protocols such as TCP/IP, Modbus, serial communication, or similar
    The ability to work independently and take technical ownership of solutions
    Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

Meriting experience

Experience in one or several of the following areas is considered an advantage:

    Experience with HMI integration (e.g., Beijer Electronics or similar industrial HMI platforms)
    Familiarity with C# for scripting/configuration tooling
    Familiarity with Python for internal tooling/automation
    Practical understanding of digital/analog I/O and basic electronics
    Experience in maritime and/or industrial automation
    Exposure to cybersecurity practices, especially in embedded/connected systems
    Experience with IoT devices and cloud platforms (Azure or AWS)

Personal qualities

We believe you are a curious and technically driven person who enjoys solving complex problems. You are analytical, structured, and take ownership of your work. As a senior developer, you are comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues across different teams. You enjoy sharing knowledge, contribute to a high-quality engineering culture, and take a pragmatic approach to solving technical challenges.

What we offer

We offer an opportunity to be part of a market leading innovative global company in the forefront of green technology for ships. An open and inspiring environment where your energy will make a difference. We provide great potential for personal and professional development.  

Manta Marine is committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is not only the right thing to do, but also the smart thing to do. Let’s make the world a greener place!

Application

When submitting your application, please include "Application – Senior Embedded Developer" in the subject line of your email. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: President Machining, Sandvik Group
jobs.description:
We are looking for an exceptional business leader to join us as President of business area Machining at Sandvik. As President, you lead one of the world's most respected industrial businesses and play a pivotal role in delivering Sandvik's Advancing to 2030 strategy through growth, innovation, digitalization and operational excellence.

‍Business area Machining is the global leading manufacturer of tools and tooling systems for advanced industrial metal cutting, as well as metal powder. In 2025, sales were approximately SEK 44 billion with about 18,700 employees. Our portfolio includes market leading brands like Sandvik Coromant, Seco, Walter and Dormer Pramet. Together, these businesses combine industry-leading technology, deep application expertise and strong customer partnerships to help manufacturers improve productivity, efficiency and sustainability.

About the job

With overall responsibility for the business, you set the direction and lead the execution of business area Machining's strategy and performance agenda. Machining consists of a portfolio of leading divisions and businesses, each with its own market position, strategy and profit and loss responsibility. A key part of your role is to foster and strengthen Sandvik's decentralized model, empowering division presidents and leadership teams to drive performance, innovation and customer success while ensuring alignment with the overall strategic direction of business area Machining and Sandvik Group.

You are accountable for sustainable growth, profitability, innovation and customer success across the portfolio. Through strong leadership, disciplined execution and active portfolio management, you identify new growth opportunities, strengthen market positions and ensure that business area Machining remains at the forefront of manufacturing transformation.

As a member of Sandvik Group Executive Management, you work closely with colleagues across the Group to ensure long-term value creation for customers, shareholders and society. You report to the President and CEO of Sandvik Group.

Job responsibilities

    Drive profitable growth and strengthen market leadership across the portfolio.
    Accelerate digitalization, AI adoption and innovation initiatives.
    Develop and support strong division leadership teams with accountability for strategy execution and business performance.
    Foster an entrepreneurial and decentralized culture where decisions are made close to customers and markets.
    Deliver operational excellence and cost competitiveness while advancing sustainability and responsible business practices.
    Identify and execute acquisitions and other opportunities that support long-term growth and value creation.

Location

The position is based in Stockholm. International travel is an integral part of the position.

Your profile

You are a proven global business leader with a strong track record of delivering growth, transformation and financial performance in complex international environments. You combine strategic thinking with operational excellence and are comfortable leading through change in a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by technology, automation, AI and sustainability.

You bring:

    Extensive senior leadership experience with full P&L responsibility.
    Success in driving business growth, transformation and strategy execution.
    Experience from industrial, manufacturing and/or technology-intensive businesses.
    Strong commercial acumen and customer orientation, combined with a strong understanding of advanced technologies.
    Experience leading large, global and decentralized organizations through empowered leadership teams.
    Strong ability to set the strategic direction and inspire, develop and lead high-performing leaders and teams.
    Strong ability to simplify complexity.
    Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

It’s also meriting if you have prior experience engaging with boards of directors, investors, media and other external stakeholders.

Your leadership

You’re an authentic and inspiring leader who creates clarity, accountability and engagement. You believe that the best results are achieved through empowered teams, strong local ownership and clear accountability. You lead in accordance with Sandvik's core values of Winning Together, Curiosity, Responsibility and Customer Focus, building a culture where people, innovation and business performance thrive, along with maintaining the highest standards in safety, sustainability and business ethics.

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. jobs.title: PhD Student in Cyber-Physical Systems
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.

Do you want to build the next generation of electronics?



Europe is racing to regain ground in semiconductor technology, and chiplets – several small dies packaged together into one working system – are one of the keys. The hard part is not the dies, but the interconnects between them.



We are looking for a PhD student to create those interconnects in a fully additive way: laser micromachining, selective metallisation and new photosensitive materials, without high-temperature sintering and with minimal material waste. The work is experimental, carried out in our own laboratories together with European industry.



The EISLAB division at Luleå University of Technology conducts research in electronic systems design, sensor systems, cyber-physical systems, the Internet of Things and machine learning, and works on electronics from material and process to a finished, verified component.



We work in close cooperation with companies such as Bosch, Ericsson, Volvo, Infineon, Boliden, LKAB and SKF, with leading international universities, and in large European research programmes such as Arrowhead Tools, coordinated by LTU.



This position belongs to our growing work on additive manufacturing for chiplet packaging, where EISLAB is responsible for the packaging part within a European consortium.



Subject description



Cyber-Physical Systems focuses on integrated software and application architectures with implementations of massively distributed embedded systems that interact with each other and their environment to enable secure, goal-driven, autonomous and evolvable solutions.



Project description



E2PACKMAN is a €93.7 million European flagship project building the next generation of semiconductor packaging – the part of chip making that decides how small, fast and powerful electronics can get. You will join a team that works with 60 partners from 13 countries, including Europe's leading semiconductor manufacturers and research institutes, to develop new materials, equipment and processes and prove them out on real industrial use cases. EISLAB is responsible for the packaging technology developed here.



Duties



Your main tasks are to:

    develop additive techniques for patterning micro- and nanoscale metal interconnects in multilayer devices
    identify and optimise polymers and photosensitive materials for additive manufacturing
    establish femtosecond or picosecond laser micro-drilling and selective metallisation for high-aspect-ratio vertical interconnects
    characterise the results (SEM, AFM, XCT, optical microscopy) for geometric accuracy, durability and interfacial strength
    validate scalability and sustainability: less material waste, better energy efficiency, no high-temperature sintering, compatibility with industrial HDI packaging



You will publish in scientific journals, present at international conferences and collaborate with academic and industrial partners across Europe as well as with researchers and PhD students at LTU. The work is largely independent, but you will receive continuous supervision.



As a PhD student you work towards a doctoral degree in accordance with the Swedish Higher Education Ordinance: most of your time is devoted to research, and you also take doctoral courses. Both are planned and documented in your individual study plan.



Qualifications



We are looking for an analytical and motivated colleague who can drive experimental research both independently and in a team.



Requirements:

    A master's degree (or equivalent) in electrical engineering, electronics, materials science, nanotechnology, microelectronics, engineering physics or a related field
    Experience of experimental laboratory work in micro- or nanofabrication, materials processing or electronics manufacturing
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to work in interdisciplinary teams
    Excellent spoken and written English



Desirable:

    Micro- and nanofabrication techniques such as laser direct writing, electroless plating, photolithography or additive manufacturing
    Characterisation tools such as XCT, SEM or AFM
    CAD and simulation tools such as CLEWIN, ANSYS or COMSOL
    Electronics packaging, HDI substrates or chiplet architectures
    Cleanroom experience



Do you not meet every desirable point? Apply anyway. We do not expect anyone to tick every box – much of this expertise is built during the doctoral studies themselves.



For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en



Further information



Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: by arrangement.



For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.



For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Shailesh Singh Chouhan, +46 920-49 2165, mailto:shailesh.chouhan@ltu.se



https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Tradeunioncontacts

Application

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Mechanical Engineering Manager

Do you want to help create the future of urban heating and cooling? 

Driven by a deep sense of purpose and sky-high ambitions, we think differently at Qvantum. Entrepreneuring together, we take pride in being disruptable and constantly learn, re-learn and un-learn. Here, the best idea always wins – brilliance eats hierarchy for breakfast. Our vision is to build a more resilient society by electrifying indoor heating and cooling, across Europe and beyond. Join us! 

Qvantum is a fast-growing Swedish energy-tech company accelerating the transformation of urban heating and cooling through intelligent heat-pump-powered energy systems. As a hardware-enabled software business, our technology powers modular heat pumps that we design and produce at speed and scale, built to integrate with local energy grids and electricity markets. Our heat pumps are flexready®, meaning they automatically can use electricity when it is cheapest and store the heat for later, enabling electrification, optimising the overall energy system, and saving money. All without compromising indoor comfort. The heat pumps are easy to install, monitor and maintain, and come in four categories: air/water, ground source, exhaust air and complete system solutions. Together, they target every home, whether a single-family house, an apartment building or an entire district.

Qvantum is headquartered in Åstorp, Sweden, with sales offices and distributors across Europe. The company has two European manufacturing facilities.

Backed by long-term blue-chip investors, including Thomas von Koch (ex EQT) and the IMAS Foundation (sister foundation to the INGKA Foundation, owning most of the IKEA stores globally), Qvantum has a vision to create a more resilient society by disrupting how we heat and cool buildings.

About the role

We are looking for a Mechanical Engineering Manager to lead and coordinate our team of Mechanical Design Engineers within heat pump product development. This is a hands-on leadership role combining engineering, coordination, technical leadership, and team development while remaining close to the products, technology, and daily engineering work. The team consists of experienced engineers, meaning your role is less focused on enabling successful delivery, providing technical guidance, removing obstacles, and ensuring alignment across projects and engineering disciplines.  

You will work closely with System Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Refrigeration, Electronics, Software, Project Management, Quality, Manufacturing, and external suppliers to ensure successful development and industrialization of next-generation heat pump solutions.

Key responsibilities

    Lead and coordinate the Mechanical Design Engineering team across ongoing development projects and assignments.
    Drive the end-to-end product development process from concept and design through validation, industrialization, and commercial launch.
    Provide technical guidance and support in mechanical design reviews, engineering decisions, and problem-solving activities.
    Collaborate closely with System Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Project Management, Manufacturing, Quality, and external suppliers.
    Ensure designs meet requirements for performance, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and quality.
    Support continuous improvement of engineering methods, tools, standards, and ways of working.
    Act as mentor and technical coach to team members.
    Support competence development, recruitment, and onboarding activities when needed.

Desired qualifications & experience

    B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
    10+ years of experience in mechanical product development in heat pump, HVAC, refrigeration, or similar products
    Minimum 3 years of experience in a managerial, team leader, or technical leadership role.
    Proven experience in mechanical design engineering for industrialized and mass-produced products.
    Experience leading development projects from concept phase through industrialization and product launch.
    Knowledge of CAD and PLM systems.
    Pragmatic and hands-on leadership with strong technical credibility.
    Solution-oriented communicator with the ability to drive progress in a fast-paced environment.
    Experienced collaborator with the ability to align cross-functional teams towards common goals.
    Fluent in English, written and spoken.
