jobs.title: Senior Professional Services Project Manager (EMEA)
It`s time to build!
jobs.description:
Join us in developing the zero-emission energy solutions of the future!

 

We firmly believe that nuclear power will be a major part of the solution for future zero-emission maritime propulsion systems. The team realizing this ambition is being created now. Do you want to be a part of it ?

Senior Mechanical Engineer

About the position:

 

We are looking for you to be part of a growing team of motivated colleagues to develop, test and build our maritime Gen IV nuclear power systems to power future ships. You will contribute to build the first prototype of a complete marine nuclear power system based on our gas-cooled reactor technology. A significant part of the work is preparing, producing, testing and improving the different components in the system, while at the same time building the complete power system test rig and demonstrating this in a moving environment. We are looking for a strong personal interest in the topic and a drive to create safe and sustainable solutions for tomorrow. You will report to the Head of Engineering & Testing – Norway.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Creating, testing and improving reactor system parts and solutions
  • Design and build test environments for different parts.
  • Take part in building the complete nuclear power system with test facilities, and perform the testing required.

  • Collaborate closely with the nuclear engineers in Emerald Nuclear Inc., as well as our partners and suppliers.

     

Qualifications:

 

  • Strong interest in working with complex thermal energy systems and engineering challenges.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience within the topic of mechanical engineering, systems engineering, thermodynamics, and/or material engineering.
  • Master-level education within Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or similar topics. Bachelor level candidates may also apply combined with relevant work experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of practical work experience within materials or mechanical production.
  • Experience with building and handling digital control systems or sensor networks is an advantage.
  • Previous experience with nuclear technology is not required. Necessary training in nuclear applications will be provided.

 

Personal qualities:

 

  • Strong interest in nuclear energy, mechanical engineering, maritime technology and similar topics.
  • Works independently, but comfortable with teamwork.
  • Interested in working with and solving challenges.
  • Structured and methodical.
  • Proactive and positive attitude.

 

Why Emerald Nuclear ?

This is your opportunity to participate in the beginning of a groundbreaking new industry development. With us you are not just working with a new type of technology. You will be part of the development of a completely new energy platform for maritime applications, with the potensial to combine zero-emission technololgy, unprecedented energy density and high reliability.

 

We can offer:

 

  • The opportunity to work with innovative and ground-breaking new technology
  • Be a part of creating completely new prototypes
  • Work in the apex between nuclear technology, mechanics and thermal systems.
  • Competitive salary, pension scheme and insurance package
  • Flexible work hours.
  • Personal development.
  • Free parking.

  • Work location at our engineering and test hub at Stette near the town of Ålesund.

     

We are building the team now:

 

Emerald Nuclear Norway shall lead market development, engineering, testing and the construction of maritime nuclear power systems. We have a very strong ambition to launch a demonstrator in 2031. And we need competent people on this journey. Are you ready to go?

 

Additional positions soon to be announced soon:

 

  • Senior Mechanic
  • Thermal systems engineer
  • Control systems engineer

 

It`s time to build!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Its time to build! Emerald Nuclear Norway AS is a wholly owned subsidiary of Emerald Nuclear Inc., a maritime nuclear energy company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Located in Ålesund, Norway, the company aims to lead market development, engineering, testing, and commerzialisation of maritime nuclear energy systems. Lately there has been a fundamental shift in attitudes toward nuclear energy and its role in the decarbonization of the maritime industry. Nuclear energy has the potential to provide a commercially viable zero-emission alternative to fossil fuels, while delivering the energy efficiency, endurance, and operational reliability required by the maritime market. We place the highest focus on the safety, security and safeguards in order to protect people, ships, communities, and the environment throughout the entire lifecycle of the ship and its nuclear energy system. Our objective is clear: to enable the deployment of the first commercial nuclear-powered offshore demonstration vessel on the Norwegian Continental Shelf by 2031.

jobs.title: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor
jobs.description:
About the position

Ferrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.

You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.

Your main responsibilities
  • Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.
  • Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.
  • Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.
  • Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.
  • Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.
  • Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.
  • Perform service, inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, modifications and format changeovers on existing systems.
  • Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.
  • Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance
  • Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.
  • Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.
  • Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.

Your professional background
  • You have a relevant technical qualification, for example as an industrial mechanic, marine engineer, metal fabricator, automation technician or similar. Extensive relevant industry experience may compensate for a different educational background.
  • You have several years of hands-on experience with the installation, servicing and commissioning of machinery or complete lines for the beverage, brewery, food or packaging industry.
  • You have in-depth knowledge of filling lines and preferably experience with fillers, cappers, can seamers, conveyors, mixers/carbonators, pasteurisation, CIP and utility equipment.
  • Experience from a manufacturer or service organisation such as Krones, KHS, Sidel, GEA or another supplier of process and filling lines would be a clear advantage.
  • You are able to read and work from mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, pneumatic diagrams, manuals and technical documentation.
  • You have strong mechanical expertise and can perform precise alignment, installation, adjustment and systematic troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, variable frequency drives, sensors and Siemens PLC/HMI systems is an advantage, but this is not a dedicated PLC programming role.
  • You can communicate professionally in written and spoken English. Danish or another European language would be an advantage.
  • You hold a valid driving licence and a valid EU/EEA passport, and are able to travel and work throughout Denmark and Europe without significant restrictions.

Personal qualities
  • You take ownership of your assignments and maintain an overview, even when schedules are tight or several disciplines are working simultaneously.
  • You are hands-on, solution-oriented and comfortable working independently away from the office.
  • You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.
  • You work in a structured manner and follow up on agreements, open items, safety, quality and documentation.
  • You are flexible regarding travel, working hours and changing priorities and understand that start-ups and production-critical service assignments may require additional effort.

We offer
  • A permanent position with significant influence on the successful delivery of international customer projects.
  • A varied working day involving new installations, commissioning, service and technical problem-solving.
  • The opportunity to work with complete solutions - from process systems and utilities to the finished filling line.
  • Close cooperation with project managers, engineers, automation specialists, suppliers and customers' technical organisations.
  • An informal company with short decision-making paths, a high level of responsibility and a strong focus on quality and professional integrity.
  • Salary and employment terms based on qualifications, together with relevant travel conditions and work equipment.


Practical information

Work location: Ferrum's base in Fredericia, combined with assignments at customer sites in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe.
Travel: Extensive and varying according to the project portfolio. Overnight travel and assignments lasting several weeks may occur.
Employment: Permanent position.

Application
Please send your application and CV, including a brief description of your experience with filling lines, installation, service and commissioning. Please also state which machine types and suppliers you have previously worked with and the level of travel you are accustomed to.

jobs.title: Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor in Defense-related Technologies for Unmanned Aerial Systems Engineering for Defense
jobs.description:
SDU Drone Center at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), University of Southern Denmark in Odense invites applications for positions in defense-related technologies for Drones (Unmanned Aerial Systems, UAS) at the levels of Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor. The positions are available from January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

What we offer
The successful candidate(s) will join the SDU Drone Center, located at SDU Campus and at HCA Airport, where we operate state-of-the-art indoor and outdoor drone laboratories. You will become part of an interdisciplinary and agile research environment with strong ties to the internationally recognized robotics ecosystem in Odense.

 

What We expect
We expect candidates to have documented expertise in systems engineering for unmanned aerial systems with demonstrated real-world applications. The successful candidate will conduct research in aerial robotics, focusing on the design and implementation of drones operating in dynamic and complex outdoor environments. Relevant research areas include, but are not limited to, autonomous systems, swarming, navigation in GNSS-denied environments, communication and coordination, airspace situational awareness and management, safety and security, and counter-drone technologies.

Experience in defense-related research and/or applications is considered an advantage.

 

Commensurate with the seniority of the position applied for, the candidates must have:

  • Strong research and publication record;

  • Experience with defense, industrial, public sector and/or emergency services collaboration (this is a requirement for Full Professor);

  • Proven track record of attracting research funding (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor);

  • Experience with teaching and education development (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor).

The successful candidate(s) are expected to play a proactive role in contributing to and expanding the Center’s research portfolio. This includes active participation in ongoing projects as well as the development, leadership, and coordination of new externally funded research initiatives. The candidate(s) are further expected to secure competitive national and international research funding, establish strategic collaborations with academic, industrial, and defense stakeholders, and strengthen the Center’s position in civil and defense-related drone technologies.

The candidate(s) will contribute to teaching and supervision within the Master of Science education in Drones and Autonomous Systems, which is part of the Robotics MSc programme at the University of Southern Denmark.

Research environment
SDU Drone Center conducts research in drone technologies and future drone applications within areas such as defense, infrastructure inspection, healthcare logistics, precision agriculture, nature conservation, and environmental monitoring. We are an interdisciplinary team of researchers with specializations within robotics, computer vision, software, embedded systems, and the design and construction of drone systems. Together we create drone solutions for a flourishing European society. Learn more about the center at https://www.sdu.dk/uasFor further information please contact Head of SDU Drone Center, Professor Ulrik Pagh Schultz, ups@mmmi.sdu.dk,  phone: +45 6550 3570.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration (mandatory for full professor and associate professor applicants).

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience (for assistant professor applicants).

  • Research plan.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and appointment as an associate professor and full professor is permanent. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an associate professor and full professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position as an associate professor or a full professor. A completed lecturer training programme or equivalent pedagogical/didactical competence development is a prerequisite. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, associate professor or full professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

We are seeking a candidate with strong lab skills and, ideally, expertise in transcriptional, protein and chromatin analyses including specialist knowledge in -omics techniques (e.g. RNA-seq) and bioinformatic analyses of large scale -omics datasets. We are interested in candidates who have experience with plant model organisms used in genetics research (e.g. Arabidopsis), as well as model Irish crops. We are particularly interested in candidates whose research focuses on how plants sense and respond to abiotic stress at the molecular level, plant epigenetic responses and the molecular basis of plant resilience to climate change. Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet.   • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

jobs.title: Collo: Data Analyst / Engineer
jobs.description:
**Employment type:** full-time, fixed-term

**Location:** Visiokatu 1, 33720 Tampere, Hybridi

**Application deadline:** 23.9.2026

Join Collo in building the intelligence layer for liquid processes.

Collo, a Finnish deep-tech company, is looking for a **Data Analyst or an Engineer** to produce insightful analytics for well-known customers. This is a fixed-term parental leave cover, with the possibility to discuss continuing in the role after the fixed-term contract ends.

**About Collo:**

Collo builds liquid process intelligence for the global food and beverage industry. The companys ambition is simple: help manufacturers understand what is happening inside their liquid processes in real time and turn that intelligence into better decisions and automated action.

Collos technology combines a unique RF-based measurement technology with science-led AI and analytics. A single inline analyzer reads the liquids unique fingerprint as it flows through the process, revealing changes that conventional factory systems often cannot see.

That intelligence helps some of the worlds leading food and beverage manufacturers reduce product losses, optimise cleaning, improve process control and ultimately make every drop matter.

Born from research at Tampere University and already deployed in 16 countries, Collo is now scaling internationally. This is your chance to join a small, highly skilled team working at the intersection of deep tech, data, industrial AI and real-world manufacturing.

**What will you be doing?**

In this role, you will join Collos Service team in a role that combines customer-facing analytics with hands-on development of the tools, pipelines, and automated workflows that make analytics more scalable and efficient.

Your responsibilities will include direct customer data analysis, visualisation, and reporting, as well as improving existing analysis pipelines, developing automated data processing, and designing scalable analysis workflows. You will work with industrial measurement and time-series data, turning it into actionable insights for Collos customers.

Your work will include participating in customer meetings, identifying analytics needs and problems in customers processes as well as developing solutions to these problems. You will conduct hands-on data analysis and communicate your findings to the customers. At the same time, you will develop and improve the underlying data processing and analysis solutions to reduce manual work. Python will be your main tool for data processing, analysis, and development. You will also use tools such as PowerPoint and Power BI to visualise and communicate insights.

In addition to customer-facing analytics, you will work closely with Collos Data & AI team. This collaboration may include preparing industrial measurement data for machine learning and AI applications, working with industrial IoT data, and contributing to shared data development topics across the organisation.

**What kind of person thrives in this role?**

This role is a combination of data analysis and engineering, offering independent responsibility, technical problem-solving, and collaboration with both customers and internal experts. It is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys not only analysing data but also developing better ways to process, automate, and utilise it.

We are looking for a data professional with a few years of relevant experience who is comfortable working independently with data and wants to deepen their expertise in data engineering and analytics. You enjoy solving technical problems but are equally comfortable discussing data and its implications with customers and other stakeholders.

**We require you to have:**

- A relevant degree in information technology, computer science, data analytics, or a related field

- A few years of professional experience in data processing, ideally in data analytics

- Strong Python skills

- Experience working with time-series data

- Experience with MS Office tools; experience with Power BI is preferred

- Experience using AI-centred tools, such as Claude Code and Codex, as part of your daily work

- Professional working proficiency in English


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience working with databases

- Experience with Azure or other cloud environments

- Experience with measurement devices, process automation and/or the food and beverage industry

- Finnish language skills


**Collo offers you:**

- An opportunity to join a company in a strong international growth phase and contribute to scaling its data and analytics capabilities

- A mission-driven team shaping a sustainable future in manufacturing

- Cutting-edge product with strong demand and industrial impact

- A chance to develop tools, pipelines, and workflows that have a direct impact on how efficiently analytics can be delivered to customers

- A low-hierarchy organisation, knowledgeable colleagues, and an efficient working environment enabled by a small but highly skilled team

- Well-known customers whose products you may recognise from supermarket shelves

- Hybrid work and flexible hours to support performance over presence


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time, fixed-term parental leave cover, currently estimated to run from November 2026 until October 2027**,** and you will be employed directly by Collo. There may be an opportunity to discuss continuing at Collo after the fixed-term contract, depending on the companys needs and available opportunities at that time.

Collos office is located in Tampere, and most of the team works regularly from the office. We therefore hope you are able to work on-site as agreed and depending on your responsibilities, while flexible remote work is also possible.

jobs.title: AI Response Evaluator
jobs.description:
iMerit is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.
Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Interpret conversational context and identify what the user really wanted

  • Rate and rank responses against defined quality criteria

  • Compare multiple answers and explain in writing why one wins

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably assessed rather than guessing

What you bring:

  • Strong critical thinking and sound judgment in ambiguous cases

  • Solid research skills and attention to detail

  • Excellent reading comprehension

  • Self direction and the discipline to hit deadlines without supervision

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project. 

  • Fully remote and flexible.

  • You choose your hours as long as volume and deadlines are met.

  • Task volume varies with project demand.

jobs.description:
Vi søger en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist til vores internationale kontor i Barcelona. 

Har du arbejdet med salg eller Telemarketing i mere end et år, og er du klar til det næste skridt i den karriere? Eller brænder du for digital markedsføring og er du kreativ og vil gerne blive certificeret rådgiver der kan hjælpe andre med at lave succesfulde digitale kampagner? Hvis du er teknisk, kreativ og udadvendt og kan få tingene gjort i et tempofyldt, hurtigt skiftende miljø, har vi måske det perfekte job til dig!

Hvad laver en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?

Du arbejder tæt sammen med ambitiøse virksomheder, der skal onboardes til digital vækst. Du rådgiver om Pay-Per-Click-kampagner (PPC), identificerer vækstmuligheder og skaber langsigtet værdi. Med forståelse for markedsdynamik og strategisk tænkning styrker du system integrering og kundeloyalitet — med effekt og relation i centrum.

Skaber vækst og digitale resultater

Du udvikler og optimerer kampagner, opsøger kunder via telefon og video, og identificerer løsninger, der matcher deres unikke behov. Du opbygger tillid og sikrer, at dine kunder får det fulde udbytte af deres digitale investeringer — både på kort og lang sigt.

Styrker kunderejser og partnerskaber

Du håndterer et højt volumen af kunder og rådgiver i komplekse kontekster. Du arbejder med strategier, der øger ROI og kampagnespend, og bistår med integration på tværs af platforme. Du bruger AI-værktøjer i din dagligdag og kommunikerer effektivt med forskellige interessenter — altid med respekt for datasikkerhed og GDPR.

Du bliver en del af et globalt team i hjertet af Barcelona, hvor teknologi og marketing mødes. 

Engelsktalende arbejdsmiljø er standard, og du får fuldt betalt oplæring, personlige coaches og adgang til certificeringer. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og spændende projekter inden for digital markedsføring.

Dit ansvar:

  • Onboarding af kunder og opbygning af langsigtede relationer over telefon og videomøder

  • Udvikling af performance-drevne PPC-strategier

  • Proaktivt salg og kampagneoptimering

  • Opdatering og vedligeholdelse af kundedata

  • Rådgivning om digital positionering og annoncering

  • Forståelse for ROI og integration med andre platforme

  • Support og strategisk planlægning på nordisk niveau

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk og engelsk på minimum C1

  • Bachelorgrad eller relevant erfaring i marketing/salg/Telemarketing

  • Kendskab til Google Ads, CRM og datastyring

  • Proaktiv og strategisk tilgang til kundeopgaver

  • Evne til at navigere i komplekse stakeholder-miljøer

  • Passion for digital markedsføring og forretningsudvikling

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav — hvis rollen vækker din interesse, opfordrer vi dig stadig til at søge!

Benefits:

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling (39 timer/uge) med hybridmodel i Barcelona

  • Flyttepakke med flybillet og indkvartering i privat studie

  • Privat sygeforsikring og sundhedsfokus

  • Bonus for at anbefale en ven

  • Certificeringer og løbende kompetenceudvikling

  • Arbejdsmiljø med sociale aktiviteter og teambuilding

  • Kontor med havudsigt i World Trade Center, Barcelona

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?

Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

  • Lavere leveomkostninger end Danmark

  • Kunst, musik, tech og kultur i dynamisk samspil

  • Fokus på trivsel og diversitet

  • Internationale brands og karrieremuligheder

  • Åben og inkluderende atmosfære

Professionel udvikling:

  • Indsigt i digital markedsføring og internationale arbejdskulturer

  • Specialiseret viden om Google Ads og online strategi

  • Fuld oplæring og adgang til certificeringer

  • Karriereveje inden for tech, salg og rådgivning

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med kunder fra hele Europa

Personlig vækst og karriere:

Forestil dig at starte dagen med café con leche, arbejde med digitale strategier under palmerne og slutte af med live-musik ved stranden. Hos TP får du ikke bare et job — du får muligheden for at bygge en karriere, forme fremtiden og leve livet fuldt ud.

Barcelona er stedet, hvor arbejde og livskvalitet går op i en højere enhed.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, kotikuntoutus ja turva-auttamistiimi, Kirkkonummi
jobs.description:
Haemme lähihoitajia vakituisiin työsuhteisiin Kirkkonummen kotikuntoutustiimiin. Tehtävään kuuluu kotikuntoutuksen lisäksi vuoroja turva-auttamistehtävässä. Työskentelyalue voi tarpeen mukaan muuttua tai laajentua.

Kotikuntoutus toimii tiiviissä yhteistyössä muun muassa Läntisen sairaala-alueen, Seniori-infon ja alueellisen kotihoidon kanssa, vastateten sairaalasta kotiutuvien ikääntyneiden kotiutuksista, hoidosta ja kuntoutuksesta kotona, turva-auttamisen käynneistä, sekä palvelutarpeen arviosta yhdessä Seniori-infon kanssa.

Lähihoitajan työ kotikuntoutuksessa on asiakkaan kotona tapahtuvaa itsenäistä, asiakaslähtöistä ja kuntouttavaa hoitotyötä sisältäen perushoidon lisäksi sairaanhoidollisia tehtäviä. Tavoitteena on mahdollistaa asiakkaan toimivaa arkea ja tukea kotona asumista.

Lähihoitajan työhön kuuluvissa turva-auttamisvuoroissa keskeisiä vastuualueita ovat turva-auttamisasiakkaiden hälytystehtävien vastaanotto sähköisen hälytyskeskusjärjestelmän kautta ja vaihtuvien asiakkaiden kotiin jalkautuminen itsenäisesti. Asiakkaan luona tehdään tilannearvio ja arvio tämän kotikuntoisuudesta. Käynnillä annetaan asiakkaan tarvitsema välitön ensiapu ja muu tuki, arvioidaan lisäavun tarve ja tarvittaessa järjestetään se asiakkaalle. Käynneillä on mahdolisuus muiden ammattiryhmien konsutointiin.

Työhön kuuluu myös turvapuhelinten ja muiden turvalaitteiden asennus asiakkaille ja turvalaitteiden toiminnan tarkistaminen.

Kirjaaminen on iso osa niin kotikuntoutuksen kuin turva-auttamipalvelun työtä. Käynneillä tehdään kirjaukset Lifecare potilastietojärjestelmään sekä raportoidaan tarvittaessa eteenpäin toisille ammattilaisille. Yhteistyötä tehdään eri viranomaistahojen, kuten kotihoidon ja sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystyksen kanssa.

Työssä pääsee takuuvarmasti hyödyntämään monipuolisesti lähihoitajan osaamista!

Työssä korostuvat hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot, vastuullisuus sekä tiimityöskentelytaidot. Työyksikkö ja esihenkilö ovat tukena ja varmistavat, että työ sujuu. Työ on moniammatillista. Tiimiin kuuluu lähihoitajien lisäksi sairaanhoitajia, fysioterapeutteja, sekä lääkäri.

Työ on jaksotyötä, johon kuuluu aamu- ja iltavuoroja sekä viikonlopputyötä.

Aloitamme haastattelut mahdollisesti jo hakuaikana, joten haethan pian - odotamme hakemustasi!

Työpaikan osoite: Jokiniityntie 2, 02400 Kirkkonummi
Työaika: 114h 45min/ 3 viikossa
Tehtävä on vakituinen.

Tehtävään soveltuva koulutus: Lähihoitajan nimikkeellä toimivalta edellytetään oikeutta käyttää tehtävään soveltuvaa nimikesuojattua ammattinimikettä. Eduksi katsotaan osaamisalana perustason ensihoito, sairaanhoito ja huolenpito tai pelastajatutkinnon perustason ensihoidon suuntautumisvaihtoehto.

Tehtävässä edellytetään:
- sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa
- ruotsin kielen taito on eduksi
- ajokortti on pakollinen
- lääkehoitolupa ei ole pakollinen, mutta se tulee suorittaa koeajan puitteissa

Toivomme, että
- ymmärrät kotona asumisen tuen palvelukokonaisuutta ja asiakastarpeita
- tunnet sote-alan päivystys- ja hätäkeskustoimintaa ja keskeisen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon lainsäädännön
- olet yhteistyötaitoinen: kohtaat ihmisiä rauhallisesti ja empaattisesti ja osaat arvioida asiakkaan tilanteen ja hoidon tarpeen nopeasti
- pystyt toimimaan itsenäisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen yhteisten toimintamallien ja ohjeiden pohjalta
- sinulla on valmius itsenäiseen kenttätyöhön asiakkaiden kotona

Arvostamme
- ensiapuosaamista
- kokemusta ikääntyneiden hoitotyöstä ja voimassa olevat lääkeluvat
- uusien järjestelmien ketterä käyttöönottokyky
- aiempaa kokemusta työssä tarvittavista järjestelmistä (Lifecare potilastietojärjestelmä, hälytyskeskusjärjestelmä, turvalaitteiden hallintajärjestelmä ja sensoridatan analysointialusta)

Tehtävässä edellytetään myös tartuntatautilain 48§:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä tartuntatautilain §55 mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Työsuhteeseen valituilta pyydetään satunnaisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen päihdeohjelman mukaista huumausainetodistusta.

1.1.2024 lukien tehtävään valitun on esitettävä itseään koskeva lain 741/2023 28 §:n mukainen iäkkäiden henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevän rikostaustan selvittämiseksi tarpeellinen rikosrekisteriote.


Olemme muutoksen tekijöitä. Uudistamme rohkeasti sen, mikä kaipaa parannusta, ja säilytämme sen, mikä toimii. Panostamme jokaisen työntekijämme hyvinvointiin ja haluamme tarjota monipuolisia etuja henkilöstöllemme. Saat käyttöösi vuodessa 300 €, jonka voit käyttää toiveidesi mukaan kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi-, liikunta- tai matkalippuetuuksiin. Lisäksi pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi Eduhousen ja Oppiportin laajojen verkkokoulutusten avulla.

In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Employment details: Location: Dublin, Ireland | Type: Full-Time, Permanent (100% In-Office) Job Purpose: Drive growth through market research, AI-driven campaign architecture, and operational administration. Working on-site with the Operations Team, you will design, execute, and monitor multi-channel campaigns while supporting internal departments to streamline business processes. Key Responsibilities: Business Development & Research: Conduct market research and data analysis to identify target demographics. Formulate research-backed plans for upcoming marketing campaigns, utilizing advanced AI methodologies to map structures and forecast performance metrics. Campaign Rollouts & Administration: Execute multi-channel outreach spanning social media, email, and outbound calls. Collaborate with Creative, Sales, and Tech departments to manage end-to-end rollouts. Build and maintain customized Gemini Gem Agents and AI workflows to optimize planning, script generation, and customer segmentation. Track workflows using centralized management tools. Business Process Support: Evaluate and optimize core business processes across all internal departments to troubleshoot bottlenecks and introduce automation. Manage the digital architecture of events using the OpenWater platform. Oversee backend administration, content updates, and operational health of WordPress websites. Supervise Media Monitoring tools to track brand sentiment. Creative Design & Implementation: End-to-end creation and management of social media campaigns. Apply editorial design principles to create visually compelling layouts for magazine advertising and digital publications. Execute high-level word processing and reporting. Training & Upskilling: Design and deliver internal training programs to upskill staff across all departments on new AI tools, software platforms, and standardized operating procedures (SOPs). Job Requirements & Qualifications: Experience: 2+ years of experience in business development support, marketing operations, or campaign administration. Proven track record of supporting cross-functional teams and optimizing business processes. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, IT, or a related field preferred. Project Management: Advanced proficiency in Monday.com for setting up operational dashboards, tracking cross-departmental KPIs, and managing workflows. AI Tools: Hands-on experience in Gemini Gem Agent creation and prompt engineering for business research and structural planning. Event Tech: Administrative experience with OpenWater or equivalent enterprise ecosystems. Web & Content: Technical familiarity with WordPress website administration and professional word-processing software. Productivity Suites: Expert proficiency in G Suite (Google Workspace) for documentation and cross-team data management. Design & Media: Practical experience in magazine advertising editorial design, layout generation, and media monitoring supervision.

jobs.title: VINDUESPUDSER SØGES TIL MIDTJYLLAND
jobs.description:
VINDUESPUDSER SØGES TIL MIDTJYLLAND

Kan du lide en aktiv arbejdsdag, hvor du selv planlægger din rute og møder mange forskellige mennesker?

Rekruttering Djursland søger for vores kunde en vinduespudser til Midtjylland. Du får ansvaret for en fast kundekreds og bliver virksomhedens ansigt udadtil, når du besøger både private og erhvervskunder.

Du starter som udgangspunkt arbejdsdagen hjemmefra og kører direkte til dagens første opgave. Derfor får du en selvstændig hverdag uden at skulle møde ind på en fast adresse hver morgen.

Dine opgaver

  • Vinduespudsning hos private og virksomheder

  • Planlægning og gennemførelse af dagens rute

  • Professionel betjening af kunderne

  • Vedligeholdelse af bil og arbejdsudstyr

  • Opfølgning på de aftalte opgaver

Vi søger dig, der

  • Arbejder grundigt og effektivt

  • Er stabil og overholder dine aftaler

  • Trives med at arbejde på egen hånd

  • Er venlig og serviceminded

  • Har kørekort B

  • Taler og forstår dansk

Erfaring med vinduespudsning er en fordel, men den rette indstilling og lysten til at lære betyder mindst lige så meget.

Du bliver tilbudt

  • En god lønpakke med mulighed for bonus

  • Ny KIA PV5 som arbejdsbil

  • Moderne og professionelt arbejdsudstyr

  • En fleksibel og selvstændig arbejdsdag

  • Gode kollegaer og hjælp, når du har brug for det

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dig i takt med virksomheden

Arbejdsområde: Midtjylland

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til:

https://RekrutteringDjursland.reqruiting.com/Pages/Application/Apply.aspx?id=29365

Skriv “Vinduespudser Midtjylland” i emnefeltet.

Spørgsmål til stillingen kan rettes til Kasper fra Rekruttering Djursland på telefon 54 58 49 49.

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Location: Dublin, Ireland Salary: €55,000 plus Sodexo benefits Contract: Full-time, Permanent About the Role We are looking for an organised and proactive Office Manager to support the delivery of hard and soft facilities services across multiple client sites. This is a varied, hands-on coordination role where you’ll help ensure services are delivered safely, consistently and to a high standard. You’ll work closely with clients, contractors and internal teams while coordinating a team of up to 20 employees and managing day-to-day facilities requirements. Travel between sites will be required Key Responsibilities: Coordinate day-to-day hard FM services, including planned and reactive maintenance, statutory inspections, utilities and contractors. Coordinate soft services including cleaning, reception, waste, pest control, workplace support and events. Lead, schedule, coach and performance-manage a multi-site team. Act as the main point of contact for facilities queries, work orders and escalations. Build strong relationships with clients and stakeholders and resolve issues professionally. Coordinate contractor access, permits, inductions, risk assessments and method statements. Maintain accurate operational, compliance and service records. Support audits, inspections and corrective actions. Monitor SLAs, KPIs, maintenance schedules, staffing, supplies and expenditure. Support purchasing, purchase orders, deliveries, invoices and inventory control. Coordinate site meetings, moves, events and business continuity activities. Promote strong Health & Safety, environmental and service standards. Identify opportunities to improve quality, efficiency and customer experience. What We Ae Looking For We are looking for someone with strong facilities coordination, people management and customer service skills. You will ideally have: Fluency in Mandarin Experience coordinating facilities operations across one or more sites. Experience across both technical and workplace/soft services. Proven experience leading, scheduling or managing teams. Good understanding of Health & Safety, compliance, audits and contractor management. Excellent organisation, communication and problem-solving skills. Experience using Microsoft Office and CAFM/helpdesk systems. Confidence working with KPIs, service data and operational reporting. The flexibility to travel between sites and respond calmly to changing priorities. A proactive, customer-focused approach with strong attention to detail. Sodexo reserves the right to close this advert early if we are in receipt of a high number of applications

jobs.title: Orthoptiste
jobs.description:
Cabinet cherche son Orthoptiste pour le cabinet de SAINT GEORGES DE DIDONNES
prise de poste immédiate
Sous la responsabilité de l'ophtalmologue , vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le parcours de soins du patient. Vos missions principales seront :

Examens et explorations fonctionnelles : Réalisation des examens complémentaires (réfraction, tonométrie, OCT, champ visuel, topographie cornéenne, rétinographie, biométrie, etc.).
Bilan orthoptique : Évaluation des troubles visuels (motilité oculaire, vision binoculaire, troubles de l'accommodation, etc.) et analyse des besoins du patient.
Rééducation et réadaptation : Conception et mise en œuvre de programmes de soins personnalisés (prise en charge du strabisme, de l'amblyopie, de la fatigue visuelle liée aux écrans, ou accompagnement en basse vision).
Coordination : Participation à l'élaboration du projet de soins en collaboration avec l'équipe médicale et les autres professionnels de santé.
Suivi administratif : Gestion des dossiers patients et transmission des bilans aux médecins.

jobs.title: Teollisuuden kunnossapitoasentaja, Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab, Turku
jobs.description:
_Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab:n tuotemerkit Marli, Mehukatti, Juissi, Vital, Natur, God Morgon ja Brazil ovat luonnollinen osa suomalaisten arkea. Jokaisella meistä on mehujen joukossa omat suosikkituotteemme ja monet niistä tuovat mieleen mukavan nostalgisia muistoja._

_Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab on osa Euroopan johtavaa mehuliiketoimintakonsernia Eckes-Granini Group GmbH:ta, jonka pääkonttori sijaitsee Saksassa. Eckes-Granini Finlandin juomatehdas sekä muut liiketoiminnot sijaitsevat Turussa. Tavoitteemme on olla Suomen vastuullisin mehutalo_.

**Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab etsii teollisuuden kunnossapitoasentajaa Turun tuotantolaitokselle kolmivuorotyöhön.**

Teollisuuden kunnossapitoasentajana vastaat tuotantolaitteiden ja automaatiojärjestelmien toimivuudesta ja kehittämisestä. Työ on monipuolinen ja sisältää sekä kunnossapidon että tuotannon kehittämisen tehtäviä.

**Tehtävänkuva**

· Mekaanisten ja sähköautomaatioon liittyvien vikojen korjaus sekä häiriöiden poisto koko tuotannon ja logistiikan alueella

· Ennakkohuoltojen toteutus

· Tuotantolinjojen kehittäminen ja parantaminen yhteistyössä esihenkilösi, muiden tuotantoasentajien sekä kunnossapitoasentajien kanssa

**Edellytämme sinulta**

· Sähkö- ja automaatioalan ammatillista koulutusta tai riittävää kokemusta teollisuuden automaatiotehtävistä

· Halua ja kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

· Hyviä ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

· Yhteistyökykyä muun henkilöstömme sekä urakoitsijoiden henkilöstön kanssa

Sähkö- ja automaatiotekniikan osaaminen on tehtävässä keskeinen perusvaatimus. Yrityksellä on mahdollisuus perehdyttää ja kouluttaa tehtävän mekaanisiin osa-alueisiin sekä laitteisiin, mutta sähkö- ja automaatiotekniikan perustaidot tulisi hakijalla olla jo valmiiksi hallussa.

**Tarjoamme**

· Vakituisen työn kansainvälisessä yrityksessä kaikkien suomalaisten tuntemien tuotebrändien parissa

· Yrityksen palkkausjärjestelmän mukaisen palkkauksen, kattavan sairaskuluvakuutuksen sekä liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun

· Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän modernissa tuotantoympäristössä

· Hyvät mahdollisuudet kehittyä työssäsi

**Palkkaus**

Tehtävän palkkahaarukka on 15,13 €/h - 18,20 €/h. Huomioimme palkkauksessa henkilön osoittaman osaamisen sekä työkokemuksen. Lisäksi palkkaukseen vaikuttavat TES:n mukaiset ilta- ja yötyölisät, yrityskohtainen kolmivuorolisä sekä työsuhteen aikana osoitettu monityötaitoisuus.

_Työkuutio toimii rekrytoinnissa Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab:n kumppanina. Pyydämme lähettämään hakemuksen ja CV:n osoitteeseen toimisto@tyokuutio.fi viimeistään 10.9.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme hakemusten läpikäynnin ja haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan sopivan ehdokkaan löytyessä – toimi siis ripeästi!_

jobs.description:

Rattaché(e) au Directeur du village F/H, il/elle veille à la réalisation du produit, en optimisant les moyens humains et organisationnels, dans le respect des budgets et des exigences réglementaires.

Véritable relais du directeur F/H et en interaction permanente avec les chefs de service, il/elle doit :

Manager, animer et coordonner l'ensemble des services, et plus particulièrement la restauration
Participer au recrutement et gérer les ressources humaines du village dans le respect des engagements de l'entreprise
Assurer une relation client de qualité et anticiper leurs attentes
Veiller à la réalisation du produit et à la bonne application de la démarche qualité

En qualité de manager, vous êtes un véritable vecteur de la culture d'entreprise dans un esprit basé sur des valeurs de Respect,  Solidarité et Excellence qui favorisent l'engagement et le développement humain de tous nos collaborateurs.

Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en hôtellerie ou en management, vous parlez couramment le langage de la gestion et du service. Le terrain est votre seconde nature : Fort(e) d'une expérience de 3 ans minimum, vous excellez dans le management d'équipe et le pilotage d'un centre de profit. Le petit plus qui fera la différence ? Une expertise éprouvée dans l'univers du tourisme ou de la restauration.

La gestion n'a pas de secret pour vous : Les indicateurs de performance, les leviers de rentabilité et les outils de pilotage font partie de votre quotidien. Vous maîtrisez idéalement des logiciels clés comme GOMC ou E-Resa. La rigueur est votre alliée : Intraitable sur la qualité, vous maîtrisez sur le bout des doigts les normes d'hygiène et de sécurité (HACCP).

Vous êtes un(e) leader inspirant(e) : Autonome, ultra-organisé(e) et dynamique, vous savez fédérer vos collaborateurs autour d'objectifs communs grâce à votre énergie

Conditions d'embauche :

Poste à pourvoir en CDI au 01/12/2026 sur un de nos magnifiques Villages Clubs : Ménuires, Montgenèvre ...
Statut Cadre en forfait jours.
Logement et repas fournis en avantage en nature.
Salaire en fonction du profil et de l'expérience

Villages Clubs du Soleil s'engage pour la diversité et l'inclusion.
Nous sommes déterminés à adapter le poste aux besoins spécifiques des personnes en situation de handicap, et nous veillons à garantir un environnement de travail inclusif, accessible et respectueux pour toutes et tous.

jobs.title: Tiimipäällikkö
jobs.description:
**Toimintamme kasvaessa etsimme nyt neljättä tiimipäällikköä Huolenpitotiimiin. Meillä pääset oppimaan jatkuvasti uutta asuntosijoittamisesta ja vuokrasuhteiden hallinnoinnista.**

Asuntopehtoori on täyden palvelun asuntovarallisuuden hoitaja, joka tarjoaa asiakkailleen vuokravälitystä, asuntovälitystä, vuokra-asuntojen Huolenpitopalvelua sekä isännöintiä. Olemme ketterä ja nykyaikainen toimija, joka tunnetaan loistavasta asiakaspalvelustaan sekä kilpailukykyisestä hinnoittelustaan. Toimimme 14 eri kaupungissa palvellen asiakkaita ympäri Suomen!

Meillä Asuntopehtoorin Huolenpitopalvelussa teet tiivistä yhteistyötä Huolenpitopalvelun muiden tiimipäällikön, sihteeriemme ja välittäjiemme sekä liiketoimintajohtajan kanssa. Tiimissämme on yhdessä tekemisen meininki ja hyvä yhteishenki!

Tiimipäällikön tehtävänä on varmistaa, että tiimin päivittäinen työ sujuu tehokkaasti, ja asiakkaamme saavat laadukasta ja asiantuntevaa palvelua. Tiimipäällikkönä vaikutat suoraan siihen, miten tiimi toimii, millaista palvelua asiakkaamme saavat ja miten pystymme vastaamaan kasvun tuomiin tarpeisiin. Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on kyky itsenäiseen työskentelyyn, kyky kantaa vastuuta omasta ja tiimin työskentelystä sekä halua kehittää toimintaa ja auttaa tiimiä onnistumaan yhdessä.

jobs.title: Doctoral researchers in Thermal Technologies, AI Infrastructure, and Building Energy Systems
jobs.description:
Do you want to explore how emerging digital technologies, intelligent energy systems, or advanced thermal solutions can accelerate the sustainable transformation of buildings and infrastructure? We are looking for doctoral researchers to join us at LUT University and contribute to research on future building energy systems and thermal technologies.

LUT Civil Engineering is a new, growing part of the LUT School of Energy Systems, and now hiring three doctoral researchers with a strong interest in sustainable building energy systems, thermal technologies, and emerging digital infrastructure. The positions focus on developing innovative solutions for energy-efficient buildings and infrastructure through advanced thermal management, intelligent control systems, and computational approaches for sustainable energy systems.

We are also currently seeking other civil engineering professionals with a range of specialties; see our other job openings: https://www.lut.fi/en/about-us/come-work-us/open-positions.

What your work will be like

You will contribute to research on one of the following areas:

- Advanced thermal management and heat transfer technologies for energy and infrastructure applications. The position focuses on developing high-performance thermal solutions for energy and infrastructure applications, with a particular emphasis on liquid cooling, microchannel and cold-plate technologies, phase change materials, heat transfer enhancement, and thermal design and optimisation.
- AI infrastructure and building energy systems. The position strengthens research on sustainable building and district energy systems by investigating their interactions with emerging AI infrastructure, with particular emphasis on energy efficiency, energy flexibility, waste heat utilisation, renewable energy integration, and low-carbon energy solutions.
- Occupant-centric building energy systems and smart heating control. The position advances research on energy-efficient and human-centred residential heating by investigating intelligent control of heating systems, with particular emphasis on occupancy sensing and prediction, smart thermostatic radiator valve (TRV) control, occupant interaction, thermal comfort, and energy efficiency.

As a doctoral researcher, your primary goal is to complete your doctoral degree. You will actively participate in the research group's activities and contribute to research projects in various ways. Depending on the position, your work may involve conducting research, developing computational models, analytical methods, and control solutions, carrying out and analysing field experiments, and analysing and documenting research results. You will disseminate your findings through peer-reviewed scientific publications and presentations at international conferences and research meetings.

In addition, you will contribute to national and international research projects in close collaboration with your research team and external partners. Your role may also include teaching and assisting in teaching at the bachelors and masters levels, supervising student projects where appropriate, and contributing to research group and project activities.

The selected candidates must apply for the right to pursue doctoral studies at the LUT Doctoral School within the first two months of employment.

What we expect

A relevant masters degree is required. Depending on your chosen research topic, your educational background may relate to energy engineering, building services engineering, mechanical engineering, civil engineering, complex systems, automation and control engineering, computer science, data science, computational science, applied mathematics, thermal engineering, or a related field.

We expect you to have strong interest in your chosen research area and an academic background that supports it. Depending on the topic, experience in scientific programming, computational modelling, CFD, building energy modelling, data-driven methods, optimisation, control, statistical or probabilistic modelling, or related quantitative methods is considered an advantage. The role requires commitment to completing your doctoral studies within their normative timeframe. We value strong academic writing skills and motivation to contribute to high-quality scientific publications during your doctoral studies. Written and spoken fluency in English is required, and other language skills are considered an asset.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are essential. You should be able to work independently, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate effectively in an international research environment. Prior scientific publications are not required but are considered an advantage. Previous research experience is beneficial but not required, and motivated early-career candidates are encouraged to apply. Commitment to responsible and ethical research practices is essential.

As the LUT Civil Engineering is just being established, you should be comfortable operating in an evolving environment where uncertainty and change are part of everyday work.

What we offer

The employment relationship starts with a one-year term. The contract may be extended by three years if your progress in your studies and research in the first year is satisfactory. The employment begins with a six-month trial period.

The work starts as soon as possible, and the start date is negotiable. The position follows a system of 1,612 annual working hours in accordance with the collective agreement for Finnish universities.

The salary is set according to the Finnish university pay systems scale for teaching and research staff (requirement level 2). The starting salary is approximately EUR 3,100 per month.

Please submit your application by 4 October 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish local time, UTC+3).

For more information, please contact Assistant Professor Xiaolei Yuan, xiaolei.yuan@lut.fi.

LUT University | LUT University seeks solutions to global issues with its expertise in technology, business, and social sciences. LUT is a trailblazer in promoting the energy transition and the regenerative use of natural resources and helps build resilient communities, industry, and businesses through data, research, and education. LUT's campuses are in Lappeenranta and Lahti, Finland, but its impact is global.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in fairness in artificial intelligence
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in fairness in artificial intelligence, available at the Department of Informatics, in the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group.

Starting date as soon as possible/by agreement. The fellowship period is three (3) years.

Depending on the candidate and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended with a fourth year for compulsory work consisting of e.g., teaching and supervision duties and research assistance.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is the Department of Informatics at Blindern, Oslo. 


Project description

The PhD fellow will be affiliated with the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group at the Department of Informatics and supervised by associate professor Anne-Marie George.

We are looking for a motivated and academically strong candidate to work on a project within fairness in artificial intelligence and machine learning. The candidate will investigate how to formally define, measure and reconcile different, at times conflicting, notions of fairness in AI systems, as well as the theoretical relationships between them.

Possible directions for the project include (the final scope will be developed together with the candidate, and it is not necessary to cover all topics):

  • Group fairness: developing and analysing algorithms and metrics for ensuring fair treatment of groups defined by protected attributes (e.g. gender, age, ethnicity, …).
  • Theoretical relations between fairness notions: studying the mathematical relationships, trade-offs, and impossibility results connecting different fairness definitions.
  • Intersectional fairness: exploring fairness guarantees for combinations of multiple protected attributes, and addressing the challenges of subgroup fairness, such as computational complexity, statistical reliability and data sparsity for fine-grained subgroups.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in informatics/computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented competence in machine learning at Master level
  • Documented programming skills
  • Minimum three documented mathematics or statistics courses with passing grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 30.11.2026 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Programming experience, e.g. in Python, particularly for machine learning
  • Experience with machine learning theory, evaluation metrics, algorithmic fairness, statistics, or optimization is an advantage

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see:
http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Strong analytical skills and critical thinking
  • Enthusiasm, creativity, self-motivation, perseverance and initiative
  • Ability to take responsibility for your work — including troubleshooting, acquiring additional skills and asking for help when needed

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (including statement of motivation summarizing prior scientific work) + 1-2 pages on research interests and vision for PhD work
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)
  • A complete list of publications and academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Master's thesis. If your thesis has not yet been completed, upload a draft version.
  • Documentation of English proficiency The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of ENglish language proficiency has been submitted
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Informatics (IFI) is one of nine departments belonging to the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. IFI is Norway’s largest university department for general education and research in Computer Science and related topics. 

The Department has more than 1800 students on bachelor level, 600 master students, and over 240 PhDs and postdocs. The overall staff of the Department is close to 370 employees, about 280 of these in full time positions. The full time tenured academic staff is 75, mostly Full/Associate Professors.

The position follows a system of 1,612 annual working hours in accordance with the collective agreement for Finnish universities.

The salary is set according to the Finnish university pay systems scale for teaching and research staff (requirement level 2). The starting salary is approximately EUR 3,100 per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

Interested? Please submit your application by 4 October 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish local time, UTC+3). Fill out the online form and attach the following documents in English and in PDF format:

- A motivation letter (one page) highlighting your research skills relevant to the position and describing why you are interested in and suitable for the position

- A curriculum vitae (CV) following the guidelines of the Finnish Advisory Board on Research Integrity: https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae

- Copies of your original bachelors and masters degree certificates and transcripts of records. If the original documents are not in English, Finnish, or Swedish, official certified translations are required

- Contact details of two references

Please also indicate which of the three topics interests you most.

Submit your application well before the deadline to allow time for uploading all attachments. Also, make sure you submit only one application.

Only applications that are submitted through the online recruitment system and include the required documents will be considered. We will review applications on a rolling basis, and the positions will be filled once suitable candidates are found.

For more information, please contact Professor Riikka Kyrö, riikka.kyro@lut.fi.

LUT University | LUT University seeks solutions to global issues with its expertise in technology, business, and social sciences. LUT is a trailblazer in promoting the energy transition and the regenerative use of natural resources and helps build resilient communities, industry, and businesses through data, research, and education. LUT's campuses are in Lappeenranta and Lahti, Finland, but its impact is global.

jobs.title: Autovuokraamotyöntekijä Turku
jobs.description:
Olemme Hertz, maailmanlaajuinen johtava autovuokraamo. Toimimme n. 150 maassa ja 8300 toimipisteessä. Vuokraamme erikokoisia autoja henkilö- ja pakettiautoista minibusseihin. Toiminnassamme pyrimme minimoimaan ympäristöhaitat ja olemme siinä edelläkävijä myös Suomessa. Kalustoomme kuuluukin hybridejä, plug-in hybridejä sekä täyssähköautoja. Meillä pääset työskentelemään yhteisöllisessä ja kehittyvässä työympäristössä osana kansainvälisesti tunnettua yhtiötä.

Etsimme nyt Turun alueelle autovuokraamotyöntekijää. Työtehtävät ovat monipuolisia ja koostuvat asiakaspalvelusta sekä operatiivisista toiminnoista, kuten mm. autojen pesuista, siirroista, vauriotarkastuksista ja luovuttamisesta asiakkaille.
Työtä tehdään aamu- ja iltavuorossa, arkisin 7:00–19:00 välisenä aikana. Työtehtäviin kuuluu myös ajoittaisia päivystys- ja viikonloppuvuoroja.
Toivomme sinun olevan nopea omaksumaan uusia asioita ja työmenetelmiä, oma-aloitteinen, joustava ja yhteistyökykyinen. Tulet hyvin toimeen ihmisten kanssa, etkä hätkähdä nopeatempoista työtä tai uusia ja välillä haastaviakin tilanteita. Olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen ja tulet sujuvasti toimeen kotimaisen kielen lisäksi ainakin englannin kielellä. Muu kielitaito on hyödyksi. Olethan vähintään 18-vuotias ja omistat voimassa olevan ajokortin. Jos kuvaus osui sinuun, saatat hyvinkin olla kohta yksi meistä.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
- Kansainvälisen työilmapiirin
- Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävien laadukkaaseen hoitamiseen
- Tuntipalkan kokemuksen mukaan, alkaen 13,07 €/h
- Loistavan lisäansainta mahdollisuuden tiimitavoitteiden ja henkilökohtaisten suoritepalkkioiden muodossa
- Lounas- ja liikuntaedun
- Mukavat työkaverit sekä loistavan mahdollisuuden kehittää itseään asiakaspalvelutehtävissä


Haluaisitko sinä olla osa huikeaa tiimiämme?

Haethan tehtävää viimeistään 27.9.2026 mennessä. Ota kuitenkin huomioon, että haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuaikana ja avoimet työpaikat täytetään mahdollisimman pian. Käytämme rekrytointiprosessin osana videohaastatteluja. Lähetä liitteenä hakemuskirjeesi, CV ja mahdolliset muut liitteet, joissa on kuvattu osaamistasi. Kuulemme mielellämme myös osaamista tukevista harrastuksistasi ja mielenkiinnon kohteistasi.

jobs.title: Vil du være med og ta oss til nye høyder? Vi søker avdelingsleder til Møre
jobs.description:
Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og virksomhet i 13 land. Felles for oss alle er én viktig oppgave: Å få folk trygt hjem hver dag.

I Norge har vi vokst siden oppstarten i 2009, og i dag består vi av over 500 medarbeidere fordelt på 13 avdelinger. Vi leverer sikkerhetstjenester på vei og byggeplasser, og ambisjonene våre er fortsatt store.

Nå ser vi etter en ny avdelingsleder til Møre.

 

Om rollen

Vi er på jakt etter en avdelingsleder som liker å være i front, som brenner for å finne spennende prosjekter og som trives med å spille andre gode. Vi søker en forretningsorientert avdelingsleder som skal lede, videreutvikle og styrke organisasjonen ved vår avdeling. 

Som avdelingsleder vil du ha ansvar for faglig og administrativ ledelse, organisering, utvikling og drift av avdelingens ressurser og kjerneprosesser.

Som avdelingsleder vil du blant annet:

  • Lede og utvikle medarbeidere og arbeidsmiljøet i avdelingen
  • Videreutvikle relasjoner med eksisterende kunder og skape nye muligheter i markedet
  • Sørge for at sikkerhet alltid ligger i fundamentet for alt vi gjør
  • Sikre god drift, kvalitet og lønnsomhet i prosjekter og leveranser

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du trives i møte med kunder og har gjerne erfaring fra bygg - og anleggsbransjen og/eller skiltmyndigheter. Du trives også med nybrottsarbeid og motiveres av å skape vekst. Videre ser vi etter en løsningsorientert person som arbeider strukturert og målrettet, som er en god serviceleder og som har evnen til å inspirere og motivere sine ansatte i en organisasjon som må være fleksibel og handlekraftig for å tilfredsstille kundesegmentet. I vår organisasjon verdsetter vi lokalkunnskap, kompetanse, fleksibilitet, initiativ og handlekraft.

Du er en pålitelig og troverdig person som evner å skape tillit til de rundt deg, lære på eget initiativ, sette deg klare mål og jobbe systematisk mot dem. For oss er det viktig at du er en lagspiller som ikke lar deg vippe av pinnen verken av motgang eller suksess. Da tror vi at vi kan få til utrolig mye bra sammen.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Relevant utdanning, fortrinnsvis innen tekniske fag eller ledelse.
  • Ledererfaring – gjerne fra virksomhet innen bygg–og anleggsbransjen, industri eller fra teknisk prosjektorganisasjon.
  • Prosjekterfaring
  • God forretningsforståelse og et tydelig kundefokus
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig.
  • Førerkort klasse B (BE er ønskelig)

 

Hva vi kan tilby

  • Muligheten til å utvikle en viktig avdeling i et selskap med sterke vekstambisjoner
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo og stor takhøyde
  • Dyktige kolleger som deler kunnskap og heier på hverandre
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Vi tilbyr deg en selvstendig lederrolle hos en offensiv og solid arbeidsgiver. Du får være tett på driften, ha stor påvirkningskraft og jobbe med løsninger som er etterspurt i markedet.

 

Interessert?

Vi vil gjerne høre fra deg. Send oss din søknad og CV.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte Head of Operations Pål Hartvik Johannessen i Ramudden Norge AS på telefon 982 86 367. Alle henvendelser vil bli behandlet konfidensielt.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

jobs.description:
_Asiakkaamme on suomalainen Turussa sijaitseva teollisuuden kunnossapidon vahva ammattilainen ja yritys on perustettu vuonna 1995. Yritys tarjoaa asiakkailleen muun muassa tuotantokoneiden- ja laitteiden asennukset, korjaukset sekä huollot. Tavallisten kunnossapitopalveluiden lisäksi he tarjoavat kokonaisvaltaisia kunnossapidon palvelusopimuksia ja kiinteähintaisia tuotteistettuja palveluita. Yritys tarjoaa myös kiinteistöjen LVIS-palveluita._

Nyt heidän riveissään on paikka automaatioasentajalle. Työnkuva koostuu teollisuuden sähköautomaatiolaitteiden asennus-, kytkentä- ja huoltotöistä. Tämän lisäksi automaatioasentaja vastaa järjestelmien tarkastuksista ja niiden toimivuuden testauksesta. Työ on osaltaan liikkuvaa, joten valittavan henkilön tulee olla valmis liikkumaan myös eri asiakkaiden toimipisteisiin. Tämän vuoksi vaadimme hakijalta B-ajokorttia.

Hakijalta odotamme aikaisempaa työkokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, sähkö- tai automaatioalan koulutusta sekä kokemusta sähkö- ja automaatioalan asennuksista. Tulevan sähköautomaatioasentajan tulee olla oma-aloitteinen, itseohjautuva sekä motivoitunut ja aidosti kiinnostunut alasta. Työntekijältä vaaditaan voimassa olevia tulityö-, työturvallisuus- ja EA-kortteja.

Työt alkavat mahdollisimman pian heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Työtä tehdään arkisin päivävuorossa, työaikojen kuitenkin ollessa työskentelykohteista riippuen joustavia. Työkielenä käytetään suomea, joten suomen kielen taito on ehdoton.

TYÖKUUTIO!

Olemme asiakkaidemme taustavoima rekrytoinneissa sekä olemme työntekijöidemme tukena koko työsuhteen ajan. Tavoitteenamme on yhdistää työntekijät uusiin työpaikkoihin. Meillä on työmahdollisuuksia opiskelijoille, alan vaihtajille, kesätyöntekijöille sekä jo kokeneille osaajille! Voit lukea meistä sekä kauttamme tarjottavista työntekijöiden eduista lisää www.tyokuutio.fi.
