Salessa myyjän työtehtävät ovat monipuolisia ja niihin kuuluvat muun muassa asiakaspalvelu, kassatyö, hyllytys, robotilauksien kerääminen sekä yleinen järjestely ja siivous. Työskentely on nopeatempoista ja vaatii kykyä hypätä työtehtävästä toiseen. Työhön sisältyy myös hetkiä, jolloin työskentelet vuorossa yksin, joten edellytämmekin sinulta täysi-ikäisyyttä. Olet saletisti etsimämme myyjä, mikäli viihdyt sosiaalisessa ja itsenäisessä työssä, sekä toivotat tervehtimällä ja olemuksellasi asiakkaat tervetulleeksi myymälään. Pidät tiimin kanssa myymälän hyvässä kunnossa ja tartut oma-aloitteisesti kaikkiin työtehtäviin. Eduksi katsomme aiemman työkokemuksen myyjän tehtävistä ja yksintyöskentelystä. jobs.title: Expert Meta Ads Freelance -  % Télétravail (H/F)
jobs.description: À propos de la mission Nous recherchons un(e) Freelance Meta Ads Specialist expérimenté(e) pour piloter et optimiser les campagnes d'acquisition digitale de nos clients, principalement des TPE et PME. La mission couvre l'ensemble du cycle Meta Ads, de l'audit et la définition de la stratégie jusqu'à la création, au lancement et à l'optimisation continue des campagnes sur Facebook et Instagram, avec une approche résolument orientée performance, conversions et rentabilité. Vos responsabilités Stratégie & Audit Meta Ads Auditer les comptes publicitaires existants et identifier rapidement les opportunités d'amélioration. Définir les stratégies d'acquisition en fonction des objectifs, du marché et du budget de chaque client. Structurer les comptes et campagnes afin de maximiser leur efficacité. Définir les audiences, objectifs de campagne et parcours de conversion adaptés. Création & Gestion des Campagnes Créer, paramétrer et gérer des campagnes Facebook Ads et Instagram Ads via Meta Ads Manager. Piloter des campagnes de génération de leads, trafic, conversions, ventes et retargeting. Construire et optimiser les audiences : ciblage, Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences et retargeting. Structurer les campagnes, ensembles de publicités et annonces. Définir les angles publicitaires et recommandations créatives adaptés aux différentes audiences. Tester différents formats, messages, visuels, vidéos et appels à l'action. Budget & Optimisation Piloter les budgets et stratégies d'enchères. Identifier les campagnes, audiences, placements et créations les plus performants. Mettre en place des A/B tests et expérimentations afin d'améliorer continuellement les résultats. Analyser la fréquence, le coût d'acquisition et la fatigue créative. Ajuster les investissements en fonction des performances et des objectifs de rentabilité. Tracking & Analytics Mettre en place, vérifier et optimiser le Meta Pixel. Maîtriser les problématiques liées à la Conversions API (CAPI) et au tracking server-side. Utiliser Google Analytics 4 et Google Tag Manager pour compléter l'analyse des performances. Vérifier la qualité et la fiabilité du tracking des événements et conversions. Comprendre les problématiques d'attribution entre Meta et les autres canaux d'acquisition. Performance & ROI Suivre les principaux KPI : CPM, CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, taux de conversion et ROAS. Analyser les performances et transformer les données en actions concrètes. Identifier les audiences, campagnes et créations générant les meilleurs résultats. Concevoir des reportings clairs orientés performance, conversions et ROI. Fournir des recommandations concrètes et priorisées pour chaque client. Assurer une veille régulier/ière sur les évolutions de Meta Ads et les nouvelles fonctionnalités de la plateforme. Profil recherché Expérience : expérience solide et démontrable dans la gestion et l'optimisation de campagnes Meta Ads, idéalement sur plusieurs secteurs d'activité. Meta Ads : excellente maîtrise de Meta Ads Manager et de la gestion de campagnes Facebook et Instagram. Acquisition : bonne compréhension des stratégies de génération de leads, conversion et retargeting. Tracking : bonne maîtrise du Meta Pixel, des événements de conversion et bonne compréhension de la Conversions API. Analytics : bonne connaissance de Google Analytics 4 et Google Tag Manager. jobs.title: Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP (H/F)

Langues Anglais professionnel obligatoire ; La maîtrise de l'allemand constitue un réel atout ; Le français est indispensable.

Stratégie : capacité à construire une véritable stratégie éditoriale au-delà de la simple publication de contenus. Analytics : capacité à analyser les performances Social Media et à transformer les résultats en recommandations concrètes. Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation. Garantir l'intégration de la sécurité dès la conception (security by design), ainsi que l'application des bonnes pratiques de résilience, de continuité, de sauvegarde, de conformité et de gouvernance. Piloter la standardisation et l'industrialisation des plateformes via l'Infrastructure as Code, l'automatisation, les pratiques DevOps/GitOps et les pipelines de déploiement. Définir et faire appliquer les architectures de référence pour les environnements cloud native, incluant les aspects de déploiement, d'observabilité, de logging, de gestion des secrets, de sécurité et de cycle de vie des plateformes. Apporter une expertise d'architecture sur les sujets PaaS, plateformes conteneurisées, intégration applicative, services managés et écosystèmes open source liés au cloud native. Jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de delivery, d'avant-vente et des clients, afin de sécuriser les choix techniques et de favoriser l'adoption des solutions définies. Assurer une veille technologique active et proposer des évolutions pertinentes sur les services OVH, Clever Cloud, les technologies cloud native et les approches d'automatisation afin d'enrichir les offres et les plateformes de DEEP. Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Tehtävä on vakituinen ja osa-aikainen 30 tuntia viikossa. Työt olisi tarkoitus aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Vastuumyyjänä varmistat kaupan arjen sujuvuuden ja asiakastyytyväisyyden yhdessä marketpäällikön ja apulaispäällikön kanssa. S-marketissa työtehtäväsi ovat monipuolisia ja niihin kuuluvat muun muassa asiakaspalvelu, kassatyö, hyllytys, ruokatilauksien kerääminen, sekä yleinen järjestely ja siivous. Vastuumyyjänä priorisoit työtehtäviä ja organisoit vuoroa, sekä varmistat että tieto kulkee vuorojen välillä. Työtä tehdään vaihtelevissa vuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin. Työaika sijoittuu kello 5.30-23.10 välille.

Olet etsimämme vastuumyyjä, jos olet asiakaslähtöinen sekä toimit luontevasti tiimissä ja yksin. Pystyt johtamaan vuoroa ja huolehdit myymälän kunnosta. Olet tehokas ja motivoitunut työntekijä, joka tarttuu oma-aloitteisesti eri työtehtäviin ja haluat innolla oppia uutta. Edellytämme sinulta aiempaa työkokemusta myyjän työstä ja eduksi katsomme myös kokemuksen vastuutehtävistä.

Vastuumyyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen palkkaryhmään B sekä tehtäväkohtaiseen vaativamman työn lisään. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 11,33-15,15 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager TLM Platform
jobs.description:
The Problem

36 million businesses in America need insuranceâit's not optional. 77% are underinsured. 40% have no coverage at all. The distribution system failed them: too slow, too opaque, too confusing.

Over 90% of commercial insurance is still human-led. We're building the inverse: 90%+ AI-led, pushing toward the higher 90s. Not by patching legacy workflowsâby building AI that makes humans more effective, improves the customer experience, and eliminates friction at every step.

We're adding ~1,000 customers per month. We've grown 100x since last year. We're looking to do even more this yearâand that's why we're hiring.

You'll build the team and the systems the rest of engineering depends on. When they compound, everyone gets faster.

The Thesis

Harper runs 200+ services across Railway and AWS. We orchestrate N parallel agentic workloads. Our AI systems make thousands of decisions a day, and every decision needs to be traceable, evaluated, and cheaper to run tomorrow than it is today. The infrastructure underneath all of that is the difference between a company that scales and one that stalls.

Great platform engineering here isn't invisibleâit's the reason product ships fast. When observability catches a silent failure before a customer does. When a pooling layer makes connection exhaustion a non-issue. When developer velocity doubles because someone built the tool nobody knew they needed. That leverage compounds across every other engineer on the team.

The Role

This role is open both to an experienced EM and to someone on the path to becoming an EM who doesn't yet have significant management experienceâwe're happy to bring that person on and support the transition.

This is a team that still needs to be built. We have 2 people in it today, and we believe this area needs significant investment at Harper. The role owns three things: infrastructure (cloud, third-party vendors, and everything surrounding it), developer productivity (making sure we're genuinely an AI-first shop, with the right AI tooling and harnesses in place for every other engineering team to be successful), and SRE and production support (production discipline is top of mind as we head into a high-growth, high-scale phaseâwe need someone who has run an SRE function before). Each of these three areas can grow into a larger team of its own over time.

The team is 2 people today, growing to five to six over the next three months. Because the team is small, whoever takes this roleâEM or TLMâwill need to be hands-on at the start, working directly with the team and doing the work themselves.

What You'll Do

  • Own infrastructure â cloud, third-party vendors, and everything surrounding it

  • Build developer productivity â the AI tooling and harnesses that make every other engineering team genuinely AI-first

  • Own SRE and production support â bring production discipline as we head into a high-growth, high-scale phase

  • Build out the team â grow from 2 people to five to six over the next three months

  • Stay hands-on â with a team this small, work directly alongside your engineers and do the work yourself, not just direct it

  • Grow each function over time â infrastructure, developer productivity, and SRE/production support can each become a larger team of its own

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • Have at least 2 years as a line manager directly managing teams of six to ten peopleâor clear readiness to grow into that role

  • You've been a line manager for at least two years, directly managing teams of six to ten peopleâor you're on a clear path there and want to grow into it

  • You have hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and strong database troubleshooting skills

  • You've seen real scaleâon the order of at least a million requests per minute

  • You can troubleshoot across databases, networking, compute, Docker, Kubernetes, and other aspects of infrastructure

  • You care as much about developer productivity and AI tooling as you do about raw infrastructure

  • You know on-call practices, SLAs, SLOs, and SRE practices generally

  • You want to stay hands-on and grow into a fuller managerial role over time

  • You move fast, with the same appetite as the rest of Harper

Nice to Have

  • Your own network to draw on for hiringâotherwise, comfort working closely with recruiters

  • Experience building developer productivity tooling and AI harnesses for other engineering teams

  • Experience building a team from a very small base

  • Prior startup experienceâespecially at a company scaling through hypergrowth

Compensation & Logistics

  • Salary: $225,000â$275,000

  • Location: San Francisco, in-office. Based in SF or willing to relocate.

  • Schedule: MondayâFriday, in-office five days a week.

  • Benefits: Uber commuter benefits; breakfast, lunch, and dinner provided; snacks, drinks, and coffee daily; free gym membership; health, dental, and vision insurance.

The Process

  1. Hiring Manager screen - 30 min video chat.

  2. Technical screen â 60 min remote: project deep dive + system design

  3. Super Day on-site â meet the team, sit in on the operation, do real work alongside us.

jobs.title: Public Sector Strategic Account Executive, Federal Civilian
Duty Manager Passenger Assistance (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Duty Manager Passenger Assistance (m/f/x)

Missions :

Assurer la préparation des opérations et la planification journalière des ressources nécessaires à l'activité
Contrôler le respect du planning et enregistrer les changements de personnel selon les procédures en vigueur. Selon les besoins de l'opération et les requêtes individuelles procéder aux ajustements du planning à court terme
Transmettre l'information et les directives nécessaires aux équipes du Ground Handling pour le bon déroulement des opérations et suivre les statuts des vols afin d'anticiper toute éventualité
Etre l'interlocuteur privilégié avec les autres services ainsi qu'avec les représentants des compagnies tierces
Signaler toute irrégularité et établir le srapport quotidien de fin de tournée
Proposer des actions correctives afin d'améliorer la qualité du service
Etre en étroite collaboration avec le Manager Passenger Assistance afin de participer au développement et suivi des ressources. Coordonner les besoins spécifiques/individuels avec le département Formation
Gérer les irrégularités du réseau Luxair et LuxairTours au départ et à l'arrivée de toutes les stations desservies en collaboration avec l'OCC et coordonner les plans d'actions avec les équipes et prestataires concernés
Rapporter toute anomalie à la Direction du Ground Handling

Profil requis:

Critères minimaux requis pour le poste

Etre détenteur d'un diplôme de fin d'études secondaires au Luxembourg ou équivalent
Maîtriser l'anglais, le français et/ou l'allemand (parlé & écrit)
Etre orienté clients, avoir une présentation soignée et respecter les procédures du port d'uniforme
Avoir une expérience confirmée de l'Assistance Passager ainsi que de l'encadrement d'équipes opérationnelles
Maintenir la stricte confidentialité des données
Etre précis, avoir le sens de l'organisation et des priorités et une grande résistance au stress
Savoir travailler de manière autonome et en équipe
Travail sur tournées
Le luxembourgeois et toute autre langue sera considérée comme un atout majeur à ce poste

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Profile

Ensure the preparation of operations and the daily planning of the resources required for the activity.
Monitor compliance with the schedule and record staff changes in accordance with the applicable procedures. Based on operational requirements and individual requests, make short-term adjustments to the schedule as necessary.
Communicate the information and instructions required by the Ground Handling teams to ensure the smooth running of operations, and monitor flight statuses in order to anticipate any potential issues.
Act as the main point of contact with other departments as well as with representatives of third-party airlines.
Report any irregularities and prepare the daily end-of-shift report.
Propose corrective actions to improve service quality.
Work closely with the Passenger Assistance Manager to contribute to the development and monitoring of resources.
Coordinate specific and individual needs with the Training Department.
Manage irregularities affecting the Luxair and LuxairTours network, both on departure and arrival at all stations served, in cooperation with the OCC, and coordinate action plans with the relevant teams and service providers.
Report any anomalies to Ground Handling Management.

Minimum Requirements

Hold a Luxembourg secondary school leaving diploma or an equivalent qualification.
Have a good command of English, French and/or German, both spoken and written.
Be customer-oriented, maintain a professional appearance and comply with uniform-wearing procedures.
Have proven experience in Passenger Assistance as well as in supervising operational teams.Maintain strict confidentiality of information and data.
Be accurate, well-organised, able to prioritise effectively and highly stress-resistant.
Be able to work both independently and as part of a team.
Be willing to work shifts.
Luxembourgish and any other additional language will be considered a major asset for this position.

Requisition ID:  1684612

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Personal Tax Compliance Senior Consultant

We're looking for our new colleague who will be part of our People Advisory Services team

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we're using the finance products, expertise and systems we've developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we'll make our ambition to be the best employer by 2026 a reality.

• In line with our corporate culture, we support you in developing your potential by focusing on topics of diversity, opportunity equality, life balance, further training and internationality
• Gain experience - we want you to experience more at EY and for you to gain new insights within one of the leading audit and consulting companies.
• Foster your development - You will explore our exciting working environment, receive individual mentoring and benefit from getting to know the broad spectrum of our clients
• Building a Network - make valuable contacts for your further career and get to know colleagues with different skills, educational and geographical backgrounds. You will discover: The ways of working and thinking in a global company are diverse!

The opportunity

Within PAS (People Advisory Services) we assist and help companies move talent across the globe. We help our clients put the right talent, with the right capabilities, doing the right things for the right cost in the right place. At EY you can expand your skills and learn about all aspects of global mobility. We'll provide the global scale, personal support, inclusive culture and technology to help you grow, lead and learn.

We are a global network with more than 11,000 employees in more than 130 countries, offering deep industry knowledge and experience to more than 2,000 corporate clients worldwide.  

EY's Luxembourg People Advisory Services (PAS) team is an integrated practice of tax, immigration, social security, payroll and reward professionals working for a very diverse range of clients.

Your key responsibilities

As a senior consultant, your client portfolio will include both large international companies as well as strategic growth market clients. You will be part of an integrated Human Capital practice providing global mobility services on individual income tax, social security, immigration as well as other related services

In your role, you will produce work of high quality in a consistent way. Furthermore, you will motivate other team members to do the same and you will receive the necessary guidance enabling you to supervise and lead your team throughout the next level of your career.

Skills and attributes for success

jobs.title: PINTOR À PISTOLA DE SUPERFÍCIES
jobs.description:
A Requintasfalto Lda pretende admitir um profissional de pintura automóvel para reforço da sua equipa.

Procura-se candidato com experiência profissional na área da pintura automóvel e capacidade para executar de forma autónoma as diferentes etapas do processo de preparação e pintura de viaturas.

As principais funções incluem preparação de superfícies para pintura, lixagem, aplicação de betumes e primários, preparação e afinação de tintas, aplicação de tinta e verniz, pintura em cabine, polimento, acabamentos finais e correção de imperfeições.

Pretende-se um profissional responsável, assíduo, pontual, cuidadoso e com atenção ao detalhe, com capacidade de trabalho em equipa e autonomia na execução das tarefas.

Valoriza-se experiência comprovada na função, bons conhecimentos técnicos de pintura automóvel e disponibilidade para entrada imediata ou a curto prazo.

jobs.title: KUĆNI MAJSTOR/KUĆNA MAJSTORICA
jobs.description:
Obavlja jednostavnije poslove održavanja i popravke: instalacije, elektroinstalacije, 
vodovodne instalacije, grijanje i druge poslove u hotelu. 
 
Izvršava sve radove na preventivnom i tekućem održavanju postrojenja. 
Vodi evidenciju o primljenom i utrošenom materijalu. 
Dužan je voditi knjigu izvršenih radova s unošenjem podataka o vremenu i vrsti posla 
koji je izvršen, te popis vrsta i količina utrošenog materijala ili rezervnih dijelova. 
Sudjeluje u godišnjem remontu strojeva i instalacija. 
 
Odgovoran je za primjenu mjera zaštite na radu, zaštite od požara na objektima, 
instalacijama, strojevima i uređajima, te za zaštitu okoliša hotela. 
Svakodnevno kontrolira Knjigu kvarova i vodi računa o njihovom promptnom 
uklanjanju. 
Predlaže voditelju poboljšanje sustava održavanja i ukazuje na stanje zaliha 
materijala ili rezervnih dijelova. 
Savjesno se odnosi prema opremi i sredstvima rada. 
Vodi tehničku dokumentaciju i potrebne evidencije. 
Sudjeluje u nabavci potrošnog materijala i rezervnih dijelova. 
Održava čistoću i urednost radnog prostora i strojeva. 
Kontrolira i primjenjuje mjere i sredstva zaštite na radu. 
Obavlja i ostale poslove po nalogu rukovoditelja.         
 
poželjno radno iskustvo na istim ili sličnim poslovima 
rad na neodređeno sa probnim rokom

jobs.title: SPECIJALIST/SPECIJALISTICA  ODRŽAVANJA STROJEVA I ELEKTRO OPREME
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLA:

ONO ŠTO NA OVOM RADNOM MJESTU OČEKUJEMO OD VAS:

  • održavanje strojeva i elektro opreme
  • nadzor rada transformatorskih stanica i manevriranje EE postrojenjem
  • izrada i popravak elektro i komunikacijskih instalacija
  • održavanje instalacije vanjske rasvjete
  • obavljanje intervencije i preventivno održavanje strojeva, instalacija i opreme u proizvodnom pogonu
  • obavljanje remonta strojeva u okviru procijenjenih tehničkih sposobnosti
  • otklanjanje kvarova u automatiziranim procesima
  • otkrivanje neispunjenih uvjeta PLC-a, simulacija ulaza i provjera ispravnosti, ispitivanje analogno/digitalnih izlaza
  • održavanje higijene strojeva, alata i radnih površina
  • poštivanje organizacije rada u odjelu
  • obavještavanje odgovorne osobe o svim uočenim nesukladnostima i događajima koji mogu imati negativan utjecaj na kvalitetu, sigurnost hrane, okoliš i energiju
  • korištenje korisničke dokumentacije prilikom održavanja strojeva i opreme kako bi svi radovi bili obavljeni prema uputama proizvođača, te propisima i pravilima struke
  • evidentiranje aktivnosti u aplikaciju i ispunjavanje dokumentacije prema interno propisanim procedurama

ŠTO NUDIMO I ŠTO MOŽETE OČEKIVATI OD NAS:

  • mentora pri uvođenju u posao
  • dodatna usavršavanja prema zahtjevima radnog mjesta
  • mogućnost napredovanja
  • nagrade za radne rezultate
  • prigodne nagrade (uskrsnica, regres, božićnica, dar za djecu)
  • naknadu za troškove prijevoza
  • osiguran topli obrok
  • osiguranu radnu odjeću i obuću
  • liječnički i sanitarni pregled na trošak poslodavca
  • plaćene dopuste za životna događanja kao što su sklapanje braka, rođenje djeteta, preseljenje i sl.
  • timski rad u ugodnom i dinamičnom radnom okruženju
  • rad u uspješnoj kompaniji, prepoznatljivog brenda i snažne tržišne pozicije
  • društveno odgovorno okruženje

    VI STE KANDIDAT ZA NAS AKO IMATE:

  • SSS (poželjan smjer: elektromehaničar / elektrotehničar / tehničar za električne strojeve s primijenjenim računalstvom / mehatroničar)
  • radno iskustvo na istim ili sličnim poslovima (poželjno, ali nije uvjet)
  • osnovno znanje engleskog jezika
  • osnovno znanje rada na računalu (MS Office)
  • proaktivnost
  • sposobnost rada u timu
  • želju za učenjem i usavršavanjem
  • tveno odgovorno okruženje

jobs.title: SPREMAČ/SPREMAČICA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE Belvedere iz Rijeke, Kozala 41, raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjene sljedećih radnih mjesta 5) 1 spremač/ica - 40 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena, na neodređeno radno vrijeme TRAŽENI UVJETI:
  • Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnom školstvu (NN 6/19);
  • Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.).
Za radna mjesta potrebno je poznavanje talijanskog jezika na razini materinjeg jezika (osim radnog mjesta br.5). Za radna mjesta mjesta provesti će se psihologijsko testiranje, poznavanje talijanskog jezika te intervju. Povrh navedenih provjera vršiti će se i vrednovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija od strane Povjerenstva za vrednovanje kandidata sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE Belvedere u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Uz potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti životopis, diplomu, dokaz o državljanstvu, elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a i uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi istražni ili kazneni postupak ne stariji od šest (6) mjeseci. Kandidati koji su stekli inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužni su također dostaviti: rješenje određenog visokog učilišta o priznavanju potpune istovrijednosti u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju istovrijednosti stranih školskih svjedodžbi i diploma ili rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje o stručnom priznavanju inozemne visokoškolske kvalifikacije u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija, rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Kandidati koji ističu posjedovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija dokumentaciji prilažu i dokaze za iste i to: uvjerenje ili certifikat, ili potvrda, ili svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava, ili osobna izjava kandidata ovjerena od javnog bilježnika. Sva dokumentacija dostavlja se u neovjerenoj preslici, odabrani kandidat prije zaključenja ugovora o radu dužan je dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumenata. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi za natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priložiti sve dokaze o priznatom statusu. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Poveznica Ministarstva branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf i https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Pozivi za pojedine faze natječajnog postupka s mjestom i vremenom održavanja te rezultati istih, kao i obavijest o odabiru kandidata biti će objavljeni na stranicama Škole na poveznici: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu selekcijskog postupka, smatrati će se da je povukao prijavu. Kandidat prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka. Prijave je potrebno dostaviti na adresu: Osnovna škola-Scuola elementare Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Rijeka. Rok za podnošenje prijave je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja. Natječaj se objavljuje na mrežnim stranicama škole i HZZ-a dana 08.09.2026.godine. Nepotpune, nepotpisane i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull'educazione e l’istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione la OŠ-SE Belvedere di Fiume, via Kozala 41, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per i seguenti posti di lavoro 5) 1 bidella - 40 ore settimanali di lavoro, a tempo indeterminato CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE:
  1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e dal Regolamento sulla qualifica e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19 e 74/20);
  2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.).
Per tutti i posti di lavoro in questione è necessario conoscere la lingua italiana a livello di madre lingua (escluso il numero 5) e possono accedere persone di ambedue i sessi. Per i posti di lavoro in questione saranno effettuati test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana e colloqui. Oltre ai suddetti controlli saranno valutate delle qualifiche aggiuntive dalla Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni rispettando le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE Belvedere con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate da dati biografici (CV), da certificato di studio richiesto del Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare, da certificato di cittadinanza, da estratto elettronico o certificato sui dati iscritti nelle evidenze matricolari dell’Ufficio di pensionamento croato e da attestato comprovante l’assenza di condanne penali la cui data di rilascio non deve risultare superiore ai sei (6) mesi. I candidati i quali hanno conseguito una qualifica estera devono inoltre presentare: il decreto d’un ente di educazione superiore con il quale si riconosce una completa equipollenza del titolo di studio secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dell’equipollenza dei titoli di studio esteri o il decreto dell’Agenzia per la scienza ed educazione superiore di riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero ai fini lavorativi secondo la Legge sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri e nei sensi della Legge sule professioni regolamentate e sul riconoscimento dei titoli di studio esteri ai fini lavorativi, il decreto del Ministero della scienze ed educazione sul riconoscimento del titolo di studio estero per i fini di lavoro nelle professioni regolamentate. I candidati i quali dichiarano di possedere delle qualifiche aggiuntive, conoscenze ed educazioni devono presentare dei documenti probatori delle stesse, ovvero: attestati o certificati, conferme, pagelle, documenti pubblici equivalenti o una dichiarazione privata certificata da parte di un notaio pubblico. Tutta la documentazione deve essere presentata sotto forma di fotocopia semplice, mentre il candidato scelto deve presentare i documenti originali prima della firma del contrato di lavoro. I candidati i quali hanno diritto di precedenza secondo regolamenti speciali, devono dichiarare questo diritto e fornire prove che confermino il loro diritto e stato. I suddetti candidati avranno la precedenza di fronte agli altri candidati che hanno le stesse condizioni e qualifiche, ma non usufruiscono di codesto diritto. Il link del Ministero degli veterani: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf e https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Gli inviti per ogni fase della selezione, con il tempo e il posto dove si terranno, come anche i risultati di esse e anche i risultati finali saranno pubblicati sulle pagine web della scuola sul sito: https://os-belvedere-ri.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao Se un candidato non si presenta a una delle fasi di selezione verrà considerato come se avesse ritirato la propria domanda. Secondo il GDPR i candidati con la presentazione della domanda acconsentono alla scuola di conservare e trattare i loro dati personali contenuti nella loro documentazione ai fini di codesto bando di concorso. Le domande devono pervenire al seguente indirizzo: OŠ-SE Belvedere, Kozala 41, 51000 Fiume, entro 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso. Il presente Bando sarà pubblicato sulle pagine web della Scuola e dell’Ufficio di collocamento Croato il giorno 8 settembre 2026. Le domande incomplete, non firmate e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito, non saranno prese in considerazione

Kandidati koji ističu posjedovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija dokumentaciji prilažu i dokaze za iste i to: uvjerenje ili certifikat, ili potvrda, ili svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava, ili osobna izjava kandidata ovjerena od javnog bilježnika. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi za natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priložiti sve dokaze o priznatom statusu. jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE Belvedere iz Rijeke, Kozala 41, raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjene sljedećih radnih mjesta 1) 2 učitelja/ice razredne nastave u produženom boravku – 40 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena, na neodređeno vrijeme TRAŽENI UVJETI:
  1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnom školstvu (NN 6/19);
  2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.).
Za radna mjesta potrebno je poznavanje talijanskog jezika na razini materinjeg jezika (osim radnog mjesta br.5). Povrh navedenih provjera vršiti će se i vrednovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija od strane Povjerenstva za vrednovanje kandidata sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE Belvedere u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Uz potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti životopis, diplomu, dokaz o državljanstvu, elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a i uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi istražni ili kazneni postupak ne stariji od šest (6) mjeseci. Kandidati koji su stekli inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužni su također dostaviti: rješenje određenog visokog učilišta o priznavanju potpune istovrijednosti u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju istovrijednosti stranih školskih svjedodžbi i diploma ili rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje o stručnom priznavanju inozemne visokoškolske kvalifikacije u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija, rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Kandidati koji ističu posjedovanje dodatnih kvalifikacija, znanja i edukacija dokumentaciji prilažu i dokaze za iste i to: uvjerenje ili certifikat, ili potvrda, ili svjedodžba ili druga javna isprava, ili osobna izjava kandidata ovjerena od javnog bilježnika. Sva dokumentacija dostavlja se u neovjerenoj preslici, odabrani kandidat prije zaključenja ugovora o radu dužan je dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumenata. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Senior Manager, EMEA Service Delivery Lead (f/m/d) - EMEA based (IT-Service-Delivery-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Senior Manager, EMEA Service Delivery Lead (f/m/d)  is a regional leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across all EMEA sites, serving Siemens software engineers across Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The Senior Manager directly leads EMEA SD Managers and is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, and execution of global GES programmes within the EMEA region.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Regional Leadership & Operations

- Lead and develop a regional team of SD Managers responsible for engineering support across EMEA sites.- Own regional SLO/SLA performance; ensure targets are met, tracked, and reported consistently.- Drive operational consistency across EMEA sites aligned to global GES standards and Global Operations Excellence (GOE) defined processes.- Act as the primary escalation point for EMEA service issues, customer concerns, and critical incidents.- Ensure CMDB accuracy, asset management, and monitoring compliance across EMEA sites.

Programme Delivery

- Lead EMEA execution of global transformation programmes.- Maintain regional project status, risks, and blockers; provide regular updates to the Global SD Director.- Coordinate with different stakeholders on regional deployments and platform changes.

People Leadership

- Line-manage EMEA SD Managers; set clear objectives, conduct performance reviews, and support career development.- Foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture across geographically dispersed EMEA teams.- Identify talent gaps, succession risks, and training needs within the EMEA SD function.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build strong relationships with EMEA sites stakeholders, business units, and functional managers.- Represent the EMEA region in GES global leadership forums, cross-functional reviews, and planning cycles.- Collaborate with Americas and APAC SD Leads to share best practices and drive global consistency.

Engineering Segment Engagement

- Execute the GES engineering segment engagement model within EMEA; act as the regional point of contact for EMEA segment leads on infrastructure quality, environment needs, and development productivity.- Establish a structured engagement cadence with EMEA engineering segment representatives to gather feedback on CI/CD environments, tooling gaps, and productivity blockers.- Identify and escalate EMEA-specific development environment constraints that impact engineering velocity; collaborate with GOE and Architecture & Standards to drive resolution.- Contribute regional segment insights to GES-wide reporting on developer productivity and service quality.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Substantial relevant experience in service delivery, infrastructure operations, or engineering support, with a demonstrated track record of regional management responsibility across multiple countries.- Proven experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple countries within the EMEA region.- Strong working knowledge of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and service level management practices.- Experience managing escalations, service performance, and operational governance in a complex enterprise environment.- Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional programmes and change within large, matrixed organizations.- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; fluent in English (additional language proficiency is an advantage).- Solid understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle tracking, and software asset inventory across distributed sites.- Practical knowledge of data center operations, including RDC/colocation environments, physical infrastructure management, and capacity oversight.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup frameworks sufficient to manage and govern SD teams responsible for these environments.- Awareness of vulnerability management practices, including coordination with security teams on remediation tracking and compliance obligations across EMEA sites.- Familiarity with software development practices and the SDLC; ability to engage with engineering teams on environment needs and tooling requirements without deep hands-on development experience.- Awareness of CI/CD concepts and pipeline dependencies; sufficient understanding to identify where GES infrastructure is a bottleneck or enabler for engineering delivery.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering or large-scale enterprise infrastructure environments.- Hands-on or supervisory experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack or equivalent platforms).- Exposure to high-performance or grid computing environments — understanding of compute cluster operations, job scheduling, and distributed infrastructure management.- Understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery across EMEA.- Experience managing EMEA-specific regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., data residency, works council processes, GDPR implications for IT operations).- Exposure to software engineering or DevOps environments — direct collaboration with development teams or platform engineering; comfort discussing developer workflow tooling, build pipelines, and environment provisioning.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required at minimum; Managing Professional track highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation — IT governance and control framework awareness.- ISO 27001 awareness — relevant to EMEA regulatory and security compliance considerations.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Foundation or Practitioner.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This role is based in EMEA, with a preference for one of Siemens' DISW established locations.
Regular travel across EMEA sites is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Director, GES Global Service Delivery
Part of: GES Global Service Delivery function, GTI

Why us?
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
The primary locations for this opportunity are Germany, UK and Ireland. The applicable salary ranges for these locations are:
98,000 Min - 171,600 Max EUR (Germany)
82,200 Min – 143,700 Max GBP (UK)
91,500 Min – 155,400 Max EUR (Ireland)
This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate’s job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/ (https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/)

The position is available across multiple EMEA locations; we welcome qualified candidates from locations not mentioned in the description to apply.

jobs.title: Afløser til receptionen søges
jobs.description:
Vi søger en afløser/ studerende til receptionen.

Milling Hotel Ansgar er et charmerende byhotel beliggende i hjertet af Odense, tæt på byens centrum og banegården. Du kan se mere om Milling Hotels, vores hoteller og værdier på www.millinghotels.dk

Vi søger en studerende/ afløser til vores reception. Er du passioneret omkring service og vil du være med til at skabe en nærværende og god oplevelse for vores gæster, så er du måske den, vi leder efter.

Dine vagter vil primært ligge eftermiddag og aften, lige som der vil være faste weekendvagter, hver anden weekend. Du vil indgå i en fast vagtplan. Timetal kan variere fra uge til uge, men gennemsnitligt skal du regne med 10-15 timer per uge. Derudover kan du påregne at skulle hjælpe med ekstra vagter i ferieperioder og ved andet fravær.

Vi tænker, at du har nogen af de rette kvalifikationer, hvis du er:

  • Ansvarsbevidst

  • Fleksibel

  • God service falder naturligt for dig

  • Har godt humør

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Er samtidig teamplayer

  • Du taler og skriver som minimum dansk (ufravigeligt) og engelsk

Vi tilbyder en spændende stilling i et stabilt team, der er præget af høj service og godt samarbejde. 

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et lille team med skønne kolleger, god vagtplan (som udgangspunkt fri hver anden weekend)

Ansøgning: Send din ansøgning og CV til hotelchef Sara Myken smyken@millinghotels.dk. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! Opslaget tages ned, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Kun skriftlige ansøgninger tages i betragtning.

jobs.title: REMONTSTRĀDNIEKS
jobs.description:
Pievienojies mūsu komandai!
Valmieras pirmsskolas izglītības iestāde “Ābelīte” (turpmāk – Iestāde) aicina darbā remontstrādnieku (0,5 darba likmi (20 stundas nedēļā)) uz nenoteiktu laiku. Darba vietas adrese: Palejas iela 5, Valmiera, Valmieras novads.

Ja Tev ir vēlme:
•    veikt slēdzeņu nomaiņu, iekārtu un mēbeļu remontu, krāsošanu, kosmētiskos remontdarbus;
•    veikt aukstā un karstā ūdensvada, kanalizācijas sistēmas ekspluatāciju un remontu;
•    informēt darba devēju par konstatētajiem bojājumiem;

un ja Tev ir:
•    profesionālā vidējā izglītība inženierzinātnēs vai būvniecības jomā;
•    valsts valodas prasmes atbilstoši Valsts valodas likuma prasībām;
•    kompetences: prasme analizēt situāciju un rīcības sekas, atrast piemērotāko risinājumu; komunikācijas un sadarbības prasmes; prasme plānot, organizēt un kvalitatīvi veikt savu darbu; atbildības sajūta, disciplinētība, precizitāte;

mēs piedāvājam:
•    atalgojumu 390 EUR mēnesī pirms nodokļu nomaksas;
•    iespēju saņemt atvaļinājuma pabalstu par labu darba sniegumu;
•    darba devēja līdzfinansētu veselības apdrošināšanu pēc pārbaudes laika beigām, kā arī citas sociālās garantijas/labumus atbilstoši darba rezultātam un normatīvajos aktos noteiktajam.

Pieteikuma vēstuli, profesionālās darbības aprakstu (CV), lūdzam iesniegt elektroniski, nosūtot uz e-pastu abelite@valmiera.edu.lv ar norādi “Remontstrādnieka vakancei” līdz 2026.gada 25.septembrim.

Informējam, ka pieteikuma dokumentā norādītie personas dati tiks apstrādāti, lai nodrošinātu šī atlases konkursa norisi atbilstoši fizisko personu datu aizsardzības regulējuma prasībām.

PhD Candidate in Laser-Induced Graphene (LIG) Sensors for Composite Materials
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

We have a new vacancy for a 3-year PhD position at ASEMlab, NTNU Gjøvik, funded by Horizon Europe projects. The PhD candidate will work with NTNU's laser-induced graphene (LIG) sensing line developing a LIG sensor system for in-situ process monitoring of fibre reinforced composite systems, and maturing it from lab-scale prototypes to integration in demonstrators. The LIG system will be developed and benchmarked alongside complementary sensing technologies. This is a doctorate at the intersection of functional 2D materials, printed electronics, industrial composites manufacturing and structural health monitoring.

The position is hosted by ASEMlab – the Laboratory of Advanced and Sustainable Engineering Materials (www.asemlab.no) at the Department of Manufacturing and Civil Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, NTNU – Norwegian University of Science and Technology, Gjøvik campus. ASEMlab performs research on polymers and composite materials across their full life cycle: advanced manufacturing, structural health monitoring and sensing, non-destructive evaluation, durability and ageing, recycling and circularity, and sustainability assessment. The laboratory operates extensive infrastructure including manufacturing, sensor development, laser systems, thermal and physico-chemical analysis (DMA, TGA, FTIR, dielectric spectroscopy), mechanical and thermomechanical fatigue testing, accelerated ageing facilities, micro-CT, CMM, ultrasound imaging, etc.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


Duties of the position
  • design and fabricate laser-induced graphene sensors and sensor arrays (temperature, strain, pressure) using ASEMlab's laser-processing infrastructure
  • characterise and calibrate the sensors electromechanically, structurally, thermally, morphologically, etc., using advanced analytical techniques, and benchmark them against complementary sensing technologies (e.g. fibre optics)
  • develop the LIG sensor system for process monitoring and structural health monitoring
  • implement the data-acquisition chain and data-import protocols as well as analyze sensor data for different needs 
  • Work closely with interdisciplinary teams of internal and external researchers specializing in sensor technologies, materials science, data analytics, etc.
  • analyze data and publish results in leading international journals and present at conferences, contribute to project deliverables, training workshops and dissemination activities

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme (link), see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in materials science/engineering, electronics/mechatronics, applied physics, nanotechnology, mechanical/manufacturing engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • demonstrated hands-on experience working in a research laboratory environment, including the safe handling of chemicals and operation of scientific instrumentation
  • strong foundational understanding of solid-state physics/chemistry and materials characterization techniques (such as Raman spectroscopy, SEM, or XRD)
  • hands-on experimental skills within sensors or functional/printed materials
  • very good written and oral English skills (documented per NTNU requirements for non-native speakers)
  • proven ability to work independently, manage a research project timeline, and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • experience in the design, fabrication, or characterization of electromechanical sensors, printed/flexible sensors, or graphene/2D and carbon-based functional materials 
  • hands-on experience with laser synthesis, laser micromachining, or optical systems, including CO₂ or UV laser platforms commonly used for LIG fabrication
  • experience with electronics prototyping, instrumentation and data acquisition tools (Python, LabVIEW), electrical characterization hardware (e.g., source meters, potentiostats, impedance analyzers) and basic signal processing, while interest in machine-learning-based process control is a plus
  • knowledge of fibre-reinforced polymer composites and their manufacturing processes
  • experience with electrical/electromechanical characterisation techniques (e.g. impedance spectroscopy, DIC-coupled strain sensing)
  • willingness to travel for test and demonstration campaigns for project needs in Europe 

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • proactive, self-driven, structured and rigorous in experimental work
  • collaborative and team-oriented mindset suited to a university lab and a large industrial consortium with firm deadlines
  • strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • curiosity and ambition to publish at a high international level

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in an international, EU-funded project consortium
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 550 800,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering Science Doctoral Programme - PhD - Faculty of Engineering Science - NTNU within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the regulations in force concerning State Employees and Civil Servants, and the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who, by assessment of the application and attachments, are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment to NTNU.

Please note that the candidate holding the announced position is expected to work with critical infrastructure and areas subject to controls on the export of strategic goods, services and technology. Candidates with the potential of not fulfilling the requirements for security clearance, access clearance and authorization as described in the Act Relating to National Security, the Export Control Act and the Act on the Implementation of International Sanctions (Sanctions Act) cannot be considered for the position.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • CV and certificates/diplomas (BSc and MSc) with grade transcripts; diplomas in other languages must be accompanied by certified English translations
  • a motivation letter (max 2 pages) describing your suitability for and interest in the position
  • MSc thesis (or a draft if not yet completed) and any publications or other relevant research output
  • documentation of English language proficiency (e.g. IELTS/TOEFL) where applicable
  • names and contact details of at least two referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Sotirios Grammatikos, Director of ASEMlab, Department of Manufacturing and Civil Engineering, NTNU Gjøvik. E-mail: sotirios.grammatikos@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Advisor Kristine Rognlid Hagaseth kristine.r.hagaseth@ntnu.no 

Application deadline: 18.09.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 
 

Gjøvik, a charming town by the shores of Lake Mjøsa, is known for its beautiful nature and rich cultural offerings. The town boasts a vibrant community with excellent schools, modern healthcare services, and a variety of recreational activities. With its strategic location, just a short drive from Oslo, Gjøvik combines the best of urban life and natural experiences. Here, you'll find a dynamic business environment and exciting career opportunities in a setting that values work-life balance.

jobs.title: Flytta till Barcelona i vinter!
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av mobila bredbandsabonnemang till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Team Leader Nurse Team
jobs.description:
Lead a Team of Registered Nurses Providing Medical Assistance Worldwide

Are you an inspiring leader who wants to make a difference every day?

At Viking Travel Care, we help travellers who become ill or injured while abroad. From our offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola, Spain, we provide travel and medical assistance services 24/7, 365 days a year to customers and travellers worldwide.

We are now looking for a Team Leader for our Medical Assistance Coordinator (Nurse) team.

Our Nurses are experienced Registered Nurses from the Nordic countries. They assess medical reports, coordinate treatment, communicate with healthcare providers around the world, handle own medical cases, and support travellers during some of life's most challenging moments. They also serve as an important medical resource for colleagues across the Travel Care operation.

As Team Leader, you will have day-to-day personnel responsibility for a team of highly skilled nurses, supporting their development and helping ensure that the Medical Assistance team works in a structured, professional, and reliable way.

You will work closely with Viking Travel Care's Medical Management and Operations Management teams, as well as fellow Team Leaders, to support the continued development of our medical assistance services. In this role, you will act as an important link between the Medical Assistance team and management, helping translate strategic priorities into daily operations, quality improvements, and employee development.

This is a unique opportunity to combine healthcare expertise with people leadership in an international and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

    Personnel responsibility for a team of Medical Assistance Coordinators (nurses)
    

    Conduct performance reviews, development conversations, and regular follow-up meetings
    

    Drive employee engagement, professional development, and competence building within the team
    

    Support recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members
    

    Ensure delivery of agreed service levels, KPIs, and quality standards
    

    Monitor workloads, staffing, and operational priorities
    

    Support daily operations and assist with complex cases when needed
    

    Handle administrative responsibilities such as scheduling, absence follow-up, and workforce planning
    

    Promote high clinical and documentation standards
    

    Ensure compliance with SOPs, routines, and quality requirements
    

    Support the implementation of new processes, routines, and quality initiatives within the Medical Assistance team
    

    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects across Travel Care

Qualifications Required

    Experience from healthcare, medical assistance, travel assistance, insurance, customer service, operations, or another relevant field.
    

    Fluent in one of the Nordic languages and English
    

    Strong communication and interpersonal skills
    

    Comfortable working in a dynamic and international environment
    

    Strong IT skills and ability to quickly learn new systems
    

    Clean criminal record

Preferred

    Relevant experience in people leadership, team coordination, employee development, or similar responsibilities.
    

    Registered Nurse holding a valid nursing licence recognised within the EU, with a minimum of three years of clinical nursing experience
    

    Experience from travel assistance, insurance medicine, emergency care, intensive care, ambulance services, acute care, or similar fields

What can we offer the right candidate?

    Competitive salary and employment conditions
    

    Permanent employment contract under Spanish labour law
    

    Employer-provided laptop and mobile phone
    

    Comprehensive onboarding and training programme
    

    A supportive and collaborative work environment with highly skilled colleagues
    

    Social activities and team events
    

    Modern offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola
    

    The opportunity to work in an international organisation helping travellers worldwide

Are you the one we're looking for?

The right person for this position is a positive and approachable leader who enjoys helping others succeed. You thrive in a dynamic environment, balancing operational priorities with employee development. You are organised, solution-oriented, and focused on creating clear and reliable ways of working for your team. You enjoy working closely with others while also taking ownership and acting independently when needed.

Most importantly, you believe that great customer care starts with strong teamwork, professional judgement, and clear, friendly communication.

About Viking

Viking Assistance Group is a leading roadside and travel assistance company in the Nordics. Viking Travel Care is the group’s travel and medical assistance division, providing assistance services 24 hours a day, 365 days a year to travellers and employees abroad. Across our services, we aim to make assistance easy to access, reliable in delivery, and friendly in every interaction.

Workplace

The position will be based at Viking Travel Care in Torrevieja or Fuengirola, Spain.

Working Hours

The role follows the Team Leader rotation and includes day, evening, and occasional weekend shifts, with flexibility needed to support a 24/7 operation when required.

Start Date

As soon as possible.

Deadline

Please apply before September 30th

jobs.title: Kokenut tarjoilija
jobs.description:
**Tarjoilija, tuukko töihin?**

Etsimme tiimiimme kokemusta jo kerännyttä tarjoilijaa, jolla pysyy käsissä niin useampi AC lautanen, bricka, lisämyynti, baarilusikka kuin isot ryhmät!

Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian ja on viikonloppupainotteista. Tunteja tarjolla noin 50h/3vk, eli mainio lisäduuni!

Meillä pääset tekemään tarjoilijan työtä laajasti; arkisin lounasbuffet, iltaisin ja viikonloppusin A la carte ja lisäksi teemme tilaustarjoilua yhteistyökumppaneille. Meitä Pancholaisia yhdistää rennon rempseä ote työhön, hyväntuulisuus ja huumori niin työkavereiden kuin asiakkaiden kesken, ammattitaitoa ja rautaista asiakaspalvelua sekä myyntiä tietenkään unohtamatta.

Meillä tehdään töitä seuraavien arvojen mukaisesti: Lämmöllä, vahvuuksilla, huumorilla, kannattavasti! Miksi kannattaisi hakea? Nokian Pancho on saavuttanut erittäin hyvät arvosanat ja maineen. Työntekijät kertovat viihtyvänsä meillä erityisesti hyvän työyhteisön ansiosta. Nokian Pancholla pääset nuorekkaaseen, erityisen hyväntuuliseen ja yhteen hiileen puhaltavaan työyhteisöön. Työaika ja palkkaus sovitaan yhdessä. Ole rohkeasti yhteydessä. Voit soittaa tai voidaan sopia tapaaminen mikäli haluat kysyä lisää paikasta.

Would you like to be part of one of Finlands most significant data center construction projects?

jobs.title: Reservedelsekspedient søges til stærkt team hos GLAD Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Brænder du for biler, lagerstyring og kundekontakt? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Hos GLAD Kalundborg har vi brug for en ny kollega i vores reservedels- og eftermarkedsteam, og vi søger derfor en dygtig og ansvarsbevidst reservedelsekspedient, der kan indgå i vores stærke team – og være med til at sikre høj kvalitet og professionel kundeservice i hverdagen.

Vores reservedelsafdeling er et centralt bindeled mellem værksted, salg og vores mange eksterne kunder – og du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at de rigtige reservedele er på rette sted, på rette tid.

 

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

  • Ekspedition af reservedele og tilbehør/ekstraudstyr til mekanikere og pladesmede på værkstedet

  • Salg af reservedele og tilbehør/ekstraudstyr til eksterne kunder i forretningen og på telefon

  • Bestilling og indkøb af reservedele

  • Drift og opfølgning på vores online reservedelswebshops sammen med vores eget webbureau – Glad Creative

  • Varemodtagelse og lagerstyring

  • Fakturering og øvrig administrativ opfølgning

  • Ad hoc-opgaver som lageroptælling og vedligeholdelse af reservedelsområdet

Personprofil:

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra en lignende stilling – f.eks. som reservedelsekspedient, lagermedarbejder eller teknisk salgsassistent

  • Arbejder struktureret, har blik for detaljen og kan lide at holde orden

  • Er serviceminded, nysgerrig og sætter en ære i at hjælpe både kunder og kolleger

  • Trives med at være bindeled mellem kolleger, kunder og leverandører

  • Er imødekommende, lærenem og positiv i din tilgang

  • Har kørekort (B) – og det er et plus, hvis du har truckcertifikat

  • Har flair for IT og gerne kendskab til autobranchen

 

Vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende og alsidig hverdag i en moderne bilforretning med høj faglighed

  • Et stærkt og uformelt team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det godt sammen

  • En arbejdsplads med gode muligheder for udvikling

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer, pensionsordning efter overenskomst og sundhedsforsikring

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer – med opstart snarest

  

Ansøgning:

Har du lyst til at blive en del af reservedelsteamet hos Glad Kalundborg?

Så send din ansøgning, dit CV og eventuelle bilag til autoforhandler Jacob Glad på jg@glad.dk

Ansøg med det samme for vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og lukker stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet den rette. Hvis du vil vide mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte reservedelschef Bo Sørensen på tlf. 50 60 57 23.

Læs mere om os og find jobannoncen for denne stilling på glad.dk/job

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

Bilcentret Peer Glad A/S | Slagelsevej 88 | 4400 Kalundborg

Tlf. 59511064 | glad.dk | glad@glad.dk

Bilcentret Peer Glad A/S består af ca. 40 passionerede kolleger, der alle arbejder med en stærk vision og et stærkt værdisæt i et topmoderne bilhus. Matematiklærer

Fysiklærer

Derudover søger vi en fysiklærer til et længerevarende vikariat på ca. 1 år.

Også denne stilling kan være både på deltid og fuldtid. For den rette kandidat kan der være mulighed for fastansættelse efter vikariatet.

Vi søger dig, som

  • Har erfaring med undervisning i udskolingen

  • Har stærke faglige kompetencer inden for matematik eller fysik

  • Er stabil, engageret og god til at skabe struktur i undervisningen

  • Kan indgå naturligt i skolens eksisterende team

  • Har gode danskkundskaber i både tale og skrift

Varighed:
Matematik: ca.6 måneder
