jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in the field of Special Needs Education
jobs.description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three to four-year full-time position as PhD Research Fellow in Special Needs Education, based at the Department of Special Needs Education, Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo.

We invite applications for doctoral projects within the broad field of counselling in special needs education. Counselling is a central component of special needs education and contributes to promoting participation, inclusion, learning, and well-being among children, young people, and adults with special educational needs. Research in this field encompasses collaboration among individuals with special educational needs, families, educators, and professionals across educational, health, and welfare services, and addresses relational, communicative, ethical, organizational, and evidence-informed aspects of counselling practice. 

For this position, we particularly encourage applications with a quantitative empirical orientation. Relevant projects may make use of large-scale survey data, administrative or register-based data, repeated cross-sectional or longitudinal designs, evaluation studies, or combinations of these. Applicants should demonstrate methodological rigour and propose statistical methods appropriate to the research questions and data. Mixed-methods, qualitative, participatory, design-based, or intervention components are also welcome where they strengthen the overall project. Relevant data sources include Ungdata, HBSC (Health Behaviour in School-aged Children), other large-scale survey data, and administrative or register-based data. For example, Ungdata provides opportunities to investigate changes over time in adolescents' school well-being, school belonging, teacher and peer relationships, psychosocial difficulties, and future educational expectations, and how these factors relate to support needs, counselling, early identification, and preventive work in schools and local services.

Relevant doctoral projects may address, but are not limited to: 

  • Communication, interaction, and counselling processes in special needs education 
  • Counselling to support inclusive education, participation, and equitable educational 
    opportunities
  • Family – professional partnerships and parent counselling
  • School well-being, school belonging, teacher and peer relationships, mental health, and 
    educational aspirations among children and adolescents
  • The interplay between school experiences, psychosocial difficulties, social background, and 
    counselling-related support needs
  • Interdisciplinary and interagency collaboration
  • Counselling within schools, kindergartens, and the Educational and Psychological Counselling 
    Service (PPT)
  • Professional judgement, ethical decision-making, and relational competence
  • Implementation, evaluation, and improvement of counselling practices and support systems
  • Digital and technology-supported counselling and supervision

We welcome innovative and methodologically rigorous projects that advance knowledge and practice in counselling within special needs education.  

The successful applicant will become part of an active and collaborative research environment and is expected to participate in one of the Department's research groups. 


More about the position

The fellowship period is 3 years. A fourth year as a PhD Research Fellow may become relevant, and it will involve 25 percent of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This will depend on the candidate's qualifications and the needs of the institute. 

The research fellow must take part in the faculty’s approved PhD program, and is expected to complete the project within the set fellowship period. The main purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree.

For more information, please see our web site. 


Qualification requirements

Applicants must satisfy the requirements for admission to the faculty´s PhD program. This normally includes:

  • Applicants must hold a Master’s degree or equivalent in education, special needs education, psychology or other fields of relevance for the announced position 
  • A Master’s degree (120 ECTS) with a minimum grade B (ECTS grading scale) or equivalent. The master’s degree must include a thesis of at least 30 ECTS, with a minimum grade B
  • A bachelor’s degree with a minimum grade C (ECTS grading scale)
  • For 5-year studies, the average grade must be C or better for the first three years, and B or better for the last two years (ECTS grading scale). The Master thesis must have been graded with a minimum grade B
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and Norwegian (or another Scandinavian language)

Personal skills 

We are looking for a motivated and engaged PhD fellow with strong potential for high-quality research. Personal suitability will be emphasized and assessed based on the following qualities: 

  • Is academically curious, proactive and able to work independently 
  • Has good collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to collaborate and  be a part of a cross-disciplinary academic community 
  • Is structured, reliable and result-oriented in their work 
  • Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
  • Has the ability to give and receive constructive feedback

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


We offer
  • Salary NOK 550 800 - NOK 594  000 per annum depending on qualifications in a position as PhD Research Fellow, (position code 1017). From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • Attractive welfare benefits and a generous pension agreement, in addition to Oslo’s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • A friendly, interdisciplinary, and international research environment with dedicated colleagues at the Department of Special Needs Education 
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities

How to apply 

The application must include:

  • Cover letter, including statement of motivation and research interests
  • A project description (written in English), including progress plan (5-7 pages). Please see our guidelines 
  • CV (summarising education, positions, and academic work) 
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only). Foreign applicants must attach an explanation of their university’s grading system 
  • Documentation of English proficiency (for information on required documentation, see information on this webpage) 
  • Master’s thesis 
  • A complete list of publications and academic works 
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number)

Incomplete applications will not be assessed.

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. 

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language). 

When evaluating the application, emphasis will be given to the project description and the applicant’s academic and personal prerequisites to carry out the project. Applicants will be called in for an interview. 


Formal regulations

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Research Fellowships, Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The appointment may be shortened/given a more limited scope within the framework of the applicable guidelines on account of any previous employment in academic positions.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 27 400 students and 6 900 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Special Needs Education is one of the three departments at The Faculty of Educational Sciences.

The department focuses on basic and applied research and education of bachelor-, master- and doctoral level candidates within the field of special needs education in Norway. 

The department employs over 50 scientific staff in addition to about 20 administrative employees. The department has approximately 800 students distributed between bachelor- and master's degree studies in special needs education as well as PhD-studies.

jobs.title: Työnjohtaja, Kiuruveden maanteiden hoitourakka
jobs.description:
Etsimme työnjohtajaa Kiuruveden maanteiden hoitourakoihin, joissa pidämme huolen, että tiet pysyvät turvallisina ja liikenne sujuvana vuoden jokaisena päivänä. Meille infra ei ole vain rakenteita, vaan ihmisten arkea ja elämänlaatua. Tässä roolissa olet mukana varmistamassa, että kaikki pääsevät perille turvallisesti – työmatkalaiset, koululaiset ja ammattikuljettajat.

Minkälaiseen rooliin ja tiimiin olisit tulossa?

Työnjohtajana vastaat itsenäisesti työnjohtotehtävistä Kiuruveden maanteiden hoitourakassa raportoiden työmaapäällikölle. Työssäsi pääset tekemään monipuolisesti urakan tehtäviä, kuten johtamaan aliurakoitsijoita sekä huolehtimaan budjetti- ja materiaaliseurannasta. Työmaalla tapahtuvan työnjohtotehtävän vastuullisen hoitamisen lisäksi osallistut myös työmaan dokumentaation tuottamiseen. Tehtäviin sisältyy myös avustavia viranomaistehtäviä sekä talvi- ja kesäkelipäivystyksiä.

Työsuhde on luonteeltaan vakituinen, ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Toimipisteesi sijaitsee Kiuruvedellä.

Miten onnistut parhaiten tehtävässä?

Destialla menestyvät ihmiset, jotka arvostavat rehtiä tekemistä, turvallisuutta ja yhteistyötä. Haluamme, että jokainen voi kehittyä ja vaikuttaa omaan työhönsä. Työnjohtajana sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvaa tulevien urakoiden työmaapäälliköksi, jos sinulta löytyy halua kehittää osaamistasi ja ottaa lisää vastuuta.

Tehtävässä onnistuaksesi tarvitset

- soveltuvaa teknisen alan koulutusta, kuten rakennusmestari, rakennustekniikan insinööri

- aiempaa kokemusta hoitourakan ympärivuotisista tehtävistä ja talvipäivystyksestä sekä halua toimia työnjohtotehtävissä

- alueen paikallistuntemusta ja valmiutta liikkumiseen urakka-alueella päivittäin

- asiantuntijatestin palvelu- ja organisaatiovalmiuksista sekä kirjallisen asiantuntijatentin suoritusta EVK-keskuksen MH-urakan vaatimuksen mukaisesti

- yhteistyökykyä, erinomaisia viestintätaitoja sekä tietoteknisiä taitoja

- halukkuutta jakaa omaa ammattitaitoa ja osaamista tiimissä, työskentelemmehän yhdessä päivittäin

Lupaamme, että Destialla

Destialla pääset tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitys ihmisten arjessa. Rakennamme ja ylläpidämme infraa sen koko elinkaaren ajan yhdessä eri alojen osaajien kanssa tiimeissä, joissa jokaisen työpanos on tärkeä. Meillä voit kehittää osaamistasi ja rakentaa urapolkuasi omaan suuntaasi myös kansainvälisesti osana Colas-konsernia.

Haluamme, että Destialle on helppo hakea erilaisista taustoista käsin. Kohtelemme toisiamme yhdenvertaisesti ja arvostavasti, ja uskomme, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät, kun ihmiset saavat olla työssään omia itsejään ja tuoda esiin erilaisia näkökulmia. Kannamme vastuuta ihmisistä, ympäristöstä ja yhteiskunnasta arjen teoissa. Vastuullisuus näkyy meillä siinä, miten teemme töitä, huolehdimme toisistamme ja kehitämme infraa, joka palvelee ihmisiä pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Meille tärkeintä on, että nämä lupaukset näkyvät myös destialaisten omissa kokemuksissa joka päivä. [Lue lisää vastuullisuudesta ja tavastamme toimia nettisivuiltamme](https://destia.fi/tietoa-meista/vastuullisuus/).

Kiinnostuksesi herättyä toimi näin

Hae meille työkaveriksi työpaikkailmoituksen kohdasta "Hae tähän työpaikkaan", ja kerro vapaamuotoisesti osaamisestasi ja toiveistasi CV:n ja hakemuskirjeen muodossa. Seuraathan sähköpostiasi, sillä saat meiltä viestejä haun etenemisestä säännöllisesti. Haastattelut aloitamme usein jo hakuajalla sopivien ehdokkaiden kanssa.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja Destialla työskentelystä antaa mielellään työpäällikkö Markku Manninen, +358405850007, markku.manninen@destia.fi


Destia Oy

Destia on suurin infra-alan palveluita Suomessa tuottava yhtiö ja osa kansainvälistä Colas-konsernia. Luomme hyvän yhteiskunnan perustaa suunnittelemalla, rakentamalla ja ylläpitämällä huomisen liikenne- ja energiainfraa. Teemme sen noin 1 900 destialaisen ainutlaatuisella infran tajulla. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli noin 790 miljoonaa euroa. [www.destia.fi](http://www.destia.fi/)

The candidate will play an important role in this. Also, pending on the candidate’s background and interest, it can also be relevant to focus on interventions and skill development both through collecting new data sets and using existing data.

jobs.description:
Ansøgningsfrist: 24. september 2026

 

Er du ufaglært, kreativ og nytænkende i din tilgang til mad? Brænder du for at skabe gastronomiske oplevelser og levere service af høj kvalitet til dine gæster? Vil du være en del af et team, der har fokus på din faglighed, udvikling og trivsel? Så har vi jobbet for dig.

 

 

Faglighed og kreativitet

Vi vægter kvalitet højt, bæredygtighed og service står øverst på agendaen. Vi forventer vores personale tager et medansvar og er med til at levere en fantastisk service. Vi søger derfor en kok, som brænder for madlavningskunsten, som har mod på at vise sine ideer frem, og som er interesseret i at bidrage til at skabe et team i verdensklasse. Hvis du kan nikke genkendende til dette, så tror vi på, at dette er det rette sted for dig.

 

 

Kreativ, Serviceminded og fleksibel

Det forventes, at vores nye kok har erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen, formår at sætte standarden højt for det produkt, der skal leveres hver dag. Som vores nye kok er du en dygtig håndværker, der brænder for service og som er villig til at gå en ekstra mil for et godt resultat til kunden og for dine kolleger.

Som person er du udadvendt, kunne levere et højt serviceniveau hver eneste dag, når du selv i de travleste perioder formår du at holde hovedet koldt og forblive fokuseret. Du er samarbejdsvillig og motiveres af udfordringer. Du er ambitiøs i din tilgang til jobbet, og du går aldrig på kompromis med kvaliteten af den mad du serverer.

 Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt mandag til fredag

 

Ansøgning

Indsend dit CV, motiveret ansøgning og andre relevante dokumenter via linket 'Ansøg nu' senest d. 24. september 2026.Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning i dag frem for i morgen – det kan være dig, vi leder efter.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Site Manager Martin Patrick Rørsig på mail. Martin.Patrick.Roersig@dk.issworld.com 

 

 Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: People & Culture Generalist
jobs.description:
At IKEA Tampere, people are at the heart of everything we do. As our Unit P&C Generalist, you will be a trusted HR partner who helps leaders and co-workers thrive, supports a healthy and inclusive workplace, and turns People & Culture plans into practical everyday actions. You will work close to the business, because the best people solutions are built together, where everyday life happens.

**Who you are**

You are an experienced, people-centred HR professional who combines sound judgement with a warm, practical way of working. You enjoy being a reliable partner to leaders and co-workers, take ownership of your work, and bring people together to find solutions that support both wellbeing and business results. You can move confidently between employment relations, work ability management and everyday HR processes, while helping change happen in a clear and respectful way.

- You have several years of broad HR experience and can provide practical, trusted support to leaders, co-workers and the business.

- You have expertise in work ability management and a relevant educational background in education, psychology or a related field, supported by hands-on experience.

- You understand collective agreements and employment relations, ideally the Finnish Commerce Collective Agreement or another collective agreement you have applied in your work.

- You know how to work closely with occupational health partners and use wellbeing insights to support sustainable everyday working life.

- You build trust through approachable, clear and confidential communication, and you can document and explain HR matters accurately to different audiences.

- You take responsibility for moving agreed actions forward, stay calm when priorities change and work independently while actively asking for and offering support.

- You have ability to embrace different IT solutions and use them in your daily tasks.

- You are fluent in both Finnish and English and enjoy bringing people together across the Tampere unit to make change practical, inclusive and meaningful.


**What you'll be doing day to day**

As a Unit P&C Generalist, you will make a real difference to everyday working life at IKEA Tampere. You will partner with leaders and co-workers to make our People & Culture plans happen in practice, strengthening wellbeing, capability and a workplace where everyone can contribute. Your work brings together hands-on HR support, employment relations and organisational development. You will listen, give clear advice and turn insights into simple actions that help the unit grow through people.

- You will partner with unit leaders to plan, deliver and follow up local People & Culture actions that support business priorities and a positive co-worker experience.

- You will provide practical HR advice and coaching to leaders and co-workers on employment relations, policies, procedures and everyday people matters.

- You will coordinate work ability management and occupational health collaboration, helping to find timely, respectful and sustainable solutions for co-workers.

- You will support leaders in developing their leadership capabilities and help co-workers build the skills needed today and tomorrow also executing trainings and on-boarding process for co-workers and managers

- You will contribute to fair and constructive cooperation with employee representatives and ensure that local practices follow applicable collective agreements, legislation and IKEA ways of working.

- You will execute operational people related tasks and daily routines on unit level, e.g. on- and offboarding related tasks.

- You will use people data, feedback and everyday observations to identify opportunities, improve HR processes and make clear recommendations that lead to action.

- You will help strengthen IKEA Tampere as an attractive employer by supporting talent, inclusion, internal growth and a culture where people trust, support and challenge one another.


**Together as a team**

IKEA is all about people, and our team make sure to bring the best people on board to keep our strong spirit of togetherness. We believe that different experiences and backgrounds collectively make us wiser and stronger, and we ensure that our co-workers bloom into their best selves as they contribute to our business.

**Apply now!**

This position is full time 37,5 h/week and fixed term until 17.9.2027. Starting in the role by agreement, but no later than 2.11.2026.

In this role your working hours may vary from 08.00 - 18.00 based on business needs. Main working location is IKEA Tampere store.

The salary for the position starts at 3099 €/month and will be specified during the recruitment process based on the selected candidates experience, skills, and the final content of the role.

You can apply by clicking the Apply now button and attach an updated CV with your application and salary request latest on 24.9.2026, so we can get to know you better.

We are interviewing the applicants during the weeks 39 and 40. We will communicate about the progress of the recruitment process via email, so keep on eye your inbox.

If you have any questions about the role, Tampere Unit People & Culture Manager Petra Aalto will be happy to answer them. You can reach her at petra.aalto@ingka.ikea.com in either English or Finnish.

Need adjustments? If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruitment.ikea.fi@ikea.com. Were happy to help.

**IKEA AS EMPLOYER**

Working at IKEA is more than just a job – with us you are part of an equal and diverse working community. A sense of belonging is important to our employees, and team spirit is at the heart of what we do. IKEA offers a variety of career paths and opportunities to develop yourself in roles that are right for you. We give you the opportunity to bring your ideas to the table to help us develop our work, and to create new IKEA success!

In addition to your salary, you will also enjoy a wide range of comprehensive staff benefits, including flexible Epassi saldo, staff discounts on our products, healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch menus at very low prices in our staff restaurants, One IKEA Bonus, gifts on special days and at Christmas, and much more!

jobs.title: Merimajan päiväkoti Kotkassa hakee 2-3 varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa!
jobs.description:
Merimajan päiväkoti etsii joukkoonsa toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen kokeneita ja motivoituneita varhaiskasvatuksen opettajia, jotka haluavat olla mukana rakentamassa lasten turvallista, lämminhenkistä ja merkityksellistä arkea.

Meillä Merimajassa arvostetaan rauhallista, sensitiivistä työotetta ja yhteisöllistä tekemisen kulttuuria. Toimintaamme ohjaavat kristilliset arvot, kuten lähimmäisenrakkaus, oikeudenmukaisuus ja kunnioitus.

Työ, jossa jokainen päivä on merkityksellinen

Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana olet tärkeä osa lasten kasvun ja oppimisen polkua. Toimit kasvattajana, ohjaajana ja tiimin pedagogisena suunnannäyttäjänä. Meillä saat toteuttaa laadukasta, leikkiin ja oppimisen iloon pohjautuvaa pedagogiikkaa yhdessä osaavan ja välittävän työyhteisön kanssa.

Etsimme sinua, joka

- omaat varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuuden (Varhaiskasvatuslaki 6 luku §26, varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) mukainen kelpoisuus, huomioiden 74 § ja 75 § voimaantulon ja siirtymäsäännökset)


- työskentelet lapsilähtöisesti, sensitiivisesti ja ammatillisesti


- arvostat tiimityöskentelyä, yhteisöllisyyttä, avointa vuorovaikutusta ja kehittämistä


- osaat kohdata lapset, huoltajat ja työtoverit lämpimästi ja kunnioittavasti


- haluat olla mukana luomassa hyvän arjen kokopäiväpedagogiikkaa, jossa jokainen tuleenähdyksi ja kuulluksi.


Tarjoamme sinulle

- sitoutuneen ja välittävän työyhteisön, jossa huumori, arvostus ja yhdessä tekeminen näkyvät arjessa


- mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kasvuun ja kouluttautumiseen


- hyvinvointia tukevan ilmapiirin, jossa työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa arvostetaan


- riittävät resurssit ja varhaiskasvatuslain mukaiset ryhmäkoot


- työterveyshuollon Mehiläisessä, vaaterahan, tyhypäivät 2x/vuosi ja ePassi-edun


Tule osaksi Merimajan yhteisöä!

Jos sydämesi sykkii lasten kasvulle, varhaiskasvatuksen laadulle ja arvopohjaiselle työlle, saatat olla juuri se, jota etsimme.

Työsuhteessa noudatetaan 6kk koeaikaa. Valitun henkilön on esitettävä lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote sekä hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan. Tartuntatautilaki (55 §) velvoittaa alle kouluikäisten kanssa työskentelevien tuberkuloositartuntariskin selvittämisen.

Palkkaus 25E (3026,78- 3301,03e) riippuen kokemusvuosistasi.

jobs.title: Ympäristöasiantuntija, Keliber-litiumhanke
jobs.description:
Sibanye-Stillwaterin Keliber-litiumhanke on aloittanut Euroopan ensimmäisen omaan malmiin perustuvan akkulaatuisen litiumhydroksidin tuotannon vaiheittaisen käynnistämisen. Toiminta kattaa koko arvoketjun malminetsinnästä litiumhydroksidin jalostukseen ja vahvistaa Euroopan akkuarvoketjua. Rikastamo sijaitsee Kaustisen Päivänevalla ja litiumjalostamo Kokkolan suurteollisuusalueella (KIP).
Litiumhydroksidi on keskeinen raaka-aine litiumioniakuissa, jotka mahdollistavat sähköautot, energian varastoinnin ja monet digitaalisen arjen ratkaisut.
Keliber on kansainvälisen kaivos- ja metallinjalostusyhtiön Sibanye-Stillwaterin tytäryhtiö, ja sen toiseksi suurin omistaja on kotimaista akkuarvoketjua kehittävä Finnish Minerals Group.
Haluatko tarttua ainutlaatuiseen tilaisuuteen ja tulla luomaan uuden sukupolven suomalaista teollisuutta? Etsimme dynaamiseen ympäristöasiantuntijoiden joukkoomme

YMPÄRISTÖASIANTUNTIJAA

vastaamaan toimintamme ympäristötarkkailun toteuttamisesta ja kehittämisestä yhdessä tärkeimpien sisäisten ja ulkoisten sidosryhmiemme kanssa. Työnkuvaasi kuuluu tarkkailuohjelman mukainen näytteenotto (vesi, maa-ainekset ja kaivannaisjätteet), jätehuollon ohjeistus ja koordinointi tuotanto-osastoille sekä toiminnanharjoittajan laboratoriopalveluntarjoajan rajapinnalla toimiminen.
Toimit myös asiantuntijana ympäristöasioissa ja varmistat ympäristövelvoitteidemme huomioon ottamisen nyt hankkeen ylösajovaiheessa ja tuotannon käynnistyttyä. Raportoit työssäsi ympäristöpäällikölle.
Tärkeimmät vastuusi ovat:
-
toiminnan ympäristölupamääräysten ja velvoitteiden toteutumisen seuranta ja raportointi

-
vesien, kaivannaisjätteiden ja jätteiden hallinnan koordinointi

-
sidosryhmäyhteistyö (mm. ympäristökonsultit, viranomaiset)

-
tuotanto-osastojen ohjeistus ja opastus

-
viranomaismenettelyjen (YVA:t, lupamenettelyt, yms.) toteuttamisessa avustaminen.

Odotamme sinulta:
-
tehtävään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa (esim. AMK Ins., DI, FM)

-
vähintään 3 vuoden kokemusta teollisuuden ympäristötehtävistä tai teollisuuteen liittyvistä hankkeista, kokemus kaivosteollisuudesta sekä pätevyys vesinäytteiden ja kiinteiden näytteiden otossa luetaan eduksi

-
kokemusta teollisuuslaitoksen ympäristötarkkailun toteuttamisesta ja kehittämisestä sekä raportoinnista

-
kokemusta teollisen toiminnan ympäristövaikutusten arvioinnista sekä vesien ja jätteiden hallinnasta

kykyä ajatella kriittisesti, kehittymishalua ja yhteistyökykyä

-
hyvää raportointikykyä sekä sujuvaa englannin ja suomen kielen taitoa.

jobs.title: Analyst (Commercial Projects & Financial Analysis), Uusimaa
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will be the analytical backbone for senior commercial leads and project managers across high-stakes energy deals. Your day-to-day focus will center on hands-on quantitative work, building and running diverse Excel models for investment calculations, deal valuations, and complex partnership structures. You will analyze broad commercial cases - ranging from long-term PPAs and joint ventures to corporate structures and M&A activities and translate your findings into clear presentations for decision-makers. Rather than working in a static setup, you will navigate a fast-moving, agile environment where project priorities evolve quickly. This position is an ideal next step for an ambitious analyst with some experience from transaction advisory, investment banking, or consulting who enjoys quantitative modeling and wants to apply their skills directly inside an industry leader.

You are offered
You will work on high-stakes commercial cases presented directly to executive leadership while receiving close guidance and support from experienced senior professionals. The position offers strong long-term career advancement and internal mobility within the company, along with a balanced hybrid work model including a few remote days per week.

Work tasks

This role focuses on providing quantitative support and financial modeling for large-scale energy projects and strategic business developments.
- Supporting senior leads on large-scale customer and partnership deals
- Building detailed Excel models for investment calculations, valuations and contract structures
- Performing market and corporate finance analysis for joint ventures and M&A projects
- Turning quantitative data into clear slides and presentations for management and clients
- Utilizing AI tools (e.g., Copilot) to speed up analysis and reporting

We are looking for

- University degree in Finance, Economics or a related field
- Some experience in analyst roles (e.g., from consulting, advisory, corporate finance, or M&A)
- Strong Excel skills for hands-on financial modeling and investment calculations
- Solid foundation in Corporate Finance principles and valuation methods
- Strong quantitative abilities and comfort working with complex data
- Ability to present and explain financial findings clearly to stakeholders
- Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Finnish or Swedish
- Familiarity with the energy industry or large-scale infrastructure investments
- Background in Corporate Finance studies
- Experience with asset or portfolio optimization analysis

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Detail-oriented and structured
- Change-oriented
- Stress tolerant
- Proactive
- Collaborative
- Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Onko sinulla paloa uuden oppimiseen ja tunnet aitoa halua auttaa asiakkaita? Hienoa - jatka lukemista ja selvitä, onko Powerin Support-työntekijän paikka juuri sinua varten tehty!

Me parannamme ihmisten päivää silloinkin, kun asiakkaan lattialle pudonneesta tietokoneesta pitää siirtää kuvat uuteen Macbookiin, tietokoneen näyttö pitää lähettää takuuhuoltoon tai virus jyllää ja aiheuttaa murheita puhelimessa. Osaamme neuvoa asiakkaita uusien laitteiden käytön kanssa ja löydämme oikeat sanat asiakkaiden auttamiseksi silloinkin, kun neuvojamme tarvitsee oman elämänsä koodari tai ensimmäisen älypuhelimensa hankkinut seniori.

Powerilaisille yhdenvertaisuus sekä monimuotoisuus ovat tärkeitä arvoja. Etsimme nyt hyvää tyyppiä osaksi Power Kalevan porukkaa. Meillä kaikki ovat saman arvoisia!

Haluamme sinut vahvistamaan tiimiämme ja tarjoamme:

- Työpaikan hienojen ja alati kehittyvien tuotteiden parissa
- Aloituksen sopimuksen mukaan sekä laadukkaan perehdytyksen
- Monipuolisen ja osaamistasi laaja-alaisesti kehittävän työnkuvan
- Mielenkiintoisen pohjoismaisen yrityksen puitteet työympäristöksi
- Kaupanalan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen
- Illoista, lauantaista ja sunnuntaista saat lisät työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti
- Työtunnit viikossa 20/vko
- E-passi
- Liittymäetu
- Omia tulevia hankintoja varten tuotteet hyvään henkilökuntahintaan

Voisit olla etsimämme henkilö jos

- Haluat palvella asiakkaita parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla
- Aikataulujen ja rutiinien noudattaminen ei ole sinulle haastavaa
- Tulet hyvin toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa
- Olet proaktiivinen ja valmis oppimaan uutta
- Osaat työskennellä niin tiimissä, kuin itsenäisesti

Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata meille hakiessa ja tärkeintä onkin, että haluat oppia uutta ja palat halusta työskennellä asiakkaiden parissa. Me perehdytämme sinut työtehtäviisi ja autamme sinua kehittymään työssäsi jatkuvasti.

Aloittamisen suhteen olemme joustavia, mutta sopivan henkilön löytyessä aloitus onnistuu, vaikka heti.

Muuta tietoa

Power Finland kuuluu Power International AS -konserniin, joka omistaa Power ketjut Norjassa, Tanskassa, Suomessa sekä Ruotsissa. Meitä Powerilaisia on Pohjoismassa yhteensä yli 6500, joista kaikki ovat sitoutuneet tarjoamaan ainutlaatuisia asiakaskokemuksia asiakkaillemme. Pohjoismainen keskusvarastomme sijaitsee Ruotsissa ja konsernin liikevaihto on yli miljardi euroa. Lisätietoa meistä löydät nettisivuiltamme www.power.fi

Tervetuloa Powerille!

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in remote sensing and modeling of the cryosphere
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in remote sensing and modeling of the cryosphere, available at the Department of Geosciences, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences.

Starting date as soon as possible.

The appointment is a full-time position and is for a period of three years (10% of which is devoted to other career-promoting work, usually in the form of teaching activities).

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Department of Geosciences at Blindern, Oslo.


Project description

The position is affiliated with the Department’s Section for Physical Geography and Hydrology, which has long-term experience in investigating the terrestrial cryosphere and is involved in various high-level research projects and centers. (See for instance http://www.mn.uio.no/geo/english/about/organisation/geohyd and https://www.mn.uio.no/geo/english/research/groups/remotesensing). We are a growing, lively, friendly and collaborative research environment in cold regions sciences, in particular in glaciology, remote sensing, geohazards, hydrology and geomatics. We participate in a number of international projects such that the successful candidate will have excellent opportunities to participate in international research networks. We also run an advanced drone lab on behalf of the entire faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences (https://www.mn.uio.no/geo/english/research/about/infrastructure/facilities/observations/geosciences/the-drone-infrastructure-laboratory/).

  • The position is embedded in a network of projects that involve remote sensing of the cryosphere and related data science methods: 
    the European Research Council (ERC) Synergy Grant SnowShifts with University of Oslo (Prof. A. Kääb), EPFL Sion and WSL/SLF (Prof. M. Lehning), and BOKU Vienna (Dr. F. Koch) as PI institutions, and GFZ Potsdam, CESBIO Toulouse and ANavS Munich as further key partners. (https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101224858) 
  • the SchmidtSciences project MountAInWater (lead: F. Pelliciotti, ISTA, and W. Immerzeel, Utrecht, and further PIs from Canada, Singapore, Netherlands, Switzerland, Norway and Germany.  (https://www.schmidtsciences.org/view/#modal-mountainwater-water-from-the-mountains-global-reanalysis-and-future-tipping-points) 
  • various ESA projects including Glaciers_CCI, Permafrost_CCI, Karakoram Anomaly, and the forthcoming EarthExplorer 10 mission Harmony. (https://climate.esa.int/en/projects/, https://climate.esa.int/en/Cross_ECV_Projects/ , https://www.esa.int/Applications/Observing_the_Earth/FutureEO/ESA_selects_Harmony_as_tenth_Earth_Explorer_mission)

The candidate will develop and apply cutting-edge remote sensing or photogrammetry methods, in combination with data science approaches such as machine learning and data assimilation via cryospheric models. A main focus of this work is snow and glaciers in the mountains around the globe. Candidates with relevant prior research experience in these areas will therefore be given preference. The candidate will have ample opportunities to collaborate internationally with other world-leading research environments and space agencies, and for field work in mountain environments and the Arctic.

The exact focus of the position and its primary project affiliation will be developed together with the successful candidate.

The main purpose of a postdoctoral fellowship is to provide the candidates with enhanced skills to pursue a scientific top position within or beyond academia. To promote a strategic career path, all postdoctoral research fellows are required to submit a professional development plan no later than one month after commencement of the postdoctoral period.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in geomatics, geosciences, geophysics, environmental sciences, computer/data science or relevant topics in other fields. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defence are eligible for appointment
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.
  • Must document a strong quantitative background and interest in remote sensing or photogrammetry, and related data science approaches, and a strong interest in geosciences/climate sciences.
  • Must document scientific programming experience, specifically for data processing, analysis, or modeling of the cryosphere.
  • The candidate must have proof of excellence in research as demonstrated through publications in refereed journals and presentations at scholarly conferences. The candidate’s publication record must show evidence of creativity and capability of independent research.

Desired qualifications:

  • Good knowledge about cryospheric and mountain processes.
  • Interest and willingness for, or experience with, field work in high-mountain/cold environments is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in automated processing of large data volumes such as Earth observation data is beneficial. 
  • It is an advantage if potential previous experience with data science approaches includes the application of Bayesian inference or probabilistic machine learning to geophysical models.

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • You share our genuine enthusiasm for the cryosphere, and the technologies and methods to observe and understand its changes.
  • You are a person who prefers being present at work and actively contributes to the professional and social environment you are a part of.
  • You are able to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • You look forward to working in an interdisciplinary and international scientific environment.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Postdoctoral development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 690 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral fellowships at the University of Oslo.

If an applicant has applied for and been granted funding for a fulltime research stay abroad while being employed as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, the employment will be prolonged with the equivalent time as the research stay, but for no longer than of twelve months ( thus extending the employment to a maximum of four years)

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The geosciences are the studies of the planet Earth and its comparative planetology; the atmosphere, the hydrosphere and cryosphere, the Earth's surface and its interior. The Department of Geosciences conducts research and teaching in most of the domains of geoscience; geology, geophysics, physical geography, geomatics, hydrology, meteorology and oceanography. The Department is the broadest geoscience research and education environment in Norway. We perform research at a high international standard and have five ERC (European Research Council) research projects ongoing.

The Department encompasses six scientific sections; Meteorology and Oceanography, Geography and Hydrology, Study of sedimentary basins, Environmental geosciences. and Crustal Processes. We host now a third in the line of three Centre of Excellences:  PHAB – Centre for Planetary Habitability, and have a Norwegian Research School for PhD students (Research School for Dynamics and Evolution of Earth and Planets, DEEP).

The Department aims to contribute to the new and important UN Sustainability Development Goals, and are important contributors to IPCC (UN’s Inter-governmental Panel on Climate Change). The staff consists of 40 professors and associate professors, in addition to postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, researchers, technical- and administrative staff. The Department has around 200 employees.

jobs.title: Cuisinier (H/F)
jobs.description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.title: Kokenut huskyopas Pure Lapland / Wild Husky Rovaniemi Oylle
jobs.description:
**Kokenut huskyopas – tule mukaan Lapin talvikauteen!**

Onko sinulla kokemusta huskyvaljakon ajamisesta ja asiakkaiden opastamisesta? Nautitko vauhdikkaista työpäivistä, koirien kanssa työskentelystä ja Lapin talvesta? **Etsimme kokenutta huskyopasta vahvistamaan tiimiämme tulevalle talvikaudelle.**

Työtehtäväsi

Huskyoppaana vastaat asiakkaidemme turvallisesta ja elämyksellisestä retkestä alusta loppuun. Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

- huskyretkien opastaminen ja valjakon ajaminen

- moottorikelkalla huskyretkien valvonta

- asiakkaiden perehdyttäminen valjakkoajoon ja turvallisuusohjeisiin

- huskyjen hoitoon, ruokintaan ja hyvinvointiin liittyvät päivittäiset tehtävät

- varusteiden ja työympäristön kunnossapito

- asiakaspalvelu kansainvälisessä ympäristössä


Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme ennen kaikkea **henkilöä, jolla on jo käytännön kokemusta huskyoppaan työstä**. Osaat toimia itsenäisesti, vastuullisesti ja rauhallisesti myös kiireisinä päivinä ja vaihtelevissa talviolosuhteissa.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyvää fyysistä kuntoa, reipasta työotetta sekä kykyä tulla toimeen niin koirien kuin ihmistenkin kanssa. **Hyvä englannin kielen taito on tärkeä**, sillä suuri osa asiakkaistamme saapuu ulkomailta. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi. Työporukassa suomenkielentaito on tärkeä.

Arvostamme erityisesti positiivista asennetta, luotettavuutta, joustavuutta sekä aitoa kiinnostusta koirien hyvinvointiin ja laadukkaiden asiakaskokemusten luomiseen.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden työskennellä siperianhuskyjen, kansainvälisten asiakkaiden ja Lapin luonnon keskellä. Saat ympärillesi kokeneen työyhteisön sekä työn, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole aivan samanlainen.

**Jos huskyt, vauhdikas ulkotyö ja Lapin talvi ovat sinun juttusi, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.**

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi huskyjen ja opastustyön parissa. **Kokenut huskyopas saa meiltä paikan – hae mukaan!**

CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l'intégration et l'exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l'énergie, l'industrie, le transport, l'aéronautique et la cybersécurité.

Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d'innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d'affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites.

En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante.***Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance.

Forte d'un savoir-faire reconnu, elle contribue activement à renforcer la performance, la sécurité et l'innovation de l'écosystème spatial.

Nos équipes apportent leur expertise sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des missions : observation de la Terre, systèmes de navigation et de télécommunication, sciences et exploration interplanétaire, surveillance et sécurité de l'Espace. Portées par l'IA et nos solutions souveraines, nous repoussons chaque jour les frontières technologiques des programmes spatiaux européens.

Rejoindre cette Business Unit , c'est façonner le futur de l'espace aux côtés d'experts passionnés.

* OpenSource

Qualifications

De formation Bac+5 écoles d'ingénieur ou équivalent, vous possédez une expérience entre 3 et 5 ans en tant que DevOps . La connaissance du secteur spatial est un véritable atout. Vous maitrisez la plateforme de conteneurisation Docker / OCI ainsi que le logiciel Kubernetes .

La maitrise de l' anglais professionnel (lu, écrit et parlé) est indispensable.

jobs.title: Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term) (m/f)
jobs.description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership-it's our approach to business and relationships.  We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what's next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term)

BBH is currently recruiting a Depositary Services Senior Representative to join our dynamic Depositary Services team. In this key role you will be responsible for the coordination and performance of tasks relating to the supervision of assets of Real Estate, Private Debt and Private Equity funds. In addition, you will assess, analyze, and monitor risks and control issues for the products and services falling under the scope of the Depositary obligations.  You will have a high level of technical acumen and analytical skills in order to foster a solution orientated and consultative approach to performing our Depositary obligations

Key Responsibilities:

• Gather and review documentation received in relation to recordkeeping and verification of ownership of real assets (real estate, private debt, private equity, fund of funds) and proactively monitor the status and completion of those tasks and follow up to obtain required client documentation
• Build Strong relationships with Clients and have the knowledge and ability to explain the regulatory drivers behind these requirements
• Review and/or execute daily cash flow monitoring activities by gathering information and reviewing exceptions
• Support team in determining appropriate resolutions to new regulatory obligations.
• Monitor, report, define and document critical internal control processes.
• Formulate corrective actions, where applicable, to resolve identified exceptions.
• Coordinate internal and external projects in an efficient and thorough manner.
• Prepare and review documentation for regulators and external auditors
• Support Team on questions from clients, regulators, external auditors and/or BBH internal departments. Communicate clearly with business area contacts as well as other areas of the Bank
• Maintain effective working relationships at relevant levels with other departments
• Escalate within the team significant audit issues, set direction/communicate proposed manner of resolution of audit issues and concerns that have a significant impact
• Develop and maintain peer relationships to share best practices

Qualifications:

1. Education level and/ or experience

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting
• 2 to 4 years' experience working within the alternative funds industry or relevant business line experience
• Proficient Business level German skills are considered as an advantage

2. Knowledge and skills

• Excellent analytical, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to present complex and sensitive issues
• Technical skills in alternatives and regulation
• Good knowledge in European and local regulatory requirements
• Demonstrates Microsoft Office skills (with emphasis placed on Excel proficiency).
• Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and systems
• Ability to identify, escalate and resolve a problem.
• Ability to communicate professionally through effective verbal and written skills.
• Ability to manage time efficiently and effectively.
• Organizational skills and detail-oriented.
• Ability to work in a team environment.
• Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.
• Ability to manage and inspire people

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn't followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn't meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development-so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice-creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often-pushing the boundaries of innovation.  As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

jobs.title: Research Facilitator (m/f)
jobs.description:
Research Facilitator

(Valid from 03/09/2026 to 18/02/2027)

Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Research Support department

Job Number: UOL08436
Contract Type: Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Role Type: Open Position
Functions: Research support
Expertise: Research & Education Support
Job (internal): Research facilitator
Job Level: level 1

About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The mission of the Research Support Department is to support the University's aim to pursuit research at the highest international standard, by working in partnership with its researchers to secure, manage and increase funding from external organisations globally, nationally and regionally. This Department communicates the University of Luxembourg's Research Strategy and Policy. The Research Support Department is responsible for providing an effective, efficient and proactive support structure to help and advice researchers on project acquisition, research execution, research management, result dissemination and exploitation. To that end, it gathers and distributes relevant information, proactively identifies sources of research funding, organises training, develops procedures and guidelines in line with the University of Luxembourg's research strategy, and develops and fosters relationships with funding agencies, other research organisations and potential sponsors.

Your role

As a Research Facilitator, you will join a collaborative team working closely with researchers and colleagues across the University. You will work within established processes and contribute to their continuous improvement to meet evolving funding, regulatory and institutional requirements.

Responsibilities:

• Support researchers in identifying national, European and international funding opportunities, e.g. FNR, Horizon Europe and other competitive funding schemes e.g. US funding, with a strong focus on quality control for national funding, e.g. FNR
• Provide a solid understanding of the project management lifecycle of research grants to provide guidance throughout the grant lifecycle, from proposal preparation to project implementation and reporting
• Produce guidelines, checklist for funding instruments and ensure regular updates and optimization of relevant communication channels and platforms
• Perform institutional validation, quality control and compliance reviews of funding applications, ensuring compliance with funders' and institutional requirements
• Contribute to the dissemination of funding opportunities, policies, procedures, and good practices within the research and research support community via relevant communication channels and platforms
• Support the optimization of digital service delivery for the performance of institutional validation, quality control, and compliance processes
• Support the organization of information sessions, workshops, training activities, and networking events
• Liaise with funding agencies, and relevant internal stakeholders and external stakeholders
• Support the institutional validation, monitoring and reporting of research projects and funding-related activities
• Maintain accurate records and contribute to the effective management of research information and data via various systems, e.g. Common Research Information System, Power BI Reports
• Contribute to the development, review and continuous improvement of processes, tools, and guidelines
• Work collaboratively with all central services, Research Facilitators across Faculties and Interdisciplinary Centres to share knowledge and promote best practices
• Contribute to the delivery of efficient, proactive, and service-oriented research facilitation services

Your profile

• Master's degree or equivalent experience
• Strong interest in research, research funding, grant management, process improvements, digital service delivery, and the higher education environment
• Service-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving abilities
• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and meet deadlines
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively in a multicultural environment
• Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team
• Ability to build constructive working relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
• Previous experience in research administration, project coordination, grant preparation and management, business process improvements , digital service delivery, and research funding would be considered an advantage
• Familiarity with research funding programmes such as FNR and Horizon Europe would be considered an asset
• Excellent command in English (C1) is required. Good working knowledge of French and/or German (B1) is considered an advantage

We offer

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply

Applications should include:

• Curriculum Vitae
• Cover letter

Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

jobs.title: Fund Operations Oversight Officer (m/f) (CDD until the end of January 2027)
jobs.description:
ING Solutions Investment Management (ISIM) is looking for a Fund Operation Oversight Officer to support the current and planned developments of its activities in Luxembourg.

Your working environment

ISIM is a subsidiary of ING Luxembourg. ISIM benefits from the status of a ?Super ManCo? as it has the licenses to manage both UCITS and Alternative Investment Fund (AIF).ISIM oversees Investment funds distributed by ING Group entities.Launched in 2014, ISIM is pursuing its development and its positioning as the Management Company (?ManCo?) of ING Group and is the key tool for Investment fund solutions within the Group.ISIM is looking for a Fund Operation Oversight Officer to reinforce its team.

As a Fund Operation Oversight Officer, you will oversee the activities of the Central Administrations and Depositary Banks of investment funds managed by ISIM. More specifically, you will perform the following controls:

Oversight and controls of delegated functions (Fund Administration, Depositary Bank)

• Perform initial and periodic due diligence on the delegates
• Review and analyse the Key Performance Indicators & Key Risk Indicators of the funds (monthly review/exceptions reports from delegates)
• Review and follow up the cash and asset reconciliations
• Oversee the coordination of the fund corporate life cycle (general meetings of shareholders, board circular resolutions, etc)

• Ensure day-to day monitoring of delegates and follow-up of incidents

Financial Statements and other fund reporting

• Coordinate the entire funds? audit process with Central Administration and auditors
• Check the Financial Statements
• Review/coordinate all other fund reporting

Board reporting and meeting

• Organise the funds? board meetings
• Ensure the preparation of the board packs in collaboration with the various counterparties (Central Administration, Depositary Bank, auditors, Investment Manager)

Given the size of the team, the Fund Operation Oversight Officer will also have to ensure support/backup with regard to administrative tasks of the ManCo whenever needed.

This position is a great opportunity to:

• Develop and benefit from training on-the-job thanks to an expert team
• Join the Management Company of one of the leading banks in Luxembourg within an international environment
• Have a contributing role in the development of the structure, allowing for a spirit of initiative
• Work in a convivial and dynamic environment of a human-size company but integrated within a large group
• Benefit from a wide range of tasks and some autonomy, including multiple contacts with internal and external representatives

Your profile

Knowledge and experience

• Master in economics / finance or equivalent
• Relevant experience in the fund industry (e.g. in relation with Fund Administration, Depositary Bank or audit of funds)

Skills

Knowledge of:

• regulatory requirements and fund organization applicable to both UCITS and AIF;
• fund accounting mechanisms and NAV calculation
• financial markets and products
• Excel proficiency and comfortable with numbers
• Flexible and eager to learn
• Rigorous and critical scepticism
• Sense of responsibility and autonomy
• Team player with good communication skills (both oral and written)
• Fluent in French and English is a must have.

Your work environment

ING is a global financial institution with a strong European footprint. The Group provides retail and wholesale banking services to approximately 41 million customers worldwide. With more than 60,000 employees, ING operates through an international network and offers a broad range of banking and financial services across numerous markets.In Luxembourg, ING serves private, professional and institutional clients through dedicated teams of banking specialists, benefiting from both local expertise and the resources of an international banking group.

A proven track record in a sales position
A strong network of private customers and financial intermediaries in France

jobs.title: Senior AML Compliance Officer (m/f) - Chinese Speaker
jobs.description:
Description:


Our client, a well-established corporate bank based in Luxembourg, is looking to strengthen its Compliance team with the recruitment of a Senior AML Compliance Officer – Chinese Speaker.
This position offers the opportunity to join an international environment and take on a key role in supporting the institution's AML/CFT framework, with particular exposure to Chinese-speaking clients and stakeholders.


Your responsibilities:

As a Senior AML Compliance Officer, you will be involved in a broad range of AML/CFT and Compliance matters, including:

Performing and reviewing AML/KYC assessments on clients and transactions;
Conducting Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) on higher-risk relationships and complex structures;
Reviewing client files, source of wealth/source of funds and supporting documentation;
Performing transaction monitoring, sanctions, PEP and adverse media reviews;
Identifying, analysing and escalating potential AML/CFT risks;
Supporting the Compliance team with periodic reviews and remediation projects;
Providing advice and guidance to the business on AML/KYC-related matters;
Contributing to the development and update of Compliance policies and procedures;
Liaising with internal stakeholders and supporting interactions with relevant regulatory or control functions.


Your profile:

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in AML/KYC or Compliance, ideally within a bank or financial institution in Luxembourg;
Strong understanding of the Luxembourg AML/CFT regulatory environment;
Solid experience with complex KYC files, EDD and financial crime risk assessment;
Fluent Chinese/Mandarin is required, combined with professional proficiency in English;
French would be considered an advantage;
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail;
Ability to work independently while interacting effectively with international stakeholders;
Rigorous, pragmatic and business-oriented approach to Compliance.


The opportunity:

You will join an international and multicultural organisation offering significant exposure to cross-border activities and complex Compliance matters.
The position provides a high level of autonomy and the opportunity to work closely with both local and international stakeholders in a demanding but collaborative environment.
Indicative fixed salary: €80K–€110K gross per year, depending on experience and technical expertise.
If you are interested in this opportunity and would like to discuss the position confidentially, please feel free to apply.

jobs.title: Product Partnerships Manager, Consumer/SMB
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're hiring a Product Partnerships Manager to own Replit's most important strategic partnerships end-to-end: from identifying the opportunity to shipping the outcome and measuring the impact.

This is a product-focused role where you will work with our consumer technology partners, such as Stripe, Shopify, Google, and the broader connector ecosystem. You'll work at the intersection of product strategy, ecosystem thinking, and deal execution. You'll need to be a serious Replit power user. You'll speak credibly with engineers. You'll negotiate with senior partner stakeholders. And you'll be the person accountable for turning ambiguous ecosystem opportunities into shipped product and business outcomes.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop a clear point of view on Replit's partner landscape and build a prioritized pipeline of high-leverage opportunities across consumer tooling, AI tooling, cloud and infrastructure, and payments technology partners.

 - Lead partner conversations from early exploration through joint product thesis, business case, commercial terms, launch plan, and post-launch iteration.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Partner Engineering, Legal, Finance, Marketing, and Sales to turn agreements into shipped outcomes.

 - Work directly with Partner Engineers to scope integrations, demos, prototypes, reference apps, and partner enablement assets.

 - Define success metrics before every launch activation: retained usage, apps created, deployments, revenue, partner-sourced users, and use them to decide when to scale, iterate, or sunset a partnership.

 - Build lightweight operating systems: partner scorecards, launch checklists, partner roadmap tracking, and repeatable frameworks for evaluating new opportunities.

 - Represent the partner internally with strong product judgment; inform roadmap changes only when they create clear leverage for Replit users.



WHO YOU ARE

You're probably one of these:

 - A product partnerships or BD person from a developer platform, AI platform, API company, cloud platform, or builder tool.

 - A former PM or founder who can sell and negotiate externally while staying close to the product.

 - A technical ecosystem operator who has shipped integrations, partner programs, or AI-native workflows.

In all cases, you're a builder. You can open Replit and put together a credible demo. You're not expected to write production integration code but you need enough technical depth to scope the work, ask the right questions, and earn trust with engineers.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Experience sourcing, structuring, negotiating, and launching strategic partnerships.

 - Strong product judgment: you can explain why a partnership should or shouldn't influence the roadmap.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, auth, cloud and deployment, databases, LLMs, agents, and developer workflows.

 - Hands-on familiarity with Replit or comparable AI-native developer tools; ability to build credible demos and prototypes.

 - Ability to run an ambiguous, multi-party process from discovery through signed agreement, launch, and measurement.

 - Credibility with both senior external partners and internal engineers.

 - Strong written and verbal communication.

 


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Background in AI, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, API companies, or creative/productivity software.

 - Experience with MCP-style integrations, agent workflows, or AI model/tooling ecosystems.

 - Founder, PM, DevRel, solutions engineering, or technical BD background



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)
